import { promises as fs } from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import type { Synced1CSnapshot } from '@/types/accounting';
import { decode1CTextBuffer } from '@/lib/import1c/xmlAndBankParser';
import {
  buildSample1CSyncErrorPayload,
  normalize1CSyncPayload,
} from '@/lib/import1c/json1CSyncNormalizer';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

const CORS_HEADERS: Record<string, string> = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET, POST, DELETE, OPTIONS',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization, X-1C-Token',
  'Cache-Control': 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate',
};

function getCacheFilePath(): string {
  return path.join(process.cwd(), '.cache', '1c_latest.json');
}

function getRawCacheFilePath(): string {
  return path.join(process.cwd(), '.cache', '1c_latest_raw.json');
}

function getExternalExportCandidatePaths(): string[] {
  const candidates: string[] = [];
  const envPath = process.env.ONEC_EXPORT_JSON_PATH?.trim();
  if (envPath) {
    candidates.push(envPath);
  }
  candidates.push('C:\\Users\\Ludwig\\Downloads\\1c_export.json');
  try {
    const homeDownloads = path.join(os.homedir(), 'Downloads', '1c_export.json');
    if (!candidates.includes(homeDownloads)) {
      candidates.push(homeDownloads);
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore homedir lookup errors in restricted environments
  }
  return candidates;
}

async function writeSnapshotCache(snapshot: Synced1CSnapshot, rawPayload?: unknown): Promise<void> {
  const cacheFile = getCacheFilePath();
  await fs.mkdir(path.dirname(cacheFile), { recursive: true });
  await fs.writeFile(cacheFile, JSON.stringify(snapshot, null, 2), 'utf-8');
  if (rawPayload !== undefined) {
    await fs.writeFile(getRawCacheFilePath(), JSON.stringify(rawPayload, null, 2), 'utf-8');
  }
}

async function readSnapshotCache(): Promise<{
  snapshot: Synced1CSnapshot | null;
  mtimeMs: number;
}> {
  const cacheFile = getCacheFilePath();
  const rawCacheFile = getRawCacheFilePath();
  try {
    const stat = await fs.stat(cacheFile);
    const cachedText = await fs.readFile(cacheFile, 'utf-8');
    const parsedCached = JSON.parse(cachedText) as Record<string, unknown>;

    if (
      parsedCached &&
      parsedCached['isNormalizedSnapshot'] === true &&
      Array.isArray(parsedCached['allDocuments']) &&
      parsedCached['directories1C'] &&
      parsedCached['registers1C']
    ) {
      return {
        snapshot: parsedCached as unknown as Synced1CSnapshot,
        mtimeMs: stat.mtimeMs,
      };
    }

    // Fallback: re-normalize from raw cache if old format was stored
    try {
      const rawText = await fs.readFile(rawCacheFile, 'utf-8');
      const parsedRaw = JSON.parse(rawText) as unknown;
      const snapshot = normalize1CSyncPayload(parsedRaw);
      await writeSnapshotCache(snapshot);
      return { snapshot, mtimeMs: stat.mtimeMs };
    } catch {
      const snapshot = normalize1CSyncPayload(parsedCached);
      return { snapshot, mtimeMs: stat.mtimeMs };
    }
  } catch {
    try {
      const rawStat = await fs.stat(rawCacheFile);
      const rawText = await fs.readFile(rawCacheFile, 'utf-8');
      const parsedRaw = JSON.parse(rawText) as unknown;
      const snapshot = normalize1CSyncPayload(parsedRaw);
      await writeSnapshotCache(snapshot);
      return { snapshot, mtimeMs: rawStat.mtimeMs };
    } catch {
      return { snapshot: null, mtimeMs: 0 };
    }
  }
}

async function clearSnapshotCache(): Promise<void> {
  for (const filePath of [getCacheFilePath(), getRawCacheFilePath()]) {
    try {
      await fs.unlink(filePath);
    } catch {
      // Ignore if file doesn't exist
    }
  }
}

function toArrayBuffer(buf: Buffer): ArrayBuffer {
  return buf.buffer.slice(buf.byteOffset, buf.byteOffset + buf.byteLength) as ArrayBuffer;
}

export async function OPTIONS() {
  return new NextResponse(null, {
    status: 204,
    headers: CORS_HEADERS,
  });
}

export async function DELETE() {
  await clearSnapshotCache();
  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      status: 'ok',
      cleared: true,
      hasData: false,
      snapshot: null,
    },
    { headers: CORS_HEADERS }
  );
}

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const cached = await readSnapshotCache();

    // Safely check external 1c_export.json locations (never throws on EPERM or ENOENT)
    for (const extPath of getExternalExportCandidatePaths()) {
      try {
        const extStat = await fs.stat(extPath);
        if (!extStat.isFile()) continue;

        if (!cached.snapshot || extStat.mtimeMs > cached.mtimeMs) {
          const fileBytes = await fs.readFile(extPath);
          const decodedText = decode1CTextBuffer(toArrayBuffer(fileBytes)).trim();
          if (!decodedText) continue;

          const parsedJson = JSON.parse(decodedText) as unknown;
          const baseSnapshot = normalize1CSyncPayload(parsedJson, 'downloads-file');
          const snapshot: Synced1CSnapshot = {
            ...baseSnapshot,
            revision: `${baseSnapshot.revision}-m${Math.floor(extStat.mtimeMs)}`,
          };
          await writeSnapshotCache(snapshot, parsedJson);

          return NextResponse.json(
            {
              status: 'ok',
              hasData: true,
              syncedAt: snapshot.syncedAt,
              revision: snapshot.revision,
              snapshot,
            },
            { headers: CORS_HEADERS }
          );
        }
      } catch {
        // Sandbox EPERM or file does not exist — safely continue
      }
    }

    if (cached.snapshot) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          status: 'ok',
          hasData: true,
          syncedAt: cached.snapshot.syncedAt,
          revision: cached.snapshot.revision,
          snapshot: cached.snapshot,
        },
        { headers: CORS_HEADERS }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        status: 'ok',
        hasData: false,
        snapshot: null,
      },
      { headers: CORS_HEADERS }
    );
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Ошибка чтения кэша синхронизации 1С.';
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        status: 'error',
        hasData: false,
        error: msg,
      },
      { status: 500, headers: CORS_HEADERS }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const searchParams = req.nextUrl.searchParams;

    if (searchParams.get('clear') === '1') {
      await clearSnapshotCache();
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          status: 'ok',
          cleared: true,
          hasData: false,
          snapshot: null,
        },
        { headers: CORS_HEADERS }
      );
    }

    if (searchParams.get('demo') === '1') {
      const sampleRaw = buildSample1CSyncErrorPayload();
      const snapshot = normalize1CSyncPayload(
        sampleRaw,
        'demo-simulation',
        `demo-sim-${Date.now()}`
      );
      await writeSnapshotCache(snapshot, sampleRaw);

      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          status: 'ok',
          hasData: true,
          syncedAt: snapshot.syncedAt,
          revision: snapshot.revision,
          snapshot,
        },
        { headers: CORS_HEADERS }
      );
    }

    const rawArrayBuffer = await req.arrayBuffer();
    const decodedText = decode1CTextBuffer(rawArrayBuffer).trim();
    if (!decodedText) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          status: 'error',
          error:
            'Пустое тело запроса. Отправьте JSON выгрузки из 1С или вызовите ?demo=1 для тестового снимка.',
        },
        { status: 400, headers: CORS_HEADERS }
      );
    }

    let parsedJson: unknown;
    try {
      parsedJson = JSON.parse(decodedText);
    } catch {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          status: 'error',
          error: 'Некорректный JSON в выгрузке 1С. Проверьте формат сериализации ЗаписьJSON.',
        },
        { status: 400, headers: CORS_HEADERS }
      );
    }

    const snapshot = normalize1CSyncPayload(parsedJson, 'http-post');
    await writeSnapshotCache(snapshot, parsedJson);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        status: 'ok',
        hasData: true,
        syncedAt: snapshot.syncedAt,
        revision: snapshot.revision,
        snapshot,
      },
      { headers: CORS_HEADERS }
    );
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Ошибка приема синхронизации 1С.';
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        status: 'error',
        error: msg,
      },
      { status: 500, headers: CORS_HEADERS }
    );
  }
}


=== FILE: src\app\api\chat\route.ts ===
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import type { AiProviderConfig, ChatMessage } from '@/types/accounting';
import {
  buildChatSystemPrompt,
  ChatContextPayload,
  generateLocalExpertReply,
} from '@/lib/ai/localExpertChat';

interface ChatRequestBody {
  messages?: Array<{
    id?: string;
    role?: 'user' | 'assistant' | 'system';
    content?: string;
    timestamp?: string;
  }>;
  message?: string;
  question?: string;
  context?: ChatContextPayload;
  aiConfig?: AiProviderConfig;
}

function normalizeMessages(body: ChatRequestBody): ChatMessage[] {
  if (Array.isArray(body.messages) && body.messages.length > 0) {
    return body.messages
      .filter((m) => typeof m?.content === 'string' && m.content.trim().length > 0)
      .map((m, idx) => ({
        id: m.id || `msg-${idx + 1}`,
        role: m.role === 'assistant' ? 'assistant' : 'user',
        content: (m.content || '').trim(),
        timestamp: m.timestamp || new Date().toISOString(),
      }));
  }

  const single = (body.message || body.question || '').trim();
  if (single) {
    return [
      {
        id: 'msg-1',
        role: 'user',
        content: single,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
    ];
  }

  return [];
}

function resolveChatProvider(aiConfig?: AiProviderConfig): {
  mode: 'gemini' | 'openai-compatible' | 'local-expert';
  apiKey: string;
  model: string;
  baseUrl: string;
} {
  const envGemini = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY?.trim() || '';
  const envOpenAi = process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY?.trim() || '';

  if (aiConfig?.provider === 'gemini') {
    const key = aiConfig.apiKey?.trim() || envGemini;
    if (key) {
      return {
        mode: 'gemini',
        apiKey: key,
        model: aiConfig.model?.trim() || 'gemini-2.0-flash',
        baseUrl: 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com',
      };
    }
  }

  if (aiConfig?.provider === 'openai-compatible') {
    const key = aiConfig.apiKey?.trim() || envOpenAi;
    if (key) {
      return {
        mode: 'openai-compatible',
        apiKey: key,
        model: aiConfig.model?.trim() || 'gpt-4o-mini',
        baseUrl: (aiConfig.baseUrl?.trim() || 'https://api.openai.com/v1').replace(/\/+$/, ''),
      };
    }
  }

  if (!aiConfig || aiConfig.provider !== 'demo-local') {
    if (envGemini) {
      return {
        mode: 'gemini',
        apiKey: envGemini,
        model: aiConfig?.model?.trim() || 'gemini-2.0-flash',
        baseUrl: 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com',
      };
    }
    if (envOpenAi) {
      return {
        mode: 'openai-compatible',
        apiKey: envOpenAi,
        model: aiConfig?.model?.trim() || 'gpt-4o-mini',
        baseUrl: (aiConfig?.baseUrl?.trim() || 'https://api.openai.com/v1').replace(/\/+$/, ''),
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    mode: 'local-expert',
    apiKey: '',
    model: '',
    baseUrl: '',
  };
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const body = (await req.json()) as ChatRequestBody;
    const messages = normalizeMessages(body);
    const context = body.context;
    const aiConfig = body.aiConfig;

    if (messages.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          usedMode: 'local-expert' as const,
          reply: 'Пожалуйста, введите ваш вопрос по 1С:Бухгалтерия 8.3.',
          error: 'Пустой список сообщений.',
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const resolved = resolveChatProvider(aiConfig);

    // =========================================================================
    // 1. LOCAL 1C 8.3 EXPERT ENGINE
    // =========================================================================
    if (resolved.mode === 'local-expert') {
      const reply = generateLocalExpertReply(messages, context);
      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        usedMode: 'local-expert' as const,
        reply,
      });
    }

    const systemPrompt = buildChatSystemPrompt(context);
    const recentMessages = messages.slice(-14);

    // =========================================================================
    // 2. GEMINI CHAT
    // =========================================================================
    if (resolved.mode === 'gemini') {
      const modelName = resolved.model.replace(/^models\//, '') || 'gemini-2.0-flash';
      const endpoint = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${encodeURIComponent(
        modelName
      )}:generateContent?key=${encodeURIComponent(resolved.apiKey)}`;

      const geminiContents = recentMessages.map((m) => ({
        role: m.role === 'assistant' ? 'model' : 'user',
        parts: [{ text: m.content }],
      }));

      const resp = await fetch(endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          systemInstruction: {
            parts: [{ text: systemPrompt }],
          },
          contents: geminiContents,
          generationConfig: {
            temperature: 0.25,
          },
        }),
      });

      if (!resp.ok) {
        const errText = await resp.text().catch(() => '');
        throw new Error(
          `Ошибка Gemini API (${resp.status}): ${errText.slice(0, 240) || resp.statusText}`
        );
      }

      const data = (await resp.json()) as {
        candidates?: Array<{ content?: { parts?: Array<{ text?: string }> } }>;
      };
      const reply =
        data.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts
          ?.map((p) => p.text || '')
          .join('\n')
          .trim() || '';

      if (!reply) {
        throw new Error('Модель Gemini вернула пустой ответ.');
      }

      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        usedMode: 'llm' as const,
        reply,
      });
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 3. OPENAI-COMPATIBLE CHAT
    // =========================================================================
    const endpoint = `${resolved.baseUrl}/chat/completions`;
    const resp = await fetch(endpoint, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${resolved.apiKey}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model: resolved.model || 'gpt-4o-mini',
        temperature: 0.25,
        messages: [
          { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt },
          ...recentMessages.map((m) => ({
            role: m.role,
            content: m.content,
          })),
        ],
      }),
    });

    if (!resp.ok) {
      const errText = await resp.text().catch(() => '');
      throw new Error(
        `Ошибка OpenAI API (${resp.status}): ${errText.slice(0, 240) || resp.statusText}`
      );
    }

    const data = (await resp.json()) as {
      choices?: Array<{ message?: { content?: string } }>;
    };
    const reply = data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.trim() || '';
    if (!reply) {
      throw new Error('OpenAI-совместимая модель вернула пустой ответ.');
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      usedMode: 'llm' as const,
      reply,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    const errMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Ошибка обращения к ИИ-помощнику.';
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        usedMode: 'llm' as const,
        reply: `Не удалось получить ответ от внешнего ИИ (${errMsg}). Проверьте API-ключ в «Настройках ИИ» или переключите режим на встроенный экспертный модуль 1С 8.3.`,
        error: errMsg,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import type {
  AiProviderConfig,
  OpeningBalanceEntry,
  OrganizationCard,
} from '@/types/accounting';
import {
  buildTaskParserSystemPrompt,
  ParsedTaskResponseSchema,
} from '@/lib/ai/schemas';
import { parseTaskLocally } from '@/lib/ai/localRuleParser';

interface ParseTaskRequestBody {
  rawText?: string;
  imageBase64?: string;
  organization?: OrganizationCard;
  openingBalances?: OpeningBalanceEntry[];
  aiConfig?: AiProviderConfig;
}

function parseDataUrlImage(input: string): { mimeType: string; base64Data: string; dataUrl: string } {
  const trimmed = input.trim();
  const match = trimmed.match(/^data:(image\/[a-zA-Z0-9.+-]+);base64,([\s\S]+)$/);
  if (match) {
    const mimeType = match[1];
    const base64Data = match[2].replace(/\s+/g, '');
    return {
      mimeType,
      base64Data,
      dataUrl: `data:${mimeType};base64,${base64Data}`,
    };
  }
  const cleanBase64 = trimmed.replace(/\s+/g, '');
  const mimeType = cleanBase64.startsWith('/9j/')
    ? 'image/jpeg'
    : cleanBase64.startsWith('UklGR')
      ? 'image/webp'
      : 'image/png';
  return {
    mimeType,
    base64Data: cleanBase64,
    dataUrl: `data:${mimeType};base64,${cleanBase64}`,
  };
}

function extractJsonFromModelText(text: string): unknown {
  const trimmed = text.trim();
  const unfenced = trimmed
    .replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i, '')
    .replace(/\s*```$/i, '')
    .trim();

  try {
    return JSON.parse(unfenced);
  } catch {
    const firstBrace = unfenced.indexOf('{');
    const lastBrace = unfenced.lastIndexOf('}');
    if (firstBrace !== -1 && lastBrace > firstBrace) {
      return JSON.parse(unfenced.slice(firstBrace, lastBrace + 1));
    }
    throw new Error('Модель вернула ответ не в формате JSON.');
  }
}

function resolveEffectiveAiProvider(
  aiConfig?: AiProviderConfig,
  hasImage = false
): {
  mode: 'gemini' | 'openai-compatible' | 'local';
  apiKey: string;
  model: string;
  baseUrl: string;
} {
  const envGemini = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY?.trim() || '';
  const envOpenAi = process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY?.trim() || '';

  if (aiConfig?.provider === 'gemini') {
    const key = aiConfig.apiKey?.trim() || envGemini;
    if (key) {
      return {
        mode: 'gemini',
        apiKey: key,
        model: aiConfig.model?.trim() || 'gemini-2.0-flash',
        baseUrl: 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com',
      };
    }
  }

  if (aiConfig?.provider === 'openai-compatible') {
    const key = aiConfig.apiKey?.trim() || envOpenAi;
    if (key) {
      return {
        mode: 'openai-compatible',
        apiKey: key,
        model: aiConfig.model?.trim() || 'gpt-4o-mini',
        baseUrl: (aiConfig.baseUrl?.trim() || 'https://api.openai.com/v1').replace(/\/+$/, ''),
      };
    }
  }

  // When aiConfig is omitted or demo-local without explicit key:
  // use env keys if available when no explicit demo-local override, OR when Vision image requires an LLM
  if (!aiConfig || aiConfig.provider !== 'demo-local' || hasImage) {
    if (envGemini) {
      return {
        mode: 'gemini',
        apiKey: envGemini,
        model: aiConfig?.model?.trim() || 'gemini-2.0-flash',
        baseUrl: 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com',
      };
    }
    if (envOpenAi) {
      return {
        mode: 'openai-compatible',
        apiKey: envOpenAi,
        model: aiConfig?.model?.trim() || 'gpt-4o-mini',
        baseUrl: (aiConfig?.baseUrl?.trim() || 'https://api.openai.com/v1').replace(/\/+$/, ''),
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    mode: 'local',
    apiKey: '',
    model: '',
    baseUrl: '',
  };
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const body = (await req.json()) as ParseTaskRequestBody;
    const rawText = typeof body.rawText === 'string' ? body.rawText.trim() : '';
    const imageBase64 = typeof body.imageBase64 === 'string' ? body.imageBase64.trim() : '';
    const organization = body.organization;
    const openingBalances = body.openingBalances;
    const aiConfig = body.aiConfig;

    if (!rawText && !imageBase64) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            'Не передан текст операций или изображение таблицы. Вставьте текст/таблицу из Excel или прикрепите скриншот.',
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const resolved = resolveEffectiveAiProvider(aiConfig, Boolean(imageBase64));

    // =========================================================================
    // 1. LOCAL SMART PARSER MODE (no API key or provider === 'demo-local')
    // =========================================================================
    if (resolved.mode === 'local') {
      if (!rawText && imageBase64) {
        const friendlyMsg =
          'Для распознавания скриншотов и фотографий методичек (Vision OCR) необходим API-ключ Gemini или OpenAI. ' +
          'Откройте «Настройки ИИ» в верхней панели и добавьте ключ, ЛИБО вставьте текст таблицы / загрузите файл Excel (.xlsx, .csv) / выберите готовую демо-задачу — умный локальный парсер 1С 8.3 разберет текст и таблицы мгновенно и без API-ключа!';
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            success: false,
            usedMode: 'local-smart-parser',
            requiresApiKey: true,
            error: friendlyMsg,
            message: friendlyMsg,
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      const localResult = parseTaskLocally(rawText, organization?.defaultVatRate ?? 20);
      if (localResult.operations.length === 0) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            success: false,
            usedMode: 'local-smart-parser',
            error:
              'Не удалось распознать хозяйственные операции из введенного текста. Проверьте наличие строк с описанием операций.',
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        usedMode: 'local-smart-parser',
        title: localResult.title,
        operations: localResult.operations,
        directories: localResult.directories,
        warnings: imageBase64
          ? [
              ...localResult.warnings,
              'Изображение проигнорировано (API-ключ не задан) — разбор выполнен по текстовой части через локальный парсер 1С 8.3.',
            ]
          : localResult.warnings,
      });
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 2. GEMINI VISION / JSON STRUCTURED PARSER
    // =========================================================================
    const systemPrompt = buildTaskParserSystemPrompt(organization, openingBalances);
    const q2FilterHint =
      'ВАЖНО: Если в тексте или файле есть секция «За 1 квартал», начальные остатки, реквизиты организации (ИНН, БИК 044030653) или операции с датами до 01.04 (январь/февраль/март), ИГНОРИРУЙ их и извлекай ТОЛЬКО хозяйственные операции 2 квартала (с 1 апреля)! Никогда не путай номера документов, табельные номера или БИК/ИНН с суммой операции.';
    const userPrompt = rawText
      ? `Распознай и разбери по правилам 1С:Бухгалтерия 8.3 (ред. 3.0) следующую учебную задачу.\n${q2FilterHint}\n\n${rawText}`
      : `Внимательно прочитай прикрепленный скриншот / фото таблицы хозяйственных операций, извлеки каждую строку без пропусков и верни полный разбор по правилам 1С:Бухгалтерия 8.3 (ред. 3.0) строго в формате JSON.\n${q2FilterHint}`;

    if (resolved.mode === 'gemini') {
      const modelName = resolved.model.replace(/^models\//, '') || 'gemini-2.0-flash';
      const endpoint = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${encodeURIComponent(
        modelName
      )}:generateContent?key=${encodeURIComponent(resolved.apiKey)}`;

      const parts: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
      if (imageBase64) {
        const parsedImg = parseDataUrlImage(imageBase64);
        parts.push({
          inlineData: {
            mimeType: parsedImg.mimeType,
            data: parsedImg.base64Data,
          },
        });
      }
      parts.push({ text: userPrompt });

      const geminiResp = await fetch(endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          systemInstruction: {
            parts: [{ text: systemPrompt }],
          },
          contents: [
            {
              role: 'user',
              parts,
            },
          ],
          generationConfig: {
            temperature: 0.1,
            responseMimeType: 'application/json',
          },
        }),
      });

      if (!geminiResp.ok) {
        const errText = await geminiResp.text().catch(() => '');
        throw new Error(
          `Ошибка Gemini API (${geminiResp.status}): ${errText.slice(0, 280) || geminiResp.statusText}`
        );
      }

      const geminiJson = (await geminiResp.json()) as {
        candidates?: Array<{
          content?: { parts?: Array<{ text?: string }> };
        }>;
      };
      const rawModelText =
        geminiJson.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts
          ?.map((p) => p.text || '')
          .join('\n')
          .trim() || '';

      if (!rawModelText) {
        throw new Error('Gemini вернул пустой ответ при разборе задачи.');
      }

      const parsedRawObj = extractJsonFromModelText(rawModelText);
      const validated = ParsedTaskResponseSchema.parse(parsedRawObj);

      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        usedMode: 'gemini',
        title: validated.title,
        operations: validated.operations,
        directories: validated.directories,
        warnings: validated.warnings,
      });
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 3. OPENAI-COMPATIBLE VISION / JSON STRUCTURED PARSER
    // =========================================================================
    const endpoint = `${resolved.baseUrl}/chat/completions`;
    const userContent: unknown = imageBase64
      ? [
          { type: 'text', text: userPrompt },
          {
            type: 'image_url',
            image_url: { url: parseDataUrlImage(imageBase64).dataUrl },
          },
        ]
      : userPrompt;

    const openAiResp = await fetch(endpoint, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${resolved.apiKey}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model: resolved.model || 'gpt-4o-mini',
        temperature: 0.1,
        response_format: { type: 'json_object' },
        messages: [
          { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt },
          { role: 'user', content: userContent },
        ],
      }),
    });

    if (!openAiResp.ok) {
      const errText = await openAiResp.text().catch(() => '');
      throw new Error(
        `Ошибка OpenAI API (${openAiResp.status}): ${errText.slice(0, 280) || openAiResp.statusText}`
      );
    }

    const openAiJson = (await openAiResp.json()) as {
      choices?: Array<{ message?: { content?: string } }>;
    };
    const rawModelText = openAiJson.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.trim() || '';
    if (!rawModelText) {
      throw new Error('OpenAI-совместимый провайдер вернул пустой ответ.');
    }

    const parsedRawObj = extractJsonFromModelText(rawModelText);
    const validated = ParsedTaskResponseSchema.parse(parsedRawObj);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      usedMode: 'openai-compatible',
      title: validated.title,
      operations: validated.operations,
      directories: validated.directories,
      warnings: validated.warnings,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Неизвестная ошибка при разборе задачи.';
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: message,
        message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

'use client';

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  ArrowRight,
  Bot,
  Compass,
  HelpCircle,
  Lightbulb,
  Loader2,
  RotateCcw,
  Send,
  Settings2,
  Sparkles,
  User,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useAccountant } from '@/context/AccountantContext';
import { ACCOUNT_MAP } from '@/data/chartOfAccounts';

export interface AccountantChatPanelProps {
  isOpen?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  onCloseMobile?: () => void;
  onOpenAiSettings?: () => void;

const QUICK_QUESTIONS: string[] = [
  'Почему здесь счет 20.01, а не 41?',
  'Как правильно оформить УПД в 1С 8.3?',
  'Не закрывается 20 счет при закрытии месяца, что проверить?',
  'Разбери проводки и НДС по текущей операции',
  'Почему у меня расхождение в ОСВ?',
];

function highlightAccountTokens(
  text: string,
  onSelectAccount: (code: string) => void,
  keyPrefix: string
): React.ReactNode[] {
  const regex = /(\b\d{2}\.\d{1,2}(?:\.[0-9А-ЯЁA-Z]{1,3})?\b|\b000\b)/g;
  const parts: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  let lastIndex = 0;
  let match: RegExpExecArray | null;

  while ((match = regex.exec(text)) !== null) {
    const candidate = match[1];
    if (!ACCOUNT_MAP[candidate]) {
      continue;
    }

    if (match.index > lastIndex) {
      parts.push(text.slice(lastIndex, match.index));
    }

    parts.push(
      <button
        key={`${keyPrefix}-acc-${match.index}`}
        type="button"
        onClick={() => onSelectAccount(candidate)}
        title={`Счет ${candidate}: ${ACCOUNT_MAP[candidate].name} (перейти в ОСВ)`}
        className="mx-0.5 inline-flex items-center rounded border border-zinc-300 bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0 font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-900 tabular-nums transition hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700"
      >
        {candidate}
      </button>
    );

    lastIndex = match.index + candidate.length;
  }

  if (lastIndex < text.length) {
    parts.push(text.slice(lastIndex));
  }

  return parts.length > 0 ? parts : [text];
}

function renderInlineMarkdown(
  text: string,
  onSelectAccount: (code: string) => void,
  keyPrefix: string
): React.ReactNode[] {
  const tokenRegex = /(\*\*[^*]+\*\*|`[^`]+`)/g;
  const nodes: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  let lastIdx = 0;
  let match: RegExpExecArray | null;

  while ((match = tokenRegex.exec(text)) !== null) {
    if (match.index > lastIdx) {
      const plain = text.slice(lastIdx, match.index);
      nodes.push(...highlightAccountTokens(plain, onSelectAccount, `${keyPrefix}-p-${lastIdx}`));
    }

    const token = match[0];
    if (token.startsWith('**') && token.endsWith('**')) {
      const inner = token.slice(2, -2);
      nodes.push(
        <strong
          key={`${keyPrefix}-b-${match.index}`}
          className="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100"
        >
          {highlightAccountTokens(inner, onSelectAccount, `${keyPrefix}-bi-${match.index}`)}
        </strong>
      );
    } else if (token.startsWith('`') && token.endsWith('`')) {
      const inner = token.slice(1, -1).trim();
      if (ACCOUNT_MAP[inner]) {
        nodes.push(
          <button
            key={`${keyPrefix}-cacc-${match.index}`}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onSelectAccount(inner)}
            title={`Счет ${inner}: ${ACCOUNT_MAP[inner].name} (перейти в ОСВ)`}
            className="mx-0.5 inline-flex items-center rounded border border-zinc-300 bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-900 tabular-nums transition hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700"
          >
            {inner}
          </button>
        );
      } else {
        nodes.push(
          <code
            key={`${keyPrefix}-code-${match.index}`}
            className="rounded border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 tabular-nums dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"
          >
            {inner}
          </code>
        );
      }
    }

    lastIdx = match.index + token.length;
  }

  if (lastIdx < text.length) {
    nodes.push(...highlightAccountTokens(text.slice(lastIdx), onSelectAccount, `${keyPrefix}-tail`));
  }

  return nodes;
}

function FormattedChatContent({
  content,
  isUser,
  onSelectAccount,
}: {
  content: string;
  isUser: boolean;
  onSelectAccount: (code: string) => void;
}) {
  if (isUser) {
    return <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-xs leading-relaxed">{content}</p>;
  }

  const lines = content.split('\n');
  const blocks: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  let listItems: { ordered: boolean; items: string[] } | null = null;

  const flushList = (keyIdx: number) => {
    if (!listItems) return;
    if (listItems.ordered) {
      blocks.push(
        <ol
          key={`ol-${keyIdx}`}
          className="my-1.5 list-decimal space-y-1 pl-4 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300"
        >
          {listItems.items.map((item, i) => (
            <li key={i}>
              {renderInlineMarkdown(item, onSelectAccount, `oli-${keyIdx}-${i}`)}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      );
    } else {
      blocks.push(
        <ul
          key={`ul-${keyIdx}`}
          className="my-1.5 list-disc space-y-1 pl-4 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300"
        >
          {listItems.items.map((item, i) => (
            <li key={i}>
              {renderInlineMarkdown(item, onSelectAccount, `uli-${keyIdx}-${i}`)}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      );
    }
    listItems = null;
  };

  lines.forEach((rawLine, idx) => {
    const trimmed = rawLine.trim();

    if (!trimmed) {
      flushList(idx);
      return;
    }

    if (/^---+$/.test(trimmed)) {
      flushList(idx);
      blocks.push(
        <hr key={`hr-${idx}`} className="my-2 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800" />
      );
      return;
    }

    const headingMatch = /^(#{1,4})\s+(.+)$/.exec(trimmed);
    if (headingMatch) {
      flushList(idx);
      blocks.push(
        <h4
          key={`h-${idx}`}
          className="mt-2.5 mb-1 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100"
        >
          {renderInlineMarkdown(headingMatch[2], onSelectAccount, `h-${idx}`)}
        </h4>
      );
      return;
    }

    const unorderedMatch = /^[-*•]\s+(.+)$/.exec(trimmed);
    if (unorderedMatch) {
      if (!listItems || listItems.ordered) {
        flushList(idx);
        listItems = { ordered: false, items: [] };
      }
      listItems.items.push(unorderedMatch[1]);
      return;
    }

    const orderedMatch = /^\d+[.)]\s+(.+)$/.exec(trimmed);
    if (orderedMatch) {
      if (!listItems || !listItems.ordered) {
        flushList(idx);
        listItems = { ordered: true, items: [] };
      }
      listItems.items.push(orderedMatch[1]);
      return;
    }

    flushList(idx);

    if (trimmed.startsWith('>')) {
      const quoteText = trimmed.replace(/^>\s*/, '');
      blocks.push(
        <blockquote
          key={`q-${idx}`}
          className="my-1.5 rounded border-l-2 border-zinc-500 bg-zinc-50 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-400 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
        >
          {renderInlineMarkdown(quoteText, onSelectAccount, `q-${idx}`)}
        </blockquote>
      );
      return;
    }

    blocks.push(
      <p
        key={`p-${idx}`}
        className="my-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300"
      >
        {renderInlineMarkdown(trimmed, onSelectAccount, `p-${idx}`)}
      </p>
    );
  });

  flushList(lines.length);

  return <div className="space-y-1">{blocks}</div>;
}

export function AccountantChatPanel({
  isOpen,
  onOpenChange,
  onCloseMobile,
  onOpenAiSettings,
}: AccountantChatPanelProps) {
  const {
    effectiveOrganization,
    openingBalances,
    activeOperation,
    operations,
    osvReport,
    reconciliation,
    auditReport,
    chatMessages,
    aiConfig,
    addChatMessage,
    clearChatMessages,
    setActiveTab,
  } = useAccountant();

  const [internalOpen, setInternalOpen] = useState(false);
  const drawerOpen = isOpen !== undefined ? isOpen : internalOpen;

  const setDrawerOpen = useCallback(
    (next: boolean) => {
      if (onOpenChange) {
        onOpenChange(next);
      } else {
        setInternalOpen(next);
      }
      if (!next && onCloseMobile) {
        onCloseMobile();
      }
    },
    [onOpenChange, onCloseMobile]
  );

  const [input, setInput] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [showQuickChips, setShowQuickChips] = useState(true);
  const [seenContextSignature, setSeenContextSignature] = useState<string>('');
  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  const redAccountsCount = useMemo(
    () => osvReport.rows.filter((r) => !r.isGroup && r.hasRedBalance).length,
    [osvReport.rows]
  );

  const discrepancyCount = reconciliation.diagnostics.length;
  const auditIssuesCount = auditReport.totalIssuesCount;

  const contextualTipSummary = useMemo(() => {
    if (auditIssuesCount > 0) {
      return {
        count: auditIssuesCount,
        isUrgent: true,
        headline: `Аудитор 1С нашел замечаний: ${auditIssuesCount}`,
        prompt: 'Почему у меня расхождение в ОСВ?',
      };
    }
    if (discrepancyCount > 0) {
      return {
        count: discrepancyCount,
        isUrgent: true,
        headline: `Найдено расхождений в вашей ОСВ: ${discrepancyCount}`,
        prompt: 'Почему у меня расхождение в ОСВ?',
      };
    }
    if (redAccountsCount > 0) {
      return {
        count: redAccountsCount,
        isUrgent: true,
        headline: `«Краснота» на ${redAccountsCount} сч. в ОСВ`,
        prompt: 'Почему возникла краснота (отрицательное сальдо) в ОСВ и как исправить?',
      };
    }
    if (activeOperation?.status === 'needs_data') {
      return {
        count: 1,
        isUrgent: true,
        headline: `Оп. №${activeOperation.number} ждет остатков из 1С`,
        prompt: 'Откуда взять недостающую сумму по текущей операции в 1С?',
      };
    }
    const pitfallsCount = activeOperation?.pitfalls.length ?? 0;
    if (activeOperation && pitfallsCount > 0) {
      return {
        count: pitfallsCount,
        isUrgent: activeOperation.pitfalls.some((p) => p.severity === 'critical'),
        headline: `Оп. №${activeOperation.number}: ${activeOperation.pitfalls[0].title}`,
        prompt: 'Разбери проводки и НДС по текущей операции',
      };
    }
    return {
      count: 0,
      isUrgent: false,
      headline: '',
      prompt: '',
    };
  }, [auditIssuesCount, discrepancyCount, redAccountsCount, activeOperation]);

  const contextSignature = `${activeOperation?.id ?? 'none'}:${activeOperation?.status ?? ''}:${discrepancyCount}:${redAccountsCount}:${auditIssuesCount}`;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (drawerOpen) {
      setSeenContextSignature(contextSignature);
    }
  }, [drawerOpen, contextSignature]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!drawerOpen) return;
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        setDrawerOpen(false);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }, [drawerOpen, setDrawerOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (drawerOpen) {
      messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  }, [chatMessages, isLoading, drawerOpen]);

  const unreadTipsCount =
    seenContextSignature === contextSignature ? 0 : contextualTipSummary.count;

  const providerLabel = useMemo(() => {
    if (aiConfig.provider === 'gemini' && aiConfig.apiKey.trim()) {
      return 'Gemini';
    }
    if (aiConfig.provider === 'openai-compatible' && aiConfig.apiKey.trim()) {
      return 'OpenAI';
    }
    return 'Эксперт 1С';
  }, [aiConfig]);

  const sendQuestion = async (rawQuestion: string) => {
    const question = rawQuestion.trim();
    if (!question || isLoading) return;

    const currentOpNumber = activeOperation?.number;
    addChatMessage({
      role: 'user',
      content: question,
      relatedOperationNumber: currentOpNumber,
    });
    setInput('');
    setIsLoading(true);

    try {
      const nextMessagesPayload = [
        ...chatMessages.slice(-12).map((m) => ({
          id: m.id,
          role: m.role,
          content: m.content,
          timestamp: m.timestamp,
        })),
        {
          id: `user-${Date.now()}`,
          role: 'user' as const,
          content: question,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
      ];

      const contextPayload = {
        organization: effectiveOrganization,
        openingBalances,
        activeOperation,
        operationsSummary: operations.map((op) => ({
          id: op.id,
          number: op.number,
          date: op.date,
          rawDescription: op.rawDescription,
          resolvedAmount: op.resolvedAmount,
          status: op.status,
          documentType1C: op.documentType1C,
          isMonthEndClosing: op.isMonthEndClosing,
        })),
        osvSummary: {
          totalStartDebit: osvReport.totalStartDebit,
          totalStartCredit: osvReport.totalStartCredit,
          totalTurnoverDebit: osvReport.totalTurnoverDebit,
          totalTurnoverCredit: osvReport.totalTurnoverCredit,
          totalEndDebit: osvReport.totalEndDebit,
          totalEndCredit: osvReport.totalEndCredit,
          rows: osvReport.rows.filter((r) => !r.isGroup),
        },
        discrepancies: reconciliation.diagnostics,
      };

      const resp = await fetch('/api/chat', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          messages: nextMessagesPayload,
          context: contextPayload,
          aiConfig,
        }),
      });

      const data = (await resp.json()) as {
        success?: boolean;
        reply?: string;
        error?: string;
      };

      const replyText =
        data.reply?.trim() ||
        'Не удалось получить ответ помощника. Попробуйте повторить запрос.';

      addChatMessage({
        role: 'assistant',
        content: replyText,
        relatedOperationNumber: currentOpNumber,
      });
    } catch {
      addChatMessage({
        role: 'assistant',
        content:
          'Произошла сетевая ошибка при обращении к модулю «Личный бухгалтер». Проверьте соединение или повторите вопрос.',
        relatedOperationNumber: currentOpNumber,
      });
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      void sendQuestion(input);
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      {/* Compact Linear Bottom-Right Trigger Button (rounded-md, 1px solid) */}
      {!drawerOpen && (
        <div className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-40">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setDrawerOpen(true)}
            title={
              contextualTipSummary.headline ||
              'Открыть помощник «Личный бухгалтер 1С 8.3»'
            }
            className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-md border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900 px-3.5 text-xs font-medium text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200"
          >
            <Bot className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
            <span>Личный бухгалтер</span>

            {unreadTipsCount > 0 && (
              <span
                className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold tabular-nums ${
                  contextualTipSummary.isUrgent
                    ? 'bg-red-600 text-white'
                    : 'bg-amber-600 text-white'
                }`}
              >
                <Lightbulb className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
                <span>{unreadTipsCount}</span>
              </span>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Right-Side Linear Slide-Over Drawer */}
      {drawerOpen && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex justify-end bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm"
          onClick={() => setDrawerOpen(false)}
        >
          <aside
            className="relative z-10 flex h-full w-full max-w-md flex-col border-l border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-[#111113]"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="border-b border-zinc-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-[#111113]">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                  <div className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900">
                    <Bot className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <h2 className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 sm:text-sm">
                        Личный бухгалтер
                      </h2>
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded border border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-emerald-800 dark:border-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-300">
                        <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-[1px] bg-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-400" />
                        1С 8.3
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                      Контекстный помощник по проводкам и ОСВ
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  {onOpenAiSettings && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setDrawerOpen(false);
                        onOpenAiSettings();
                      }}
                      title="Настройки ИИ-провайдера"
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-700 transition hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
                    >
                      <Settings2 className="h-3 w-3" />
                      <span>{providerLabel}</span>
                    </button>
                  )}

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={clearChatMessages}
                    title="Очистить диалог"
                    className="rounded-md p-1.5 text-zinc-400 transition hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
                  >
                    <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setDrawerOpen(false)}
                    title="Закрыть панель (Esc)"
                    className="rounded-md p-1.5 text-zinc-500 transition hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"

                    <X className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Live Context Strip */}
              <div className="mt-2.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                {activeOperation && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setActiveTab('navigator');
                      setDrawerOpen(false);
                    }}
                    title={activeOperation.rawDescription}
                    className="inline-flex max-w-full items-center gap-1.5 truncate rounded border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 transition hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"

              }}
              className="border-t border-zinc-200 bg-white p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-[#111113]"
            >
              <div className="flex items-end gap-2">
                <textarea
                  rows={2}

                />
                <button
                  type="submit"

                  className="flex h-[40px] w-[40px] shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-zinc-900 text-white transition hover:bg-zinc-800 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200"
                >
                  {isLoading ? (
                    <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                  ) : (
                    <Send className="h-4 w-4" />
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </aside>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

export function AiSettingsModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
}: {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const { aiConfig, updateAiConfig } = useAccountant();

  const [provider, setProvider] = useState<AiProviderConfig['provider']>(aiConfig.provider);
  const [apiKey, setApiKey] = useState(aiConfig.apiKey);
  const [baseUrl, setBaseUrl] = useState(aiConfig.baseUrl || 'https://api.openai.com/v1');
  const [model, setModel] = useState(aiConfig.model || 'gemini-2.0-flash');
  const [showKey, setShowKey] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setProvider(aiConfig.provider);
      setApiKey(aiConfig.apiKey || '');
      setBaseUrl(aiConfig.baseUrl || 'https://api.openai.com/v1');
      setModel(aiConfig.model || 'gemini-2.0-flash');
    }
  }, [isOpen, aiConfig]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleProviderSelect = (next: AiProviderConfig['provider']) => {
    setProvider(next);
    if (next === 'gemini' && (!model || model.startsWith('gpt-'))) {
      setModel('gemini-2.0-flash');
    } else if (next === 'openai-compatible' && (!model || model.startsWith('gemini'))) {
      setModel('gpt-4o-mini');
    }
  };

  const handleSave = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    updateAiConfig({
      provider,
      apiKey: apiKey.trim(),
      baseUrl: baseUrl.trim() || 'https://api.openai.com/v1',
      model:
        model.trim() ||
        (provider === 'openai-compatible' ? 'gpt-4o-mini' : 'gemini-2.0-flash'),
    });
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60">
      <div className="w-full max-w-xl rounded-md bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 overflow-hidden">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-4 py-3 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300" />
            <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
              Настройки ИИ и Vision OCR

            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1 rounded text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-200/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"

            <X className="w-4 h-4" />

        <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="p-4 space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
              Режим работы
            </label>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleProviderSelect('demo-local')}
                className={`text-left p-3 rounded-md border transition-colors ${
                  provider === 'demo-local'
                    ? 'border-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-200 bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-zinc-900'
                    : 'border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900/50'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                    <Cpu className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Локальный движок 1С 8.3 (без API-ключа)
                  </div>
                  {provider === 'demo-local' && (
                    <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-medium bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900">
                      Активен
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                  Разбор текста, Excel/CSV, выгрузок ОСВ из 1С и экспертный чат работают офлайн.
                </p>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleProviderSelect('gemini')}
                className={`text-left p-3 rounded-md border transition-colors ${
                  provider === 'gemini'
                    ? 'border-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-200 bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-zinc-900'

                    Base URL

          </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
            >
              Отмена
            </button>

              type="submit"
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200 text-white dark:text-zinc-900"
            >
              <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              Сохранить
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  ShieldAlert,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useAccountant } from '@/context/AccountantContext';
import { AuditIssue, AuditIssueCategory } from '@/types/accounting';

type FilterCategory = 'all' | AuditIssueCategory;

const CATEGORY_META: Record<
  FilterCategory,
  { label: string; shortLabel: string }
> = {
  all: { label: 'Все', shortLabel: 'Все' },
  advance_unoffset: { label: 'Авансы 60/62', shortLabel: 'Авансы 60/62' },
  missing_sf_upd: { label: 'Счета-фактуры / 19', shortLabel: 'СФ / 19' },
  incomplete_requisites: { label: 'Неполные реквизиты', shortLabel: 'Реквизиты' },
  unclosed_month: { label: 'Закрытие месяца', shortLabel: 'Закрытие мес.' },
  posting_mismatch: { label: 'Суммы и счета', shortLabel: 'Суммы и счета' },
  missing_operation: { label: 'Пропущенные операции', shortLabel: 'Пропущенные' },
};

const CATEGORY_ORDER: FilterCategory[] = [
  'all',
  'advance_unoffset',
  'missing_sf_upd',
  'incomplete_requisites',
  'unclosed_month',
  'posting_mismatch',
  'missing_operation',
];

function formatMoneyMono(val: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (val === null || val === undefined || !Number.isFinite(val)) return '—';
  const sign = val < -0.004 ? '−' : '';
  return `${sign}${Math.abs(val).toLocaleString('ru-RU', {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })} ₽`;
}

function formatDeltaMono(diff: number): string {
  if (Math.abs(diff) < 0.005) return '0,00 ₽';
  const sign = diff > 0 ? '+' : '−';
  return `${sign}${Math.abs(diff).toLocaleString('ru-RU', {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })} ₽`;
}

function formatSyncTimestamp(iso?: string): string {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  const dt = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(dt.getTime())) return iso;
  return dt.toLocaleTimeString('ru-RU', {
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    second: '2-digit',
  });
}

function getSourceLabel(source?: string): string {
  switch (source) {
    case 'http-post':
      return 'POST /api/1c-sync';
    case 'downloads-file':
      return 'Downloads/1c_export.json';
    case 'file-upload':
      return 'Импорт файла 1С';
    case 'demo-simulation':
      return 'Тестовый снимок 1С';
    default:
      return '1С 8.3';
  }
}

function getSeverityMeta(severity: AuditIssue['severity']) {
  switch (severity) {
    case 'critical':
      return {
        label: 'Критично',
        icon: AlertOctagon,
        badgeClass:
          'border-red-300 bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:border-red-900/80 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-300',
        borderLeftClass: 'border-l-2 border-l-red-600 dark:border-l-red-500',
      };
    case 'warning':
      return {
        label: 'Внимание',
        icon: AlertTriangle,
        badgeClass:
          'border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 dark:border-amber-900/80 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-300',
        borderLeftClass: 'border-l-2 border-l-amber-600 dark:border-l-amber-500',
      };
    default:
      return {
        label: 'Проверка',
        icon: Info,
        badgeClass:
          'border-zinc-300 bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300',
        borderLeftClass: 'border-l-2 border-l-zinc-400 dark:border-l-zinc-600',
      };
  }
}

export function AuditErrorsTab() {

    auditReport,
    synced1C,
    isSyncing1C,
    refreshFrom1CSync,
    simulate1CSyncWithSampleErrors,
    clear1CSyncSnapshot,
    selectOperationAndNavigate,
    setActiveTab,
  } = useAccountant();

  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<FilterCategory>('all');
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [syncFeedback, setSyncFeedback] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleCopy = (key: string, value: string) => {
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard) {
      void navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
    }
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setCopiedKey((prev) => (prev === key ? null : prev));
    }, 1600);
  };

  const handleRefreshSync = async () => {
    setSyncFeedback(null);
    const updated = await refreshFrom1CSync();
    setSyncFeedback(
      updated
        ? 'Снимок 1С успешно обновлен.'
        : synced1C
          ? 'Новых изменений в выгрузке 1С не обнаружено.'
          : 'Активный снимок 1С пока не найден (ожидается POST /api/1c-sync или 1c_export.json).'
    );
  };

  const handleSimulateErrors = async () => {
    setSyncFeedback(null);
    await simulate1CSyncWithSampleErrors();
    setSelectedCategory('all');
    setSyncFeedback('Загружен тестовый снимок 1С с типовыми ошибками по всем 6 категориям.');

  const visibleIssues = useMemo<AuditIssue[]>(() => {
    if (selectedCategory === 'all') {

                  <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-[1px] bg-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-400" />

                              <span className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 tabular-nums dark:text-zinc-100">
                                {gap.expectedValue}
                              </span>
                            </div>

                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleCopy(copyId, gap.expectedValue)}
                              className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 transition hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
                            >
                              {isCopied ? (

                                  <Check className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />

                                </>
                              ) : (
                                <>
                                  <ClipboardCopy className="h-3 w-3" />

                    {issue.howToFixIn1C}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </article>

export type Database1CSubTab = 'org' | 'documents' | 'directories' | 'balances';

const SECTION_ORDER = [
  'Банк и касса',
  'Покупки',
  'Продажи',
  'Зарплата и кадры',
  'Операции',
];

function formatMoney(val: number | undefined | null): string {
  if (val === undefined || val === null || !Number.isFinite(val)) return '—';
  const sign = val < -0.004 ? '−' : '';
  return `${sign}${Math.abs(roundMoney(val)).toLocaleString('ru-RU', {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })} ₽`;
}

function formatSyncTime(iso?: string): string {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return iso;
  return d.toLocaleTimeString('ru-RU', {
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    second: '2-digit',
  });
}

function CopyValueButton({
  value,
  copyKey,
  copiedKey,
  onCopy,
  label = 'Скопировать',
}: {
  value: string;
  copyKey: string;
  copiedKey: string | null;
  onCopy: (key: string, val: string) => void;
  label?: string;
}) {
  if (!value || value === '—') return null;
  const isCopied = copiedKey === copyKey;
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={() => onCopy(copyKey, value)}
      className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-700 transition hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
    >
      {isCopied ? (
        <>
          <Check className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
          <span className="text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">Скопировано</span>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <ClipboardCopy className="h-3 w-3 text-zinc-400" />
          <span>{label}</span>
        </>
      )}
    </button>
  );
}
