          {item.nomenclatureGroup && (
            <CopyableFieldRow
              label="Номенклатурная группа (субконто 20 / 90)"
              value={item.nomenclatureGroup}
              copiedId={copiedId}
              fieldKey={`${item.id}-ng`}
              onCopy={handleCopy}
            />
          )}
          {item.expenseItem && (
            <CopyableFieldRow
              label="Статья затрат"
              value={item.expenseItem}
              copiedId={copiedId}
              fieldKey={`${item.id}-exp`}
              onCopy={handleCopy}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-4">
      {/* Top «Реквизит-контроль» Strip */}
      <div className="rounded-md bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 p-4 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                Реквизит-контроль и Справочники 1С
              </span>
              {requisiteReport.incompleteCount > 0 ? (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-mono tabular-nums font-semibold bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/50 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800">
                  <ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Требует дозаполнения в 1С: {requisiteReport.incompleteCount} карт.
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-mono tabular-nums font-medium bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800">
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Эталонные карточки полные ({1 + requisiteReport.counterpartyChecks.length} проверено)
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
              Проверка обязательных полей нашей организации (8 полей) и всех контрагентов задачи (Наименование, ИНН, КПП, р/сч, БИК, Банк, Договор + вид договора).
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => void refreshFrom1CSync()}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-white hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#111113] dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 transition-colors"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Сверить с 1С</span>
            </button>

            {!synced1C && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => void simulate1CSyncWithSampleErrors()}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-[#FAFAFA] hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-[#09090B] dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 transition-colors"
              >
                <span>Тест: незаполненные реквизиты 1С</span>
              </button>
            )}

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('navigator')}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200 text-white dark:text-zinc-900 transition-colors"
            >
              <span>К пошаговому вводу операций →</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Summary Chips for Organization + All 5 Counterparties */}
        <div className="pt-2 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
          {[requisiteReport.organizationCheck, ...requisiteReport.counterpartyChecks].map(
            (chk) => {
              const bad = chk.status !== 'complete';
              return (
                <button
                  key={chk.entityId}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() =>
                    setSection(
                      chk.entityType === 'organization' ? 'organization' : 'counterparties'
                    )
                  }
                  className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs border transition-colors ${
                    bad
                      ? 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200 border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800 font-semibold'
                      : 'bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span
                    className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded ${
                      bad ? 'bg-rose-600' : 'bg-emerald-500'
                    }`}
                  />
                  <span>{chk.name}</span>
                  <span className="font-mono tabular-nums text-[11px] opacity-80">
                    {chk.filledCount}/{chk.totalRequired}
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            }
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Sub-navigation Tabs + Add Custom Item Button */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="inline-flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 p-1 rounded-md bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setSection('counterparties');
              setShowAddForm(false);
            }}
            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
              section === 'counterparties'
                ? 'bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 shadow-sm'
                : 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
            }`}
          >
            <Briefcase className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Контрагенты и договоры</span>
            <span className="font-mono tabular-nums text-[11px] opacity-75">
              {createdCpCount}/{directories.counterparties.length}
            </span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setSection('organization');
              setShowAddForm(false);
            }}
            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
              section === 'organization'
                ? 'bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 shadow-sm'
                : 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
            }`}
          >
            <Building2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Наша организация</span>
            {requisiteReport.organizationCheck.status !== 'complete' && (
              <span className="px-1 rounded bg-rose-600 text-white text-[10px] font-mono">
                !
              </span>
            )}
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setSection('nomenclature');
              setShowAddForm(false);
            }}
            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
              section === 'nomenclature'
                ? 'bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 shadow-sm'
                : 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
            }`}
          >
            <Package className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Номенклатура и НГ</span>
            <span className="font-mono tabular-nums text-[11px] opacity-75">
              {createdNomCount}/{directories.nomenclature.length}
            </span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setSection('employees');
              setShowAddForm(false);
            }}
            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
              section === 'employees'
                ? 'bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 shadow-sm'
                : 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
            }`}
          >
            <Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Сотрудники и Кадры</span>
            <span className="font-mono tabular-nums text-[11px] opacity-75">
              {createdEmpCount}/{directories.employees.length}
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {section !== 'organization' && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowAddForm((prev) => !prev)}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-white hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#111113] dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 transition-colors"
          >
            {showAddForm ? <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
            <span>{showAddForm ? 'Отмена' : 'Добавить карточку'}</span>
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Inline Add Custom Item Forms */}
      {showAddForm && section === 'counterparties' && (
        <form
          onSubmit={handleAddCounterpartySubmit}
          className="rounded-md bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 p-4 space-y-3"
        >
          <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
            Новый контрагент (Справочники → Контрагенты)
          </h3>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
            <input
              required
              value={cpName}
              onChange={(e) => setCpName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder='Наименование (ООО "Вектор")'
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            />
            <input
              value={cpInn}
              onChange={(e) => setCpInn(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="ИНН (10 или 12 цифр)"
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-mono tabular-nums bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            />
            <input
              value={cpKpp}
              onChange={(e) => setCpKpp(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="КПП (9 цифр)"
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-mono tabular-nums bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            />
            <input
              value={cpBankAcc}
              onChange={(e) => setCpBankAcc(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Расчетный счет (20 цифр)"
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-mono tabular-nums bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            />
            <input
              value={cpBik}
              onChange={(e) => setCpBik(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="БИК банка"
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-mono tabular-nums bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            />
            <input
              value={cpBankName}
              onChange={(e) => setCpBankName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Наименование банка"
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            />
            <select
              value={cpContractKind}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setCpContractKind(e.target.value as CounterpartyCard1C['contractKind'])
              }
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            >
              <option value="С поставщиком">Вид договора: С поставщиком</option>
              <option value="С покупателем">Вид договора: С покупателем</option>
              <option value="Прочее">Вид договора: Прочее</option>
            </select>
            <input
              value={cpContractNum}
              onChange={(e) => setCpContractNum(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Номер договора (№ 177)"
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-mono tabular-nums bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            />
            <input
              value={cpContractDate}
              onChange={(e) => setCpContractDate(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Дата договора (01.04.2026)"
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-mono tabular-nums bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-end">
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200 text-white dark:text-zinc-900"
            >
              Сохранить карточку
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}

      {showAddForm && section === 'nomenclature' && (
        <form
          onSubmit={handleAddNomenclatureSubmit}
          className="rounded-md bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 p-4 space-y-3"
        >
          <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
            Новая позиция номенклатуры
          </h3>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
            <input
              required
              value={nomName}
              onChange={(e) => setNomName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Наименование"
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            />
            <select
              value={nomKind}
              onChange={(e) => {
                const nextKind = e.target.value as NomenclatureCard1C['kind'];
                setNomKind(nextKind);
                if (nextKind === 'Товары') {
                  setNomAccount('41.01');
                  setNomVatAccount('19.03');
                } else if (nextKind === 'Материалы') {
                  setNomAccount('10.01');
                  setNomVatAccount('19.03');
                } else {
                  setNomAccount('20.01');
                  setNomVatAccount('19.04');
                }
              }}
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            >
              <option value="Товары">Товары (41.01)</option>
              <option value="Материалы">Материалы (10.01)</option>
              <option value="Услуги / Субподрядные работы">
                Услуги / Субподрядные работы (20.01, 26)
              </option>
              <option value="Продукция / СМР">Продукция / СМР</option>
            </select>
            <input
              value={nomUnit}
              onChange={(e) => setNomUnit(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Ед. изм."
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            />
            <input
              value={nomAccount}
              onChange={(e) => setNomAccount(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Счет учета"
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-mono tabular-nums bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            />
            <input
              value={nomGroup}
              onChange={(e) => setNomGroup(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Номенклатурная группа"
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            />
            <input
              type="number"
              value={nomVatRate}
              onChange={(e) => setNomVatRate(Number(e.target.value) || 0)}
              placeholder="Ставка НДС (%)"
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-mono tabular-nums bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-end">
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200 text-white dark:text-zinc-900"
            >
              Добавить позицию
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}

      {showAddForm && section === 'employees' && (
        <form
          onSubmit={handleAddEmployeeSubmit}
          className="rounded-md bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 p-4 space-y-3"
        >
          <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
            Новый сотрудник
          </h3>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
            <input
              required
              value={empFullName}
              onChange={(e) => setEmpFullName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="ФИО сотрудника"
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            />
            <input
              value={empPosition}
              onChange={(e) => setEmpPosition(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Должность"
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            />
            <input
              value={empDept}
              onChange={(e) => setEmpDept(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Подразделение"
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            />
            <input
              type="number"
              value={empSalary}
              onChange={(e) => setEmpSalary(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Оклад, ₽"
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-mono tabular-nums bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            />
            <input
              value={empHireDate}
              onChange={(e) => setEmpHireDate(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Дата приема (05.04.2026)"
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-mono tabular-nums bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            />
            <select
              value={empCostAcc}
              onChange={(e) => setEmpCostAcc(e.target.value)}
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            >
              <option value="26">Счет затрат: 26 (АУП)</option>
              <option value="20.01">Счет затрат: 20.01 (Производство)</option>
              <option value="44.01">Счет затрат: 44.01 (Торговля)</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-end">
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200 text-white dark:text-zinc-900"
            >
              Добавить сотрудника
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}

      {/* SECTION 1: COUNTERPARTIES WITH REQUISITE CONTROL */}
      {section === 'counterparties' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3">
          {directories.counterparties.map((cp) => {
            const isCreated = Boolean(cp.createdIn1C);
            const reqCheck =
              cpCheckMap.get(cp.id) ||
              (cp.inn ? cpCheckMap.get(`inn:${cp.inn}`) : undefined) ||
              cpCheckMap.get(`name:${cp.name.toLowerCase()}`);
            const hasGap = reqCheck && reqCheck.status !== 'complete';

            return (
              <div
                key={cp.id}
                className={`rounded-md bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] border p-4 space-y-3 ${
                  hasGap
                    ? 'border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800'
                    : 'border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-medium bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                        {cp.contractKind}
                      </span>
                      <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                        {cp.name}
                      </h3>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
                      {cp.fullName}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => toggleDirectoryItemCreated(cp.id)}
                    className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium border transition-colors ${
                      isCreated
                        ? 'bg-zinc-900 text-white border-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900'
                        : 'bg-white hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#111113] dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {isCreated ? (
                      <CheckSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    ) : (
                      <Square className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    )}
                    <span>Заведено в 1С</span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Requisite Completeness Checklist */}
                {reqCheck && (
                  <RequisiteGapAlert
                    check={reqCheck}
                    copiedId={copiedId}
                    onCopy={handleCopy}
                  />
                )}

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                  <CopyableFieldRow
                    label="Наименование"
                    value={cp.name}
                    copiedId={copiedId}
                    fieldKey={`${cp.id}-name`}
                    onCopy={handleCopy}
                  />
                  <CopyableFieldRow
                    label="ИНН"
                    value={cp.inn}
                    mono
                    copiedId={copiedId}
                    fieldKey={`${cp.id}-inn`}
                    onCopy={handleCopy}
                  />
                  <CopyableFieldRow
                    label="КПП"
                    value={cp.kpp}
                    mono
                    copiedId={copiedId}
                    fieldKey={`${cp.id}-kpp`}
                    onCopy={handleCopy}
                  />

function formatRub(amount: number): string {
  return (
    new Intl.NumberFormat('ru-RU', {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    }).format(amount) + ' ₽'
  );
}

function roundMoney(val: number): number {
  return Math.round((val + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100;
}

export function Import1CDataPanel({
  compact = false,
  onApplied,
}: {
  compact?: boolean;
  onApplied?: () => void;
}) {
  const {
    rawOperations,
    organization,
    openingBalances,
    applyImported1CData,
    clearOpeningBalances,
  } = useAccountant();

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [appliedSuccessMsg, setAppliedSuccessMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<Parsed1CImportResult | null>(null);
  const [editableBalances, setEditableBalances] = useState<OpeningBalanceEntry[]>([]);
  const [mergeMode, setMergeMode] = useState<'replace' | 'merge'>('replace');

  const handleFilesSelected = async (fileList: FileList | File[]) => {
    const files = Array.from(fileList);
    if (files.length === 0) return;

    setIsLoading(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    setAppliedSuccessMsg(null);

    try {
      const result = await parse1CExportFiles(files, rawOperations, organization);
      if (
        result.openingBalances.length === 0 &&
        !result.organizationPatch &&
        result.counterparties.length === 0
      ) {
        setErrorMsg(
          result.warnings[0] ||
            'Не удалось обнаружить счета ОСВ, реквизиты организации или контрагентов в выбранных файлах 1С.'
        );
        setPreview(null);
      } else {
        setPreview(result);
        setEditableBalances(result.openingBalances);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorMsg(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : 'Ошибка при чтении файлов выгрузки 1С:Бухгалтерия 8.3.'
      );
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleTestSampleImport = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    setAppliedSuccessMsg(null);

    try {
      const result = await loadSample1CQ1Preview(rawOperations, organization);
      setPreview(result);
      setEditableBalances(result.openingBalances);
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorMsg(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Не удалось сформировать тестовую выгрузку 1С.'
      );
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadSampleXlsx = () => {
    try {
      const { buffer, filename } = generateSample1CQ1Workbook();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], {
        type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
      });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = filename;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorMsg(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Ошибка скачивания примера файла ОСВ 1С.'
      );
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateBalanceRow = (
    idx: number,
    patch: Partial<OpeningBalanceEntry>
  ) => {
    setEditableBalances((prev) =>
      prev.map((row, i) => (i === idx ? { ...row, ...patch } : row))
    );
  };

  const handleApplyToTask = () => {
    if (!preview) return;

    applyImported1CData({
      openingBalances: editableBalances,
      mergeMode,
      organizationPatch: preview.organizationPatch,
      counterparties: preview.counterparties,
      employees: preview.employees,
    });

    const accCount = new Set(editableBalances.map((b) => b.accountCode)).size;
    setAppliedSuccessMsg(
      `Перенесено счетов: ${accCount}, контрагентов: ${preview.counterpartiesAndContractsCount}, автоматически рассчитано операций: ${preview.autoFilledOperationsCount}.`
    );
    setPreview(null);
    if (onApplied) {
      onApplied();
    }
  };

  const orgPatchEntries = preview?.organizationPatch
    ? Object.entries(preview.organizationPatch).filter(
        ([, val]) => val !== undefined && val !== ''
      )
    : [];

  return (
    <div className="rounded-md bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 p-4 space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <Database className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
              Импорт данных из 1С:Бухгалтерия 8.3 за закрытый 1 квартал
            </h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
              Поддерживаются: общая ОСВ (`.xlsx`, `.xls`, `.csv`), ОСВ по счетам 60, 62, 68, 69, 70 с договорами, XML (`EnterpriseData`) и Клиент-Банк (`1c_to_kl.txt`)
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {openingBalances.length > 0 && !preview && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              clearOpeningBalances();
              setAppliedSuccessMsg(null);
            }}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 hover:text-rose-700 bg-[#FAFAFA] hover:bg-rose-50 dark:bg-[#09090B] dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/30 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 transition-colors"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Очистить остатки</span>
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {appliedSuccessMsg && (
        <div className="p-3 rounded-md bg-emerald-50/70 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
          <span>Данные из 1С применены: {appliedSuccessMsg}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {!preview && (
        <div
          onDragOver={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
          onDrop={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (e.dataTransfer.files && e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
              void handleFilesSelected(e.dataTransfer.files);
            }
          }}
          className={`border border-dashed border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 rounded-md ${
            compact ? 'p-4' : 'p-5'
          } text-center bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] space-y-3`}
        >
          <div className="flex justify-center">
            {isLoading ? (
              <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin text-zinc-600" />
            ) : (
              <Upload className="w-5 h-5 text-zinc-500" />
            )}
          </div>

          <div>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
              Перетащите сюда файлы выгрузки из 1С 8.3 (ОСВ за 1 кв. + ОСВ по счетам 60, 68, 70)
            </p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
              Конечное сальдо на 31.03 переносится как входящее на 01.04 без задвоения субсчетов
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 pt-1">
            <label className="cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200 text-white dark:text-zinc-900 transition-colors">
              <FileSpreadsheet className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Выбрать файлы 1С (.xlsx, .csv, .xml, .txt, .json)</span>
              <input
                type="file"
                multiple
                accept=".xlsx,.xls,.csv,.xml,.txt,.json"
                className="hidden"
                onChange={(e) => {
                  if (e.target.files && e.target.files.length > 0) {
                    void handleFilesSelected(e.target.files);
                  }
                }}
              />
            </label>

            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={isLoading}
              onClick={handleTestSampleImport}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-white hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#111113] dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 transition-colors"
            >
              <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600" />
              <span>Проверить на тестовой выгрузке 1С за 1 кв. (.xlsx)</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleDownloadSampleXlsx}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-white hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#111113] dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 transition-colors"
            >
              <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Скачать пример ОСВ 1 кв. (.xlsx)</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {errorMsg && (
        <div className="p-3 rounded-md bg-rose-50/70 dark:bg-rose-950/30 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800 flex items-start gap-2 text-xs text-rose-900 dark:text-rose-200">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <span>{errorMsg}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Preview Screen After Upload */}
      {preview && (
        <div className="space-y-4 pt-1">
          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-md bg-emerald-50/60 dark:bg-emerald-950/25 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800 space-y-2">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-200 font-mono tabular-nums">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                <span>
                  Распознано счетов: {new Set(editableBalances.map((b) => b.accountCode)).size}, контрагентов и договоров:{' '}
                  {preview.counterpartiesAndContractsCount}, автоматически заполнено пустых сумм в задаче:{' '}
                  {preview.autoFilledOperationsCount}
                </span>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPreview(null)}
                className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:underline"
              >
                ← Загрузить другие файлы
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px]">
              {preview.detectedFormats.map((fmt: string, i: number) => (
                <span
                  key={i}
                  className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-medium bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
                >
                  {fmt}
                </span>
              ))}
              {preview.periodLabel && (
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-mono tabular-nums bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                  {preview.periodLabel}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {preview.autoFilledOperations.length > 0 && (
            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-md bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 space-y-2">
              <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                Автоматически заполнены пустые суммы в операциях задачи:
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                {preview.autoFilledOperations.map((item: Parsed1CAutoFillItem) => (
                  <div
                    key={item.operationId}
                    className="p-2.5 rounded-md bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 space-y-1"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5">
                      <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[10px] font-mono tabular-nums font-semibold bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900">
                        Оп. №{item.operationNumber}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-mono tabular-nums font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                        {formatRub(item.resolvedAmount)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 line-clamp-1">
                      {item.description}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-mono tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                      {item.explanation}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {orgPatchEntries.length > 0 && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-md bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 space-y-1">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
                <Building2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Распознаны реквизиты организации:</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs font-mono tabular-nums text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                {preview.organizationPatch?.shortName && (
                  <span>{preview.organizationPatch.shortName}</span>
                )}
                {preview.organizationPatch?.inn && (
                  <span>ИНН {preview.organizationPatch.inn}</span>
                )}
                {preview.organizationPatch?.kpp && (
                  <span>КПП {preview.organizationPatch.kpp}</span>
                )}
                {preview.organizationPatch?.bankAccount && (
                  <span>р/сч {preview.organizationPatch.bankAccount}</span>
                )}
                {preview.organizationPatch?.bik && (
                  <span>БИК {preview.organizationPatch.bik}</span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {preview.warnings.length > 0 && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-md bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 space-y-0.5">
              {preview.warnings.map((w: string, idx: number) => (
                <div key={idx}>• {w}</div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {editableBalances.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
                  Входящие остатки на 01.04 (можно скорректировать перед применением):
                </span>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs">
                  <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer">
                    <input
                      type="radio"
                      name="mergeMode1c"
                      checked={mergeMode === 'replace'}
                      onChange={() => setMergeMode('replace')}
                    />
                    <span>Заменить остатки</span>
                  </label>
                  <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer">
                    <input
                      type="radio"
                      name="mergeMode1c"
                      checked={mergeMode === 'merge'}
                      onChange={() => setMergeMode('merge')}
                    />
                    <span>Дополнить текущие</span>
                  </label>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="max-h-72 overflow-auto rounded-md border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                  <thead className="sticky top-0 bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="py-2 px-2.5 font-semibold w-24">Счет</th>
                      <th className="py-2 px-2.5 font-semibold">Субконто 1</th>
                      <th className="py-2 px-2.5 font-semibold">Субконто 2</th>
                      <th className="py-2 px-2.5 font-semibold text-right w-32">Сальдо Дт, ₽</th>
                      <th className="py-2 px-2.5 font-semibold text-right w-32">Сальдо Кт, ₽</th>
                      <th className="py-2 px-2 font-semibold w-9" />
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-200 dark:divide-zinc-800">
                    {editableBalances.map((row, idx) => (
                      <tr key={row.id || idx} className="bg-white dark:bg-[#111113]">
                        <td className="py-1.5 px-2">
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            value={row.accountCode}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              handleUpdateBalanceRow(idx, { accountCode: e.target.value })
                            }
                            className="w-full px-2 py-1 rounded font-mono tabular-nums font-semibold text-xs bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
                          />
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-1.5 px-2">
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            value={row.subconto1 || ''}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              handleUpdateBalanceRow(idx, { subconto1: e.target.value })
                            }
                            placeholder="—"
                            className="w-full px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
                          />
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-1.5 px-2">
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            value={row.subconto2 || ''}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              handleUpdateBalanceRow(idx, { subconto2: e.target.value })
                            }
                            placeholder="—"
                            className="w-full px-2 py-1 rounded font-mono tabular-nums text-xs bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
                          />
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-1.5 px-2 text-right">
                          <input
                            type="number"
                            step="0.01"
                            min="0"
                            value={row.debit || ''}
                            placeholder="0,00"
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              handleUpdateBalanceRow(idx, {
                                debit: roundMoney(Math.max(0, Number(e.target.value) || 0)),
                              })
                            }
                            className="w-full px-2 py-1 rounded font-mono tabular-nums font-semibold text-right text-xs bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
                          />
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-1.5 px-2 text-right">
                          <input
                            type="number"
                            step="0.01"
                            min="0"
                            value={row.credit || ''}
                            placeholder="0,00"
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              handleUpdateBalanceRow(idx, {
                                credit: roundMoney(Math.max(0, Number(e.target.value) || 0)),
                              })
                            }
                            className="w-full px-2 py-1 rounded font-mono tabular-nums font-semibold text-right text-xs bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
                          />
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-1.5 px-2 text-center">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() =>
                              setEditableBalances((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== idx))
                            }
                            className="p-1 rounded text-zinc-400 hover:text-rose-600"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setPreview(null)}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-md text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
            >
              Отмена
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleApplyToTask}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-5 py-2 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white transition-colors"
            >
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Применить данные из 1С к задаче</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

7 | 22.04.2026 | Реализованы оконные блоки 133 шт по 10300 за шт в ООО "СП-171". | 1 369 900
8 | 24.04.2026 | Получена оплата за оконные блоки от ООО "СП-171" (ИНН 7810192328, КПП 781401001). | 1 369 900
9 | 25.04.2026 | ООО "Управление" выполнило субподрядные строительно-монтажные работы по ремонту кровли на объекте "Ремонт кровли с установкой кирпичной трубы". На основании счета, акта и счет-фактуры произведена оплата. | 2 352 000`;

function formatRub(amount: number): string {
  return (
    new Intl.NumberFormat('ru-RU', {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    }).format(amount) + ' ₽'
  );
}

export function ImportTaskModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onOpenAiSettings,
}: {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onOpenAiSettings: () => void;
}) {
  const {
    organization,
    openingBalances,
    aiConfig,
    demoScenarios,
    loadDemoScenario,
    importParsedTask,
    synced1C,
    isSyncing1C,
    refreshFrom1CSync,
  } = useAccountant();

  const [tab, setTab] = useState<ImportTab>('import1c');
  const [imageDataUrl, setImageDataUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [imageFileName, setImageFileName] = useState<string>('');
  const [excelFileName, setExcelFileName] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedSheetsInfo, setSelectedSheetsInfo] = useState<string>('');
  const [excelSheetRows, setExcelSheetRows] = useState<string[][]>([]);
  const [rawText, setRawText] = useState<string>('');

  const [isParsing, setIsParsing] = useState(false);
  const [parseError, setParseError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [requiresApiKeyError, setRequiresApiKeyError] = useState(false);

  const [parsedTitle, setParsedTitle] = useState<string>('');
  const [parsedOps, setParsedOps] = useState<BusinessOperation[] | null>(null);
  const [parsedDirs, setParsedDirs] = useState<Partial<ExtractedDirectories1C> | undefined>(
    undefined
  );
  const [parsedMode, setParsedMode] = useState<string>('');
  const [parsedWarnings, setParsedWarnings] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const readImageFile = useCallback((file: File) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => {
      if (typeof reader.result === 'string') {
        setImageDataUrl(reader.result);
        setImageFileName(file.name || 'Скриншот буфера обмена');
        setParseError(null);
      }
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handlePaste = (e: ClipboardEvent) => {
      const items = e.clipboardData?.items;
      if (!items) return;
      for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += 1) {
        const item = items[i];
        if (item.type.startsWith('image/')) {
          const file = item.getAsFile();
          if (file) {
            setTab('screenshot');
            readImageFile(file);
            e.preventDefault();
            return;
          }
        }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('paste', handlePaste);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('paste', handlePaste);
  }, [isOpen, readImageFile]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleExcelUpload = async (file: File) => {
    try {
      setParseError(null);
      setExcelFileName(file.name);
      const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const workbook = XLSX.read(buffer, { type: 'array' });

      // Filter out ОСВ, Остатки, Справочники, 1 квартал sheets
      const candidateSheets = workbook.SheetNames.filter(
        (name) => !SKIP_SHEET_NAME_RE.test(name.trim())
      );
      const skippedSheets = workbook.SheetNames.filter((name) =>
        SKIP_SHEET_NAME_RE.test(name.trim())
      );

      // Prefer explicit Q2 / April / Task sheets if present, otherwise use candidateSheets
      const preferredSheets = candidateSheets.filter((name) =>
        PREFER_Q2_SHEET_NAME_RE.test(name.trim())
      );
      const sheetsToRead =
        preferredSheets.length > 0
          ? preferredSheets
          : candidateSheets.length > 0
            ? candidateSheets
            : [workbook.SheetNames[0]];

      const allCleanRows: string[][] = [];
      const tsvBlocks: string[] = [];

      for (const sheetName of sheetsToRead) {
        const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[sheetName];
        if (!worksheet) continue;

        const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json<Array<string | number | null>>(worksheet, {
          header: 1,
          defval: '',
          raw: false,
        });

        // Keep column positions intact (including empty cells) so column headers
        // (№ п/п, Номер документа, Дата, Содержание, Сумма) align strictly!
        const nonEmptyRows = rows
          .map((r) =>
            r.map((cell) =>
              String(cell ?? '')
                .replace(/[\r\n\t]+/g, ' ')
                .trim()
            )
          )
          .filter((r) => r.some((cell) => cell.length > 0));

        if (nonEmptyRows.length > 0) {
          allCleanRows.push(...nonEmptyRows);
          tsvBlocks.push(nonEmptyRows.map((r) => r.join('\t')).join('\n'));
        }
      }

      const infoParts = [`Листы задания: ${sheetsToRead.join(', ')}`];
      if (skippedSheets.length > 0) {
        infoParts.push(`пропущены вспомогательные листы: ${skippedSheets.join(', ')}`);
      }
      setSelectedSheetsInfo(infoParts.join(' • '));
      setExcelSheetRows(allCleanRows.slice(0, 30));
      setRawText(tsvBlocks.join('\n'));
    } catch (err) {
      setParseError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? `Ошибка чтения файла Excel/CSV: ${err.message}`
          : 'Не удалось прочитать файл таблицы.'
      );
    }
  };

  const handleLoadBuiltInScreenshot = async () => {
    try {
      setParseError(null);
      const resp = await fetch('/demo-task-screenshot.jpg');
      if (!resp.ok) {
        setImageDataUrl('/demo-task-screenshot.jpg');
        setImageFileName('demo-task-screenshot.jpg');
        return;
      }
      const blob = await resp.blob();
      const file = new File([blob], 'demo-task-screenshot.jpg', {
        type: blob.type || 'image/jpeg',
      });
      readImageFile(file);
    } catch {
      setImageDataUrl('/demo-task-screenshot.jpg');
      setImageFileName('demo-task-screenshot.jpg');
    }
  };

  const handleRunParse = async () => {
    setIsParsing(true);
    setParseError(null);
    setRequiresApiKeyError(false);

    try {
      const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
        organization,
        openingBalances,
        aiConfig,
      };

      if (tab === 'screenshot') {
        if (!imageDataUrl) {
          setParseError('Прикрепите скриншот таблицы или нажмите Ctrl+V.');
          setIsParsing(false);
          return;
        }
        payload.imageBase64 = imageDataUrl;
        if (rawText.trim()) payload.rawText = rawText.trim();
      } else {
        if (!rawText.trim()) {
          setParseError('Введите текст операций или загрузите таблицу Excel/CSV.');
          setIsParsing(false);
          return;
        }
        payload.rawText = rawText.trim();
      }

      const res = await fetch('/api/parse-task', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
        setRequiresApiKeyError(Boolean(data.requiresApiKey));
        setParseError(data.error || data.message || 'Ошибка при разборе задачи.');
        setIsParsing(false);
        return;
      }

      setParsedTitle(data.title || 'Задание на 2 квартал');
      setParsedOps(data.operations || []);
      setParsedDirs(data.directories);
      setParsedMode(data.usedMode || 'local-smart-parser');
      setParsedWarnings(Array.isArray(data.warnings) ? data.warnings : []);
    } catch (err) {
      setParseError(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Сетевая ошибка при обращении к /api/parse-task'
      );
    } finally {
      setIsParsing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdatePreviewOp = (
    idx: number,
    patch: Partial<BusinessOperation>
  ) => {
    setParsedOps((prev) =>
      prev ? prev.map((op, i) => (i === idx ? { ...op, ...patch } : op)) : prev
    );
  };

  const handleConfirmImport = () => {
    if (!parsedOps || parsedOps.length === 0) return;
    importParsedTask({
      title: parsedTitle.trim() || 'Задание на 2 квартал',
      operations: parsedOps,
      directories: parsedDirs,
      uploadedImageDataUrl: tab === 'screenshot' ? imageDataUrl : null,
    });
    setParsedOps(null);
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-5 bg-black/60">
      <div className="w-full max-w-4xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col rounded-md bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 overflow-hidden">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] shrink-0">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
              Загрузить задание или подключить файл базы 1С
            </h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
              Выгрузка из 1С (JSON / Excel ОСВ / XML) или условие операций 2 квартала
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1 rounded text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-200/70 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Tabs */}
        <div className="px-5 pt-2 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] shrink-0">
          {(
            [
              { id: 'import1c', label: 'База / файл из 1С', icon: Database },
              { id: 'excel', label: 'Excel / CSV задания', icon: FileSpreadsheet },
              { id: 'screenshot', label: 'Скриншот задания', icon: ImageIcon },
              { id: 'text', label: 'Текст / Таблица', icon: FileText },
              { id: 'presets', label: 'Демо-задание (9 оп.)', icon: Layers },
            ] as const
          ).map((item) => {
            const Icon = item.icon;
            const active = tab === item.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={item.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setTab(item.id);
                  setParseError(null);
                  setParsedOps(null);
                }}
                className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium border-b-2 transition-colors ${
                  active
                    ? 'border-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-100 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100'
                    : 'border-transparent text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
                }`}
              >
                <Icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>{item.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Body */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto scrollbar-thin p-5 space-y-4">
          {/* TAB 1: LIVE SYNC URL + UPLOAD 1C EXPORT FILE */}
          {tab === 'import1c' && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="rounded-md bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 p-4 space-y-2.5">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                    Автоматическое подключение к 1С:Бухгалтерия 8.3
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={isSyncing1C}
                    onClick={async () => {
                      const ok = await refreshFrom1CSync();
                      if (ok) onClose();
                    }}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200 text-white dark:text-zinc-900"
                  >
                    <RefreshCw
                      className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isSyncing1C ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`}
                    />
                    <span>Проверить снимок 1С сейчас</span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                  <div className="p-2.5 rounded bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 mb-0.5">
                      Адрес для внешней обработки 1С (`HTTPСоединение`):
                    </div>
                    <div className="font-mono text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 select-all">
                      POST http://localhost:3000/api/1c-sync
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="p-2.5 rounded bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 mb-0.5">
                      Локальный файл выгрузки (авточтение каждые 3 сек.):
                    </div>
                    <div className="font-mono text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 select-all">
                      C:\Users\Ludwig\Downloads\1c_export.json
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {synced1C && (
                  <div className="text-xs text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-medium">
                    База 1С подключена: организация {organization.shortName || organization.name}, документов в снимке — {synced1C.allDocuments?.length ?? 0}.
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <Import1CDataPanel compact onApplied={onClose} />
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 2: EXCEL / CSV TASK READER (SKIPS ОСВ / 1 КВАРТАЛ / СПРАВОЧНИКИ) */}
          {tab === 'excel' && !parsedOps && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div
                onDragOver={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                onDrop={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  const file = e.dataTransfer.files?.[0];
                  if (file) void handleExcelUpload(file);
                }}
                className="border border-dashed border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 rounded-md p-6 text-center bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] space-y-3"
              >
                <FileSpreadsheet className="w-6 h-6 text-zinc-500 mx-auto" />
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                    Загрузите Excel / CSV файл с журналом операций задания (.xlsx, .xls, .csv)
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 mt-1">
                    Листы «ОСВ», «Остатки», «Справочники» и операции за 1 квартал (до 1 апреля) автоматически пропускаются
                  </p>
                </div>
                <label className="cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200 text-white dark:text-zinc-900">
                  <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Выбрать Excel / CSV файл</span>
                  <input
                    type="file"
                    accept=".xlsx,.xls,.csv,.tsv"
                    className="hidden"
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const f = e.target.files?.[0];
                      if (f) void handleExcelUpload(f);
                    }}
                  />
                </label>
              </div>

              {excelSheetRows.length > 0 && (
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
                    <span className="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                      {excelFileName}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                      {selectedSheetsInfo}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="max-h-48 overflow-auto rounded-md border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                    <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-[11px]">
                      <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-200 dark:divide-zinc-800">
                        {excelSheetRows.slice(0, 12).map((row, rIdx) => (
                          <tr key={rIdx} className="bg-white dark:bg-[#111113]">
                            {row.slice(0, 6).map((cell, cIdx) => (
                              <td
                                key={cIdx}
                                className="py-1.5 px-2.5 border-r border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 truncate max-w-[240px]"
                              >
                                {cell}
                              </td>
                            ))}
                          </tr>
                        ))}
                      </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 3: SCREENSHOT OCR */}
          {tab === 'screenshot' && !parsedOps && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div
                onDragOver={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                onDrop={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  const file = e.dataTransfer.files?.[0];
                  if (file && file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
                    readImageFile(file);
                  }
                }}
                className="border border-dashed border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 rounded-md p-6 text-center bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] space-y-3"
              >
                <Upload className="w-5 h-5 text-zinc-500 mx-auto" />
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                    Перетащите фото таблицы сюда или нажмите{' '}
                    <kbd className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 font-mono text-xs">
                      Ctrl+V
                    </kbd>
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 pt-1">
                  <label className="cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200 text-white dark:text-zinc-900">
                    <ImageIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Выбрать изображение</span>
                    <input
                      type="file"
                      accept="image/*"
                      className="hidden"
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const f = e.target.files?.[0];
                        if (f) readImageFile(f);
                      }}
                    />
                  </label>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleLoadBuiltInScreenshot}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-white hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-[#111113] dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
                  >
                    <span>Показать фото исходного задания (9 операций)</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {imageDataUrl && (
                <div className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 p-3 bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                    <span className="text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-mono">
                      {imageFileName}
                    </span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setImageDataUrl(null);
                        setImageFileName('');
                      }}
                      className="text-rose-600 hover:underline"
                    >
                      Удалить
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div className="max-h-60 overflow-auto rounded bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] p-2 flex justify-center border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                    {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                    <img
                      src={imageDataUrl}
                      alt="Предпросмотр скриншота"
                      className="max-h-52 w-auto rounded object-contain"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {aiConfig.provider === 'demo-local' && !aiConfig.apiKey && (
                <div className="p-3 rounded-md bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
                    Для распознавания новых изображений укажите API-ключ Gemini или OpenAI, либо загрузите Excel / текст задания.
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={onOpenAiSettings}
                    className="shrink-0 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900"
                  >
                    Настройки ИИ
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 4: TEXT / TABLE */}
          {tab === 'text' && !parsedOps && (
            <div className="space-y-2.5">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <label className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                  Вставьте таблицу или список операций 2 квартала:
                </label>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setRawText(SAMPLE_TEXT_TASK)}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-[#FAFAFA] hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-[#09090B] dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
                >
                  <ClipboardPaste className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Подставить 9 операций из задания</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              <textarea
                rows={10}
                value={rawText}
                onChange={(e) => setRawText(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="1 | 02.04 | Перечислен 100% аванс ООО Конкурент... | 1 236 900"
                className="w-full p-3 rounded-md text-xs font-mono tabular-nums leading-relaxed bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-zinc-400"
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 5: PRESETS */}
          {tab === 'presets' && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {demoScenarios.map((preset) => (
                <div
                  key={preset.id}
                  className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] p-4 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4"
                >
                  <div className="space-y-1 flex-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900">
                        {preset.operations.length} операций
                      </span>
                      <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                        {preset.title}
                      </h3>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                      {preset.subtitle}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      loadDemoScenario(preset.id);
                      onClose();

                  >
                    Загрузить заново
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Error Banner */}
          {parseError && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-md bg-rose-50/70 dark:bg-rose-950/30 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">

                  Настройки ИИ
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Parsed Operations Preview */}
          {parsedOps && (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="p-3 rounded-md bg-emerald-50/60 dark:bg-emerald-950/25 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">

                      <th className="py-2 px-2.5 font-semibold w-28">Дата</th>
                      <th className="py-2 px-2.5 font-semibold">Содержание операции</th>

                            {op.documentType1C}
                          </div>

                              ? op.postings
                                  .map((p) => `${p.debitAccount}/${p.creditAccount}`)
                                  .join(', ')
                              : 'Кадровый приказ'}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2 px-2 align-top text-right">
                          {op.explicitAmount === null ? (
                            <div className="space-y-1">
                              <span className="inline-block px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-[10px]">
                                Из остатков 1С
                              </span>
                              <input
                                type="number"
                                step="0.01"
                                placeholder="Авто"
                                onChange={(e) => {
                                  const v = e.target.value.trim();
                                  handleUpdatePreviewOp(idx, {
                                    explicitAmount: v ? Number(v) : null,
                                    resolvedAmount: v ? Number(v) : 0,
                                  });
                                }}
                                className="w-full px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-mono tabular-nums text-right bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
                              />
                            </div>
                          ) : (
                            <div className="space-y-0.5">
                              <input
                                type="number"
                                step="0.01"
                                value={op.explicitAmount}
                                onChange={(e) => {
                                  const num = Number(e.target.value) || 0;
                                  handleUpdatePreviewOp(idx, {
                                    explicitAmount: num,
                                    resolvedAmount: num,
                                  });
                                }}
                                className="w-full px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-mono tabular-nums font-semibold text-right bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
                              />
                              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tabular-nums text-zinc-400">
                                {formatRub(op.explicitAmount)}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2 px-2 align-top text-center">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() =>
                              setParsedOps((prev) =>
                                prev ? prev.filter((_, i) => i !== idx) : prev
                              )
                            }
                            className="p-1 rounded text-zinc-400 hover:text-rose-600"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="px-5 py-3 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] flex items-center justify-between gap-3 shrink-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-200/70 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
          >
            Закрыть
          </button>

          {tab !== 'presets' && tab !== 'import1c' && !parsedOps && (
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={isParsing}
              onClick={handleRunParse}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200 text-white dark:text-zinc-900 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {isParsing ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Распознаем операции...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Распознать операции 2 квартала</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          )}

          {parsedOps && (
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={parsedOps.length === 0}
              onClick={handleConfirmImport}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200 text-white dark:text-zinc-900 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Применить задание ({parsedOps.length} оп.)</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

} from 'lucide-react';

import { BusinessOperation, OpeningBalanceEntry, OrganizationCard } from '@/types/accounting';
