'use client';

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  AlertCircle,
  ArrowLeft,
  ArrowRight,
  Check,
  CheckCircle2,
  ChevronRight,
  ClipboardCopy,
  RefreshCw,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useAccountant } from '@/context/AccountantContext';
import { getAccountInfo } from '@/data/chartOfAccounts';
import {
  BusinessOperation,
  DocumentTableRowGuide,
  Operation1CSyncStatus,
} from '@/types/accounting';

function formatRub(amount: number): string {
  return (
    new Intl.NumberFormat('ru-RU', {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    }).format(amount) + ' ₽'
  );
}

function buildFallbackPlainExplanation(op: BusinessOperation): string {
  if (op.postings.length === 0) {
    return 'Документ «Прием на работу» относится к кадровому учету: он регистрирует сотрудника, подразделение и месячный оклад, а бухгалтерские проводки по зарплате, НДФЛ и взносам программа 1С сформирует в конце месяца документом «Начисление зарплаты».';
  }

  const lines = op.postings.map((p) => {
    const dt = getAccountInfo(p.debitAccount);
    const kt = getAccountInfo(p.creditAccount);
    return `Дт ${p.debitAccount} (${dt.name}) — Кт ${p.creditAccount} (${kt.name}) на сумму ${formatRub(p.amount)}: ${p.comment}`;
  });

  return lines.join(' ');
}

export function StepNavigatorTab() {
  const {
    operations,
    activeOperation,
    setActiveOperationId,
    toggleOperationDone,
    setActiveTab,
    effectiveOrganization,
    synced1C,
    refreshFrom1CSync,
    resetToDefaultDemo,
  } = useAccountant();

  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const q2Operations = useMemo(
    () => operations.filter((op) => !op.isMonthEndClosing),
    [operations]
  );

  const handleCopy = (key: string, text: string) => {
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard) {
      void navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    }
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setCopiedKey((prev) => (prev === key ? null : prev));
    }, 1600);
  };

  if (!activeOperation) {
    return (
      <div className="p-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center space-y-3">
        <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
          Выберите хозяйственную операцию в списке слева.
        </p>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={resetToDefaultDemo}
          className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900"
        >
          Восстановить задание
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const navList = activeOperation.isMonthEndClosing ? operations : q2Operations;
  const currentIndex = navList.findIndex((op) => op.id === activeOperation.id);
  const prevOp = currentIndex > 0 ? navList[currentIndex - 1] : null;
  const nextOp =
    currentIndex >= 0 && currentIndex < navList.length - 1
      ? navList[currentIndex + 1]
      : null;

  const substituteStudentText = (raw: string): string => {
    const student = effectiveOrganization.studentName.trim();
    if (!student) return raw;
    return raw.replace(/\(?\s*ФИО\s+студента\s*\)?/gi, student);
  };

  const match1C = activeOperation.match1C;
  const syncStatus: Operation1CSyncStatus =
    match1C?.syncStatus ??
    (activeOperation.status === 'done'
      ? 'done_in_1c'
      : activeOperation.status === 'needs_data'
        ? 'needs_fix_in_1c'
        : 'missing_in_1c');

  const matchedDocs = match1C?.matchedDocs ?? [];
  const matchedPostings = match1C?.matchedPostings ?? [];
  const issues = match1C?.issues ?? [];
  const missingCounterpartyFields = match1C?.missingCounterpartyFields ?? [];
  const tableRowsGuide: DocumentTableRowGuide[] = match1C?.tableRowsGuide ?? [];
  const plainExplanation =
    match1C?.plainExplanation?.trim() ||
    buildFallbackPlainExplanation(activeOperation);

  // Full breadcrumb route in 1C 8.3 (including Создать -> Вид операции when distinct)
  const fullMenuBreadcrumb = useMemo(() => {
    const steps = [...activeOperation.menuPath1C];
    const last = steps[steps.length - 1] || '';
    const opKind = activeOperation.operationKind1C?.trim();
    if (
      opKind &&
      !last.toLowerCase().includes(opKind.toLowerCase().slice(0, 12))
    ) {
      steps.push('Создать', opKind);
    }
    return steps;
  }, [activeOperation.menuPath1C, activeOperation.operationKind1C]);

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-7 max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      {/* OPERATION HEADER */}
      <div className="rounded-md bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 p-5 space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900 font-mono tabular-nums text-xs font-semibold">
              Операция №{activeOperation.number}
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono tabular-nums text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
              от {activeOperation.date}

                  activeOperation.status === 'done'
                    ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800'
                    : 'bg-[#FAFAFA] hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-[#09090B] dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 disabled:opacity-40'
                }`}
              >
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>
                  {activeOperation.status === 'done'

              <button
                type="button"

              >
                <ArrowLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Пред.</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={!nextOp}
                onClick={() => nextOp && setActiveOperationId(nextOp.id)}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 disabled:opacity-40"

                      className={`shrink-0 inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-medium border transition-colors ${
                        isCopied
                          ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800'
                          : 'bg-white hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-[#111113] dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {isCopied ? (
                        <>
                          <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600" />
                          <span>Скопировано</span>
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <ClipboardCopy className="w-3 h-3" />
                          <span>Скопировать</span>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 2) Компактная подсказка по пустым реквизитам контрагента в 1С */}
        {missingCounterpartyFields.length > 0 && (
          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-md bg-rose-50/40 dark:bg-rose-950/20 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800/80 space-y-2.5">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span>
                В карточке контрагента в 1С пустые поля:{' '}
                {missingCounterpartyFields.map((f) => f.fieldLabel).join(', ')} — впишите эти значения:
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              {missingCounterpartyFields.map((gap) => {
                const copyId = `cp-gap-${activeOperation.id}-${gap.fieldKey}`;
                const isCopied = copiedKey === copyId;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={gap.fieldKey}
                    className="px-3 py-2 rounded bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/60 flex items-center justify-between gap-2"
                  >
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                        {gap.fieldLabel}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-xs font-mono tabular-nums font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 truncate">
                        {gap.expectedValue}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleCopy(copyId, gap.expectedValue)}
                      className="shrink-0 inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-medium border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300"
                    >
                      {isCopied ? (
                        <>
                          <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600" />
                          <span>Ок</span>
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <ClipboardCopy className="w-3 h-3" />
                          <span>Скопировать</span>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 3) Табличная часть (когда есть строки табличной части) */}
        {tableRowsGuide.length > 0 && (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
              2. Табличная часть документа
            </div>
            <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                    <th className="py-2 px-3 font-semibold">Номенклатура / Статья</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-3 font-semibold text-right">Количество</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-3 font-semibold text-right">Цена</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-3 font-semibold text-right">Сумма</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-3 font-semibold">НДС</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-3 font-semibold">Счет учета</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-200 dark:divide-zinc-800">
                  {tableRowsGuide.map((row, idx) => {
                    const nameCopyKey = `tbl-name-${activeOperation.id}-${idx}`;
                    const sumCopyKey = `tbl-sum-${activeOperation.id}-${idx}`;
                    return (
                      <tr key={idx} className="bg-white dark:bg-[#111113]">
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                            <div>
                              <div className="font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                                {substituteStudentText(row.name)}
                              </div>
                              {row.subconto && (
                                <div className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500">
                                  Субконто: {row.subconto}
                                </div>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() =>
                                handleCopy(nameCopyKey, substituteStudentText(row.name))
                              }
                              title="Скопировать наименование"
                              className="p-1 rounded text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
                            >
                              {copiedKey === nameCopyKey ? (
                                <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                              ) : (
                                <ClipboardCopy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              )}
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right font-mono tabular-nums text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 whitespace-nowrap">
                          {row.quantity || '—'}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right font-mono tabular-nums text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 whitespace-nowrap">
                          {row.price || '—'}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right font-mono tabular-nums font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 whitespace-nowrap">
                          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                            <span>{row.amount}</span>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() =>
                                handleCopy(
                                  sumCopyKey,
                                  row.amount.replace(/[^\d,.-]/g, '')
                                )
                              }
                              title="Скопировать сумму"
                              className="p-1 rounded text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
                            >
                              {copiedKey === sumCopyKey ? (
                                <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600" />
                              ) : (
                                <ClipboardCopy className="w-3 h-3" />
                              )}
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-mono tabular-nums text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 whitespace-nowrap">
                          {row.vat}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-mono tabular-nums font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 whitespace-nowrap">
                          {row.account}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 4) Счет-фактура / УПД */}
        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-md bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
              Счет-фактура / УПД внизу документа:{' '}
              <span
                className={
                  activeOperation.hasUpdOrSf
                    ? 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400'
                    : 'text-zinc-500'
                }
              >
                {activeOperation.hasUpdOrSf
                  ? 'Обязательно зарегистрировать (тумблер УПД или кнопка «Зарегистрировать»)'
                  : 'Не требуется'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
              {activeOperation.updLabel ||
                (activeOperation.hasUpdOrSf
                  ? `Укажите дату ${activeOperation.date} и номер первичного документа, чтобы сформировалась проводка по НДС (счет 68.02).`
                  : 'Для банковских, кассовых и кадровых документов счет-фактура внизу формы не вводится.')}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* БЛОК Г. КАКИЕ ПРОВОДКИ ДОЛЖНЫ ПОЛУЧИТЬСЯ (Дт/Кт) */}
      <section className="rounded-md bg-white dark:bg-[#111113] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 p-5 space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <h2 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            Блок Г. Какие проводки должны получиться (проверка по кнопке «Дт/Кт»)
          </h2>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('audit_osv')}
            className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-100 hover:underline"
          >
            Открыть проверку ошибок и ОСВ →
          </button>
        </div>

        {activeOperation.postings.length > 0 ? (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                  <th className="py-2 px-3 font-semibold w-28">Дебет</th>
                  <th className="py-2 px-3 font-semibold w-28">Кредит</th>
                  <th className="py-2 px-3 font-semibold text-right w-40">Сумма</th>
                  <th className="py-2 px-3 font-semibold">Субконто (аналитика)</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-200 dark:divide-zinc-800">
                {activeOperation.postings.map((p, idx) => {
                  const subcontos = [
                    ...p.debitSubconto.map((s) => `Дт: ${substituteStudentText(s)}`),
                    ...p.creditSubconto.map((s) => `Кт: ${substituteStudentText(s)}`),
                  ];
                  return (
                    <tr key={p.id || idx} className="bg-white dark:bg-[#111113]">
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 align-top font-mono tabular-nums font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                        {p.debitAccount}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 align-top font-mono tabular-nums font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                        {p.creditAccount}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 align-top text-right font-mono tabular-nums font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 whitespace-nowrap">
                        {formatRub(p.amount)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 align-top text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 space-y-0.5">
                        {subcontos.length > 0 ? (
                          subcontos.map((line, sIdx) => <div key={sIdx}>{line}</div>)
                        ) : (
                          <span>{substituteStudentText(p.comment)}</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-md bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
            {activeOperation.status === 'needs_data'
              ? 'Суммы проводок появятся автоматически после загрузки остатков на 31 марта.'
              : 'На дату кадрового приказа бухгалтерских проводок Дт/Кт нет — начисление зарплаты и взносов выполняется в конце месяца.'}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Plain Human-Language Explanation */}
        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-md bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 space-y-1">
          <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
            Почему используются именно эти счета:
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 leading-relaxed">
            {plainExplanation}
          </p>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Compass,
  Database,
  FileSearch,
  ListTodo,
  Table2,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useAccountant } from '@/context/AccountantContext';
import { Header } from '@/components/Header';
import { OperationsSidebar } from '@/components/OperationsSidebar';
import { StepNavigatorTab } from '@/components/StepNavigatorTab';
import { Database1CTab } from '@/components/Database1CTab';
import { AuditErrorsTab } from '@/components/AuditErrorsTab';
import { OsvTab } from '@/components/OsvTab';
import { AccountantChatPanel } from '@/components/AccountantChatPanel';
import { ImportTaskModal } from '@/components/ImportTaskModal';
import { AiSettingsModal } from '@/components/AiSettingsModal';

export function WorkspaceShell() {
  const {
    activeTab,
    setActiveTab,
    operations,
    activeOperationId,
    openingBalances,
    osvReport,
    reconciliation,
    requisiteReport,
    auditReport,
    synced1C,
  } = useAccountant();

  const [isImportModalOpen, setIsImportModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isAiSettingsOpen, setIsAiSettingsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isMobileSidebarOpen, setIsMobileSidebarOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isChatDrawerOpen, setIsChatDrawerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [tab3SubView, setTab3SubView] = useState<'audit' | 'osv'>('audit');

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsMobileSidebarOpen(false);
  }, [activeOperationId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeTab === 'osv') {
      setTab3SubView('osv');
    } else if (activeTab === 'audit') {
      setTab3SubView('audit');
    }
  }, [activeTab]);

  const realQ2Operations = useMemo(
    () => operations.filter((op) => !op.isMonthEndClosing),
    [operations]
  );

  const doneIn1CCount = useMemo(
    () =>
      realQ2Operations.filter((op) =>
        op.match1C ? op.match1C.syncStatus === 'done_in_1c' : op.status === 'done'
      ).length,
    [realQ2Operations]
  );

  const osvAlertCount = useMemo(() => {
    const redCount = osvReport.rows.filter((r) => !r.isGroup && r.hasRedBalance).length;
    return redCount + reconciliation.mismatchedAccountsCount;
  }, [osvReport.rows, reconciliation.mismatchedAccountsCount]);

  const combinedErrorsCount = useMemo(
    () => Math.max(auditReport.totalIssuesCount, osvAlertCount),
    [auditReport.totalIssuesCount, osvAlertCount]
  );

  const isTab1 = activeTab === 'navigator';
  const isTab2 =
    activeTab === 'database1c' || activeTab === 'balances' || activeTab === 'directories';
  const isTab3 =
    activeTab === 'audit_osv' || activeTab === 'audit' || activeTab === 'osv';

  const dbInitialSection =
    activeTab === 'balances'
      ? 'balances'
      : activeTab === 'directories'
        ? 'directories'
        : undefined;

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen flex-col overflow-hidden bg-[#FAFAFA] text-zinc-900 dark:bg-[#09090B] dark:text-zinc-100">
      {/* 1-Row Global Header */}
      <Header
        onOpenImportModal={() => setIsImportModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenAiSettings={() => setIsAiSettingsOpen(true)}
        onToggleMobileChat={() => setIsChatDrawerOpen((prev) => !prev)}
      />

      {/* 3 Clear Top Tabs Bar */}
      <nav
        aria-label="Разделы рабочей области"
        className="z-20 flex min-h-11 shrink-0 flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-zinc-200 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-[#111113] sm:px-5"
      >
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
          {isTab1 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsMobileSidebarOpen(true)}
              className="inline-flex h-8 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 transition hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 lg:hidden"
            >
              <ListTodo className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">
                Операции ({doneIn1CCount}/{realQ2Operations.length})
              </span>
            </button>
          )}

          {/* Tab 1: Что сделать в 1С (Пошагово) */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('navigator')}
            className={`inline-flex h-8 items-center gap-2 rounded-md border px-3 text-xs font-medium transition ${
              isTab1
                ? 'border-zinc-900 bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:border-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900'
                : 'border-transparent text-zinc-600 hover:border-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-50 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100'
            }`}
          >
            <Compass className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
            <span>Что сделать в 1С (Пошагово)</span>
            <span
              className={`rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold tabular-nums ${
                isTab1
                  ? 'bg-white/20 text-white dark:bg-zinc-900/20 dark:text-zinc-900'
                  : 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400'
              }`}
            >
              {doneIn1CCount}/{realQ2Operations.length}
            </span>
          </button>

          {/* Tab 2: Что уже есть в моей базе 1С */}
          <button
            type="button"

            className={`inline-flex h-8 items-center gap-2 rounded-md border px-3 text-xs font-medium transition ${

            }`}

                {requisiteReport.incompleteCount}
              </span>
            ) : (

                    : 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400'
                }`}

                {synced1C ? synced1C.allDocuments?.length ?? 0 : openingBalances.length}
              </span>

          </button>

            }`}
          >
            <FileSearch className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
            <span>Проверка ошибок и ОСВ</span>
            {combinedErrorsCount > 0 && (
              <span className="rounded bg-red-600 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold text-white tabular-nums">
                {combinedErrorsCount}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </nav>

      {/* Main Content Area */}
      <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden">

        {isTab1 && (

            <OperationsSidebar onOpenImportModal={() => setIsImportModalOpen(true)} />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Right / Full Workspace */}
        <main className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col overflow-hidden bg-[#FAFAFA] dark:bg-[#09090B]">
          {/* Clean Segmented Switch on Tab 3 («Проверка ошибок и ОСВ») */}
          {isTab3 && (
            <div className="z-10 flex h-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-zinc-200 bg-white px-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-[#111113] sm:px-6">
              <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 p-0.5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
                <button

                    setActiveTab('audit_osv');

                  className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition ${

                    tab3SubView === 'osv'
                      ? 'bg-white text-zinc-900 shadow-sm dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100'
                      : 'text-zinc-600 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Table2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  <span>Оборотно-сальдовая ведомость (ОСВ)</span>
                  {osvAlertCount > 0 && (
                    <span className="rounded bg-red-600 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold text-white tabular-nums">
                      {osvAlertCount}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Scrollable Body */}
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto pb-20 scrollbar-thin">
            {isTab1 && <StepNavigatorTab />}
            {isTab2 && <Database1CTab initialSection={dbInitialSection} />}
            {isTab3 && (tab3SubView === 'audit' ? <AuditErrorsTab /> : <OsvTab />)}
          </div>
        </main>
      </div>

      {/* Mobile Slide-Over Operations Drawer (Tab 1) */}
      {isTab1 && isMobileSidebarOpen && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-40 flex bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm lg:hidden"
          onClick={() => setIsMobileSidebarOpen(false)}
        >
          <div
            className="relative flex h-full w-[88vw] max-w-[320px] flex-col border-r border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-[#111113]"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="flex h-11 items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-200 px-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                Операции задачи
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsMobileSidebarOpen(false)}
                className="rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden">
              <OperationsSidebar
                onOpenImportModal={() => {
                  setIsMobileSidebarOpen(false);
                  setIsImportModalOpen(true);
                }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Bottom-Right Compact Button + Slide-Over Chat Drawer («Личный бухгалтер») */}
      <AccountantChatPanel
        isOpen={isChatDrawerOpen}
        onOpenChange={setIsChatDrawerOpen}
        onCloseMobile={() => setIsChatDrawerOpen(false)}
        onOpenAiSettings={() => setIsAiSettingsOpen(true)}
      />

      {/* Global Modals */}
      <ImportTaskModal
        isOpen={isImportModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsImportModalOpen(false)}
        onOpenAiSettings={() => {
          setIsImportModalOpen(false);
          setIsAiSettingsOpen(true);
        }}
      />

      <AiSettingsModal
        isOpen={isAiSettingsOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsAiSettingsOpen(false)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

const AccountantContext = createContext<AccountantContextValue | null>(null);

function roundMoney(val: number): number {
  return Math.round((val + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100;
}

function normalizeEntityKey(str?: string): string {
  return (str || '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/ё/g, 'е')
    .replace(/[«»"'`]/g, '')
    .replace(
      /\b(ооо|ао|пао|зао|оао|ип|общество с ограниченной ответственностью|акционерное общество)\b/g,
      ''
    )
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

export function AccountantProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const existingParent = useContext(AccountantContext);
  if (existingParent) {
    return <>{children}</>;
  }

  return <AccountantProviderInner>{children}</AccountantProviderInner>;
}

  const syncedRevisionRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const hasDoneInitialServerSyncRef = useRef(false);

  // Hydrate from localStorage + IndexedDB on mount

    const saved = loadPersistedState();
    if (saved) {
      setActivePresetId(saved.activePresetId || DEFAULT_DEMO_SCENARIO.id);
      setTaskTitle(saved.taskTitle || DEFAULT_DEMO_SCENARIO.title);
      setOrganization(saved.organization);
      setOpeningBalances(saved.openingBalances);
      setRawOperations(saved.rawOperations);
      setClosingOperationStatuses(saved.closingOperationStatuses || {});
      setIncludeAutoClosing(
        typeof saved.includeAutoClosing === 'boolean' ? saved.includeAutoClosing : false
      );
      setBaseDirectories(saved.baseDirectories || DEFAULT_DEMO_SCENARIO.directories);

      const map: Record<string, boolean> = {};
      for (const c of saved.baseDirectories?.counterparties ?? []) {
        if (c.createdIn1C) map[c.id] = true;
      }
      for (const n of saved.baseDirectories?.nomenclature ?? []) {
        if (n.createdIn1C) map[n.id] = true;
      }
      for (const e of saved.baseDirectories?.employees ?? []) {
        if (e.createdIn1C) map[e.id] = true;
      }
      setCreatedDirectoryMap(map);

      setActiveOperationId(saved.activeOperationId || saved.rawOperations[0]?.id || '');
      setActiveTab(saved.activeTab || 'navigator');
      setOsvMode(saved.osvMode || 'all_operations');
      setUserOsvInputs(saved.userOsvInputs || {});
      if (saved.synced1C) {
        setSynced1C(saved.synced1C);
        syncedRevisionRef.current = saved.synced1C.revision;
      }
      if (Array.isArray(saved.chatMessages) && saved.chatMessages.length > 0) {
        setChatMessages(saved.chatMessages);

  // Apply an incoming Synced1CSnapshot: IMMEDIATELY replaces organization, openingBalances, userOsvInputs, and directories!
  const applySyncedSnapshot = useCallback((snapshot: Synced1CSnapshot) => {
    syncedRevisionRef.current = snapshot.revision;
    setSynced1C(snapshot);

    // 1. IMMEDIATELY replace `organization` with real 1C organization + registers1C responsiblePersons/accountingPolicy
    const org1C = snapshot.organization;
    const resp1C = snapshot.registers1C?.responsiblePersons;
    const policy1C = snapshot.registers1C?.accountingPolicy;
    if (org1C || resp1C || policy1C) {
      setOrganization((prev) => {
        const incomingName = (org1C?.name || org1C?.shortName || '').trim();
        const incomingShort = (org1C?.shortName || org1C?.name || '').trim();
        const incomingInn = (org1C?.inn ?? '').trim();

        const isRealDifferentCompany =
          (incomingName.length > 0 &&
            normalizeEntityKey(incomingName) !==
              normalizeEntityKey(DEFAULT_DEMO_SCENARIO.organization.name) &&
            normalizeEntityKey(incomingName) !==
              normalizeEntityKey(DEFAULT_DEMO_SCENARIO.organization.shortName)) ||
          (incomingInn.length > 0 && incomingInn !== DEFAULT_DEMO_SCENARIO.organization.inn);

        const pickField = (val1C: string | undefined, fallbackPrev: string): string => {
          if (val1C !== undefined && val1C.trim() !== '') return val1C.trim();
          if (isRealDifferentCompany && val1C !== undefined) return val1C.trim();
          return fallbackPrev;
        };

        const resolvedDirector =
          (org1C?.directorName && org1C.directorName.trim()) ||
          (resp1C?.directorName && resp1C.directorName.trim()) ||
          (isRealDifferentCompany ? '' : prev.directorName);

        const resolvedAccountant =
          (org1C?.chiefAccountantName && org1C.chiefAccountantName.trim()) ||
          (resp1C?.chiefAccountantName && resp1C.chiefAccountantName.trim()) ||
          (isRealDifferentCompany ? '' : prev.chiefAccountantName);

        let resolvedTaxSystem = prev.taxSystem;
        if (org1C?.taxSystem) {
          resolvedTaxSystem = org1C.taxSystem;
        } else if (policy1C?.taxSystem) {
          const ts = policy1C.taxSystem.toUpperCase();
          if (ts.includes('15')) resolvedTaxSystem = 'USN_15';
          else if (ts.includes('6') || ts.includes('УСН')) resolvedTaxSystem = 'USN_6';
          else if (ts.includes('ОСН') || ts.includes('ОБЩ')) resolvedTaxSystem = 'OSNO';
        }

        const resolvedCosting =
          typeof policy1C?.directCosting === 'boolean'
            ? policy1C.directCosting
              ? 'direct-costing'
              : 'full-absorption'
            : org1C?.costingMethod || prev.costingMethod;

        return {
          ...prev,
          name: incomingName || prev.name,
          shortName: incomingShort || prev.shortName,
          inn: pickField(org1C?.inn, prev.inn),
          kpp: pickField(org1C?.kpp, prev.kpp),
          ogrn: pickField(org1C?.ogrn, prev.ogrn ?? ''),
          bankAccount: pickField(org1C?.bankAccount, prev.bankAccount),
          bankName: pickField(org1C?.bankName, prev.bankName),
          bik: pickField(org1C?.bik, prev.bik),
          corrAccount: pickField(org1C?.corrAccount, prev.corrAccount),
          address: pickField(org1C?.address, prev.address ?? ''),
          directorName: resolvedDirector,
          chiefAccountantName: resolvedAccountant,
          taxSystem: resolvedTaxSystem,
          costingMethod: resolvedCosting,
          substituteStudentInOrgName: incomingName ? false : prev.substituteStudentInOrgName,
          substituteStudentAsAccountant:
            resolvedAccountant && isRealDifferentCompany
              ? false
              : prev.substituteStudentAsAccountant,
        };
      });
    }

    // 2. IMMEDIATELY replace `openingBalances` from 1C `Остатки` (31.03.2026) so empty Q2 sums resolve automatically
    if (Array.isArray(snapshot.openingBalances) && snapshot.openingBalances.length > 0) {
      setOpeningBalances(
        snapshot.openingBalances.map((row, idx) => ({
          ...row,
          id: row.id || `ob-sync-${idx}`,
          accountCode: row.accountCode.trim(),
          debit: roundMoney(Number(row.debit) || 0),
          credit: roundMoney(Number(row.credit) || 0),
        }))
      );
    }

    // 3. Replace `userOsvInputs` cleanly from `snapshot.endBalances`
    if (snapshot.endBalances && Object.keys(snapshot.endBalances).length > 0) {
      const nextOsv: Record<string, UserOsvInputRow> = {};
      for (const [accountCode, bal] of Object.entries(snapshot.endBalances)) {
        const code = accountCode.trim();
        nextOsv[code] = {
          accountCode: code,
          endDebit: roundMoney(Number(bal.debit) || 0),
          endCredit: roundMoney(Number(bal.credit) || 0),
        };
      }
      setUserOsvInputs(nextOsv);
    }

    // 4. Merge 1C employees & counterparties into directories where applicable (keeping non-empty reference fields intact)
    const syncEmployees = snapshot.directories1C?.employees ?? [];
    const syncCounterparties =
      snapshot.directories1C?.counterparties?.length
        ? snapshot.directories1C.counterparties
        : (snapshot.counterparties ?? []);

    if (syncEmployees.length > 0 || syncCounterparties.length > 0) {
      setBaseDirectories((prev) => {
        const mergedCounterparties = [...prev.counterparties];
        for (const cp of syncCounterparties) {
          if (!cp.name?.trim()) continue;
          const cleanInn = (cp.inn || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
          const norm = normalizeEntityKey(cp.name);
          const idx = mergedCounterparties.findIndex((ex) => {
            const exInn = (ex.inn || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
            if (cleanInn.length >= 10 && exInn === cleanInn) return true;
            return norm.length > 0 && normalizeEntityKey(ex.name) === norm;
          });
          const firstContract = cp.contracts?.[0];
          const mappedKind: CounterpartyCard1C['contractKind'] =
            firstContract?.kind?.toLowerCase().includes('покупател')
              ? 'С покупателем'
              : firstContract?.kind?.toLowerCase().includes('проч')
                ? 'Прочее'
                : 'С поставщиком';

          if (idx >= 0) {
            const cur = mergedCounterparties[idx];
            mergedCounterparties[idx] = {
              ...cur,
              fullName: cp.fullName?.trim() || cur.fullName,
              inn: cleanInn.length >= 10 ? cp.inn!.trim() : cur.inn,
              kpp: cp.kpp?.trim() || cur.kpp,
              bankAccount: cp.bankAccount?.trim() || cur.bankAccount,
              bik: cp.bik?.trim() || cur.bik,
              bankName: cp.bankName?.trim() || cur.bankName,
              contractNumber: firstContract?.number?.trim() || cur.contractNumber,
              contractDate: firstContract?.date?.trim() || cur.contractDate,
              createdIn1C: true,
            };
          } else {
            mergedCounterparties.push({
              id: `cp-sync-${mergedCounterparties.length + 1}`,
              name: cp.name.trim(),
              fullName: cp.fullName?.trim() || cp.name.trim(),
              inn: cp.inn?.trim() || '',
              kpp: cp.kpp?.trim() || '',
              bankAccount: cp.bankAccount?.trim() || '',
              bankName: cp.bankName?.trim() || '',
              bik: cp.bik?.trim() || '',
              contractKind: mappedKind,
              contractNumber: firstContract?.number?.trim() || '',
              contractDate: firstContract?.date?.trim() || '',
              createdIn1C: true,
            });
          }
        }

        const mergedEmployees = [...prev.employees];
        for (const emp of syncEmployees) {
          if (!emp.fullName?.trim()) continue;
          const norm = normalizeEntityKey(emp.fullName);
          const idx = mergedEmployees.findIndex(
            (ex) => normalizeEntityKey(ex.fullName) === norm
          );
          if (idx >= 0) {
            mergedEmployees[idx] = {
              ...mergedEmployees[idx],
              position: emp.position || mergedEmployees[idx].position,
              department: emp.department || mergedEmployees[idx].department,
              salary: emp.salary && emp.salary > 0 ? emp.salary : mergedEmployees[idx].salary,
              hireDate: emp.hireDate || mergedEmployees[idx].hireDate,
              createdIn1C: true,
            };
          } else {
            mergedEmployees.push({
              id: emp.id || `emp-1c-${mergedEmployees.length + 1}`,
              fullName: emp.fullName.trim(),
              position: emp.position || 'Сотрудник',
              department: emp.department || 'Основное подразделение',
              salary: emp.salary ?? 0,
              hireDate: emp.hireDate || '2026-04-01',
              costAccount: '26',
              createdIn1C: true,
            });
          }
        }
        return {
          ...prev,
          counterparties: mergedCounterparties,
          employees: mergedEmployees,
        };
      });
    }
  }, []);

  // Manual refresh from GET /api/1c-sync (unconditionally applies when hasData is true!)
  const refreshFrom1CSync = useCallback(async (): Promise<boolean> => {
    setIsSyncing1C(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/1c-sync', {
        method: 'GET',
        cache: 'no-store',
      });
      if (!res.ok) return false;
      const data = (await res.json()) as {
        status?: string;
        hasData?: boolean;
        snapshot?: Synced1CSnapshot | null;
      };
      if (data?.status === 'ok' && data.hasData && data.snapshot) {
        applySyncedSnapshot(data.snapshot);
        hasDoneInitialServerSyncRef.current = true;
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    } catch {
      return false;
    } finally {
      setIsSyncing1C(false);
    }
  }, [applySyncedSnapshot]);

  // 1-click simulation of a realistic 1C April snapshot containing all student error types
  const simulate1CSyncWithSampleErrors = useCallback(async (): Promise<void> => {
    setIsSyncing1C(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/1c-sync?demo=1', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: '{}',
      });
      if (!res.ok) return;
      const data = (await res.json()) as {
        status?: string;
        snapshot?: Synced1CSnapshot;
      };
      if (data?.snapshot) {
        applySyncedSnapshot(data.snapshot);
        hasDoneInitialServerSyncRef.current = true;
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore network error in offline/SSR context
    } finally {
      setIsSyncing1C(false);
    }
  }, [applySyncedSnapshot]);

  // Clear active 1C sync snapshot
  const clear1CSyncSnapshot = useCallback(async (): Promise<void> => {
    setIsSyncing1C(true);
    try {
      await fetch('/api/1c-sync?clear=1', { method: 'POST' });
    } catch {
      // ignore
    } finally {
      syncedRevisionRef.current = null;
      setSynced1C(null);
      setUserOsvInputs({});
      setIsSyncing1C(false);
    }
  }, []);

  // Initial mount unconditional sync + background polling of GET /api/1c-sync every 3000ms
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isHydrated || typeof window === 'undefined') return;

    let cancelled = false;

    const pollOnce = async (forceApply: boolean) => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      if (
        !forceApply &&
        typeof document !== 'undefined' &&
        document.visibilityState === 'hidden'
      ) {
        return;
      }
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/1c-sync', {
          method: 'GET',
          cache: 'no-store',
        });
        if (!res.ok || cancelled) return;
        const data = (await res.json()) as {
          status?: string;
          hasData?: boolean;
          snapshot?: Synced1CSnapshot | null;
        };
        if (cancelled) return;
        if (data?.status === 'ok' && data.hasData && data.snapshot) {
          if (
            forceApply ||
            !hasDoneInitialServerSyncRef.current ||
            data.snapshot.revision !== syncedRevisionRef.current
          ) {
            hasDoneInitialServerSyncRef.current = true;
            applySyncedSnapshot(data.snapshot);
          }
        }
      } catch {
        // silent background poll
      }
    };

    // Unconditional check & apply on mount so stale localStorage demo org never overrides live 1C!
    void pollOnce(true);

    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      void pollOnce(false);
    }, 3000);

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      window.clearInterval(timer);
    };
  }, [isHydrated, applySyncedSnapshot]);

  // Effective organization with student name substitution applied
  const effectiveOrganization = useMemo<OrganizationCard>(() => {
    const student = organization.studentName.trim();
    if (!student) return organization;

    return {
      ...organization,
      name: organization.substituteStudentInOrgName
        ? `${organization.name} (${student})`
        : organization.name,
      shortName: organization.substituteStudentInOrgName
        ? `${organization.shortName} (${student})`
        : organization.shortName,
      chiefAccountantName: organization.substituteStudentAsAccountant
        ? student
        : organization.chiefAccountantName,
    };
  }, [organization]);

  // Extracted + merged 1C directories with createdIn1C status and student name substitution applied
  const directories = useMemo<ExtractedDirectories1C>(() => {
    const extracted = extractDirectoriesFromTask(rawOperations, openingBalances, baseDirectories);
    const student = organization.studentName.trim();
    return {
      ...extracted,
      counterparties: extracted.counterparties.map((item) => ({
        ...item,
        createdIn1C: createdDirectoryMap[item.id] ?? item.createdIn1C ?? false,
      })),
      nomenclature: extracted.nomenclature.map((item) => ({
        ...item,
        createdIn1C: createdDirectoryMap[item.id] ?? item.createdIn1C ?? false,
      })),
      employees: extracted.employees.map((item) => {
        const isStudentSlot =
          item.id === 'emp-student-accountant' || /фио\s+студента/i.test(item.fullName);
        const resolvedName =
          isStudentSlot && organization.substituteStudentAsAccountant && student
            ? student
            : item.fullName;
        return {
          ...item,
          fullName: resolvedName,
          createdIn1C: createdDirectoryMap[item.id] ?? item.createdIn1C ?? false,
        };
      }),
    };
  }, [rawOperations, openingBalances, baseDirectories, createdDirectoryMap, organization]);

  // Requisite Completeness Control («Реквизит-контроль»)
  const requisiteReport = useMemo<RequisiteCheckReport>(() => {
    return checkRequisitesCompleteness(effectiveOrganization, directories, synced1C);
  }, [effectiveOrganization, directories, synced1C]);

  // Smart-linked main operations + optional Month-End Closing operations + Per-Operation 1C Matcher
  const resolvedMainOperations = useMemo<BusinessOperation[]>(() => {
    return resolveOperationsWithSmartLinks(rawOperations, openingBalances, effectiveOrganization);
  }, [rawOperations, openingBalances, effectiveOrganization]);

  const closingOperations = useMemo<BusinessOperation[]>(() => {
    if (!includeAutoClosing) return [];
    return generateMonthEndClosingOperations(
      resolvedMainOperations,
      openingBalances,
      directories,
      effectiveOrganization,
      closingOperationStatuses
    );
  }, [
    includeAutoClosing,
    resolvedMainOperations,
    openingBalances,
    directories,
    effectiveOrganization,
    closingOperationStatuses,
  ]);

  const operations = useMemo<BusinessOperation[]>(() => {
    const combined = [...resolvedMainOperations, ...closingOperations];
    return enrichOperationsWith1CMatch(combined, synced1C, requisiteReport);
  }, [resolvedMainOperations, closingOperations, synced1C, requisiteReport]);

  const activeOperation = useMemo<BusinessOperation | null>(() => {
    if (operations.length === 0) return null;
    return operations.find((op) => op.id === activeOperationId) ?? operations[0];
  }, [operations, activeOperationId]);

  // Live OSV & Reference OSV & Reconciliation
  const osvReport = useMemo<OsvReport>(() => {
    return calculateOsv(openingBalances, operations, osvMode);
  }, [openingBalances, operations, osvMode]);

  const referenceOsvReport = useMemo<OsvReport>(() => {
    return calculateOsv(openingBalances, operations, 'all_operations');
  }, [openingBalances, operations]);

  const reconciliation = useMemo<OsvReconciliationResult>(() => {
    return reconcileUserOsv(referenceOsvReport, userOsvInputs, operations);
  }, [referenceOsvReport, userOsvInputs, operations]);

  // Full 6-Category 1C Error Auditor
  const auditReport = useMemo<Full1CAuditReport>(() => {
    return runFull1CAudit(
      operations,
      referenceOsvReport,
      effectiveOrganization,
      directories,
      synced1C,
      userOsvInputs
    );
  }, [
    operations,
    referenceOsvReport,
    effectiveOrganization,
    directories,
    synced1C,
    userOsvInputs,
  ]);

  // Auto-save to localStorage whenever state changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasLoadedStorageRef.current) return;

    const savedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    const persistedDirectories: ExtractedDirectories1C = {
      ...baseDirectories,
      counterparties: directories.counterparties,
      nomenclature: directories.nomenclature,
      employees: directories.employees,
    };

    const payload: PersistedAccountantState = {
      version: 3,
      activePresetId,
      taskTitle,
      organization,
      openingBalances,
      rawOperations,
      closingOperationStatuses,
      includeAutoClosing,
      baseDirectories: persistedDirectories,
      activeOperationId,
      activeTab,
      osvMode,
      userOsvInputs,
      synced1C,
      chatMessages,
      aiConfig,
      theme,
      savedAt,
    };

    if (savePersistedState(payload)) {
      setLastSavedAt(savedAt);
    }
  }, [
    activePresetId,
    taskTitle,
    organization,
    openingBalances,
    rawOperations,
    closingOperationStatuses,
    includeAutoClosing,
    baseDirectories,
    directories,
    activeOperationId,
    activeTab,
    osvMode,
    userOsvInputs,
    synced1C,
    chatMessages,
    aiConfig,
    theme,
  ]);

  // Actions
  const updateOrganization = useCallback((patch: Partial<OrganizationCard>) => {
    setOrganization((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...patch }));
  }, []);

  const addOpeningBalance = useCallback(
    (entry: Omit<OpeningBalanceEntry, 'id'> & { id?: string }) => {
      const id = entry.id || `ob-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;
      setOpeningBalances((prev) => [...prev, { ...entry, id }]);
    },
    []
  );

  const updateOpeningBalance = useCallback((id: string, patch: Partial<OpeningBalanceEntry>) => {
    setOpeningBalances((prev) =>
      prev.map((row) => (row.id === id ? { ...row, ...patch } : row))
    );
  }, []);

  const removeOpeningBalance = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setOpeningBalances((prev) => prev.filter((row) => row.id !== id));
  }, []);

  const clearOpeningBalances = useCallback(() => {
    setOpeningBalances([]);
  }, []);

  const balanceOpeningDifferenceTo84 = useCallback(() => {
    setOpeningBalances((prev) => {
      const totalDebit = roundMoney(prev.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (Number(r.debit) || 0), 0));
      const totalCredit = roundMoney(prev.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (Number(r.credit) || 0), 0));
      const diff = roundMoney(totalDebit - totalCredit);
      if (Math.abs(diff) < 0.01) return prev;

      const idx84 = prev.findIndex((r) => r.accountCode === '84.01');
      if (idx84 >= 0) {
        const current = prev[idx84];
        const currentNetCredit = roundMoney((current.credit || 0) - (current.debit || 0) + diff);
        const updated: OpeningBalanceEntry =
          currentNetCredit >= 0
            ? { ...current, debit: 0, credit: currentNetCredit }
            : { ...current, debit: Math.abs(currentNetCredit), credit: 0 };
        const copy = [...prev];
        copy[idx84] = updated;
        return copy;
      }

      return [
        ...prev,
        {
          id: `ob-84-auto-${Date.now()}`,
          accountCode: '84.01',
          subconto1: 'Нераспределенная прибыль (автобалансировка)',
          debit: diff < 0 ? Math.abs(diff) : 0,
          credit: diff > 0 ? diff : 0,
          comment: 'Автоматическое выравнивание валюты начального баланса',
        },
      ];
    });
  }, []);

  const applyImported1CData = useCallback((payload: ApplyImported1CPayload) => {
    if (payload.organizationPatch) {
      const cleanPatch: Partial<OrganizationCard> = {};
      for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(payload.organizationPatch)) {
        if (val !== undefined && val !== '') {
          (cleanPatch as Record<string, unknown>)[key] = val;
        }
      }
      if (cleanPatch.name || cleanPatch.shortName) {
        cleanPatch.substituteStudentInOrgName = false;
      }
      if (Object.keys(cleanPatch).length > 0) {
        setOrganization((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...cleanPatch }));
      }
    }

    let normalizedIncoming: OpeningBalanceEntry[] | undefined;
    if (payload.openingBalances && payload.openingBalances.length > 0) {
      normalizedIncoming = payload.openingBalances.map((row, idx) => ({
        ...row,
        id: row.id || `ob-1c-${Date.now()}-${idx}`,
        accountCode: row.accountCode.trim(),
        debit: roundMoney(Number(row.debit) || 0),
        credit: roundMoney(Number(row.credit) || 0),
      }));

      if (payload.mergeMode === 'merge') {
        const incList = normalizedIncoming;
        setOpeningBalances((prev) => {
          const incomingAccountsWithSubconto = new Set(
            incList.filter((r) => Boolean(r.subconto1 || r.subconto2)).map((r) => r.accountCode)
          );
          const incomingSingleAccounts = new Set(
            incList.filter((r) => !r.subconto1 && !r.subconto2).map((r) => r.accountCode)
          );

          const result: OpeningBalanceEntry[] = prev.filter((existing) => {
            if (
              incomingSingleAccounts.has(existing.accountCode) &&
              !existing.subconto1 &&
              !existing.subconto2
            ) {
              return false;
            }
            if (
              incomingAccountsWithSubconto.has(existing.accountCode) &&
              !existing.subconto1 &&
              !existing.subconto2
            ) {
              return false;
            }
            return true;
          });

          for (const inc of incList) {
            const matchIdx = result.findIndex(
              (r) =>
                r.accountCode === inc.accountCode &&
                normalizeEntityKey(r.subconto1) === normalizeEntityKey(inc.subconto1) &&
                normalizeEntityKey(r.subconto2) === normalizeEntityKey(inc.subconto2)
            );
            if (matchIdx >= 0) {
              result[matchIdx] = { ...result[matchIdx], ...inc, id: result[matchIdx].id };
            } else {
              result.push(inc);
            }
          }
          return result;
        });
      } else {
        setOpeningBalances(normalizedIncoming);
      }
    }

    if (
      (payload.counterparties && payload.counterparties.length > 0) ||
      (payload.employees && payload.employees.length > 0)
    ) {
      setBaseDirectories((prev) => {
        const mergedCounterparties = [...prev.counterparties];
        for (const incCp of payload.counterparties ?? []) {
          const cleanInn = (incCp.inn || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
          const normName = normalizeEntityKey(incCp.name);
          const idx = mergedCounterparties.findIndex((existing) => {
            const exInn = (existing.inn || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
            if (cleanInn.length >= 10 && exInn === cleanInn) return true;
            return normName.length > 0 && normalizeEntityKey(existing.name) === normName;
          });

          if (idx >= 0) {
            const cur = mergedCounterparties[idx];
            mergedCounterparties[idx] = {
              ...cur,
              name: incCp.name || cur.name,
              fullName: incCp.fullName || cur.fullName,
              inn: cleanInn.length >= 10 ? incCp.inn : cur.inn,
              kpp: incCp.kpp || cur.kpp,
              bankAccount: incCp.bankAccount || cur.bankAccount,
              bankName: incCp.bankName || cur.bankName,
              bik: incCp.bik || cur.bik,
              contractKind: incCp.contractKind || cur.contractKind,
              contractNumber: incCp.contractNumber || cur.contractNumber,
              contractDate: incCp.contractDate || cur.contractDate,
            };
          } else {
            mergedCounterparties.push({
              ...incCp,
              id: incCp.id || `cp-1c-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
            });
          }
        }

        const mergedEmployees = [...prev.employees];
        for (const incEmp of payload.employees ?? []) {
          const normEmpName = normalizeEntityKey(incEmp.fullName);
          const idx = mergedEmployees.findIndex(
            (existing) =>
              normEmpName.length > 0 && normalizeEntityKey(existing.fullName) === normEmpName
          );
          if (idx >= 0) {
            const cur = mergedEmployees[idx];
            mergedEmployees[idx] = {
              ...cur,
              position: incEmp.position || cur.position,
              department: incEmp.department || cur.department,
              salary: incEmp.salary > 0 ? incEmp.salary : cur.salary,
              hireDate: incEmp.hireDate || cur.hireDate,
              costAccount: incEmp.costAccount || cur.costAccount,
              nomenclatureGroup: incEmp.nomenclatureGroup || cur.nomenclatureGroup,
            };
          } else {
            mergedEmployees.push({
              ...incEmp,
              id: incEmp.id || `emp-1c-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
            });
          }
        }

        return {
          ...prev,
          counterparties: mergedCounterparties,
          employees: mergedEmployees,
        };
      });
    }

    if (payload.synced1CPatch) {
      const rev = payload.synced1CPatch.revision || `upload-${Date.now()}`;
      syncedRevisionRef.current = rev;
      setSynced1C((prev) => {
        const mappedCps =
          payload.synced1CPatch?.counterparties ??
          (payload.counterparties
            ? payload.counterparties.map((cp) => ({
                name: cp.name,
                fullName: cp.fullName,
                inn: cp.inn,
                kpp: cp.kpp,
                bankAccount: cp.bankAccount,
                bik: cp.bik,
                bankName: cp.bankName,
                contracts: cp.contractNumber
                  ? [{ number: cp.contractNumber, date: cp.contractDate, kind: cp.contractKind }]
                  : [],
              }))
            : (prev?.counterparties ?? []));

        return {
          revision: rev,
          syncedAt: payload.synced1CPatch?.syncedAt || new Date().toISOString(),
          source: payload.synced1CPatch?.source || 'file-upload',
          isNormalizedSnapshot: true,
          organization:
            payload.synced1CPatch?.organization ?? payload.organizationPatch ?? prev?.organization,
          counterparties: mappedCps,
          openingBalances:
            payload.synced1CPatch?.openingBalances ??
            normalizedIncoming ??
            prev?.openingBalances ??
            [],
          endBalances: payload.synced1CPatch?.endBalances ?? prev?.endBalances,
          aprilPostings: payload.synced1CPatch?.aprilPostings ?? prev?.aprilPostings ?? [],
          hasMonthEndClosing:
            payload.synced1CPatch?.hasMonthEndClosing ?? prev?.hasMonthEndClosing,
          allDocuments: payload.synced1CPatch?.allDocuments ?? prev?.allDocuments ?? [],
          directories1C: payload.synced1CPatch?.directories1C ?? {
            counterparties: mappedCps,
            nomenclature: prev?.directories1C?.nomenclature ?? [],
            employees: prev?.directories1C?.employees ?? [],
          },
          registers1C: payload.synced1CPatch?.registers1C ?? prev?.registers1C ?? {},
        };
      });
    }
  }, []);

  const selectOperationAndNavigate = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setActiveOperationId(id);
    setActiveTab('navigator');
  }, []);

  const setOperationStatus = useCallback((id: string, status: OperationStatus) => {
    setRawOperations((prev) => {
      const existsInRaw = prev.some((op) => op.id === id);
      if (!existsInRaw) return prev;
      return prev.map((op) => (op.id === id ? { ...op, status } : op));
    });
    setClosingOperationStatuses((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [id]: status,
    }));
  }, []);

  const toggleOperationDone = useCallback(
    (id: string) => {
      const target = operations.find((op) => op.id === id);
      if (!target) return;
      if (target.status === 'needs_data') return;
      const nextStatus: OperationStatus = target.status === 'done' ? 'pending' : 'done';
      setOperationStatus(id, nextStatus);
    },
    [operations, setOperationStatus]
  );

  const markAllOperationsDone = useCallback(() => {
    setRawOperations((prev) =>
      prev.map((op) => (op.status === 'needs_data' ? op : { ...op, status: 'done' }))
    );
    setClosingOperationStatuses((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      for (const cop of closingOperations) {
        next[cop.id] = 'done';
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, [closingOperations]);

  const resetAllOperationsStatus = useCallback(() => {
    setRawOperations((prev) =>
      prev.map((op) => (op.status === 'needs_data' ? op : { ...op, status: 'pending' }))
    );
    setClosingOperationStatuses({});
  }, []);

  const updateOperation = useCallback((id: string, patch: Partial<BusinessOperation>) => {
    setRawOperations((prev) => prev.map((op) => (op.id === id ? { ...op, ...patch } : op)));
  }, []);

  const toggleDirectoryItemCreated = useCallback((idOrCategory: string, maybeId?: string) => {
    const targetId = maybeId ?? idOrCategory;
    setCreatedDirectoryMap((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [targetId]: !prev[targetId],
    }));
  }, []);

  const addCounterparty = useCallback(
    (item: Omit<CounterpartyCard1C, 'id'> & { id?: string }) => {
      const id = item.id || `cp-custom-${Date.now()}`;
      setBaseDirectories((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        counterparties: [...prev.counterparties, { ...item, id }],

    },
    []
  );

  const addNomenclature = useCallback(
    (item: Omit<NomenclatureCard1C, 'id'> & { id?: string }) => {
      const id = item.id || `nom-custom-${Date.now()}`;
      setBaseDirectories((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        nomenclature: [...prev.nomenclature, { ...item, id }],
      }));
    },
    []
  );

  const addEmployee = useCallback((item: Omit<EmployeeCard1C, 'id'> & { id?: string }) => {
    const id = item.id || `emp-custom-${Date.now()}`;
    setBaseDirectories((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      employees: [...prev.employees, { ...item, id }],
    }));
  }, []);

  const updateUserOsvInput = useCallback(
    (accountCode: string, patch: Partial<UserOsvInputRow>) => {
      setUserOsvInputs((prev) => {
        const existing = prev[accountCode] ?? { accountCode };
        return {
          ...prev,
          [accountCode]: {
            ...existing,
            ...patch,
            accountCode,
          },
        };
      });
    },
    []
  );

  const clearUserOsvInputs = useCallback(() => {
    setUserOsvInputs({});
  }, []);

  const fillUserOsvFromReference = useCallback(() => {
    const next: Record<string, UserOsvInputRow> = {};
    for (const row of referenceOsvReport.rows) {
      if (row.isGroup) continue;
      next[row.accountCode] = {
        accountCode: row.accountCode,
        turnoverDebit: row.turnoverDebit,
        turnoverCredit: row.turnoverCredit,
        endDebit: row.endDebit,
        endCredit: row.endCredit,
      };
    }
    setUserOsvInputs(next);
  }, [referenceOsvReport]);

  const simulateTypicalAdvanceErrorInOsv = useCallback(() => {
    const advanceAmount = 1236900;
    const next: Record<string, UserOsvInputRow> = {};
    for (const row of referenceOsvReport.rows) {
      if (row.isGroup) continue;
      next[row.accountCode] = {
        accountCode: row.accountCode,
        turnoverDebit: row.turnoverDebit,
        turnoverCredit: row.turnoverCredit,
        endDebit: row.endDebit,
        endCredit: row.endCredit,
      };
    }

    const ref6001 = next['60.01'] ?? {
      accountCode: '60.01',
      turnoverDebit: 0,
      turnoverCredit: 0,
      endDebit: 0,
      endCredit: 0,
    };
    const ref6002 = next['60.02'] ?? {
      accountCode: '60.02',
      turnoverDebit: 0,
      turnoverCredit: 0,
      endDebit: 0,
      endCredit: 0,
    };

    next['60.01'] = {
      ...ref6001,
      turnoverDebit: roundMoney(Math.max(0, (ref6001.turnoverDebit ?? 0) - advanceAmount)),
      endCredit: roundMoney((ref6001.endCredit ?? 0) + advanceAmount),
    };
    next['60.02'] = {
      ...ref6002,
      turnoverCredit: roundMoney(Math.max(0, (ref6002.turnoverCredit ?? 0) - advanceAmount)),
      endDebit: roundMoney((ref6002.endDebit ?? 0) + advanceAmount),
    };

    setUserOsvInputs(next);
  }, [referenceOsvReport]);

  const setUploadedImageDataUrl = useCallback((dataUrl: string | null) => {
    setUploadedImageState(dataUrl);
    void saveUploadedImageToIdb(dataUrl);
  }, []);

  const loadDemoScenario = useCallback((presetId: string) => {
    const preset =
      DEMO_SCENARIOS.find((p) => p.id === presetId) ?? DEFAULT_DEMO_SCENARIO;
    setActivePresetId(preset.id);
    setTaskTitle(preset.title);
    setOrganization(preset.organization);
    setOpeningBalances(preset.openingBalances);
    setRawOperations(preset.operations);
    setClosingOperationStatuses({});
    setIncludeAutoClosing(false);
    setBaseDirectories(preset.directories);
    setCreatedDirectoryMap({});
    setActiveOperationId(preset.operations[0]?.id ?? '');
    setUserOsvInputs({});
    syncedRevisionRef.current = null;
    setSynced1C(null);
    setUploadedImageState(null);
    void saveUploadedImageToIdb(null);
  }, []);

  const resetToDefaultDemo = useCallback(() => {
    clearPersistedState();
    loadDemoScenario(DEFAULT_DEMO_SCENARIO.id);
    setChatMessages([INITIAL_WELCOME_MESSAGE]);
    void fetch('/api/1c-sync?clear=1', { method: 'POST' }).catch(() => undefined);
  }, [loadDemoScenario]);

  const importParsedTask = useCallback(
    (payload: ImportTaskPayload) => {
      setActivePresetId('custom-imported-task');
      if (payload.title) {
        setTaskTitle(payload.title);
      }
      if (payload.organizationPatch) {
        setOrganization((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...payload.organizationPatch }));
      }
      if (payload.openingBalances) {
        setOpeningBalances(payload.openingBalances);
      }
      setRawOperations(payload.operations);
      setClosingOperationStatuses({});
      setIncludeAutoClosing(false);
      setBaseDirectories({
        counterparties: payload.directories?.counterparties ?? [],
        nomenclature: payload.directories?.nomenclature ?? [],
        nomenclatureGroups: payload.directories?.nomenclatureGroups ?? [],
        expenseItems: payload.directories?.expenseItems ?? [],
        cashFlowItems: payload.directories?.cashFlowItems ?? [],
        employees: payload.directories?.employees ?? [],
      });
      setCreatedDirectoryMap({});
      setActiveOperationId(payload.operations[0]?.id ?? '');
      setUserOsvInputs({});
      setActiveTab('navigator');
      if (payload.uploadedImageDataUrl !== undefined) {
        setUploadedImageDataUrl(payload.uploadedImageDataUrl);
      }
    },
    [setUploadedImageDataUrl]
  );

  const addChatMessage = useCallback(
    (msg: Omit<ChatMessage, 'id' | 'timestamp'> & { id?: string; timestamp?: string }) => {
      const fullMsg: ChatMessage = {
        id: msg.id || `chat-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
        role: msg.role,
        content: msg.content,
        timestamp: msg.timestamp || new Date().toISOString(),
        relatedOperationNumber: msg.relatedOperationNumber,
      };
      setChatMessages((prev) => [...prev, fullMsg]);
    },
    []
  );

  const clearChatMessages = useCallback(() => {
    setChatMessages([INITIAL_WELCOME_MESSAGE]);
  }, []);

  const updateAiConfig = useCallback((patch: Partial<AiProviderConfig>) => {
    setAiConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...patch }));
  }, []);

  const setTheme = useCallback((nextTheme: 'light' | 'dark') => {
    setThemeState(nextTheme);
  }, []);

  const toggleTheme = useCallback(() => {
    setThemeState((prev) => (prev === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'));
  }, []);

  const saveSnapshotNow = useCallback(
    async (label?: string) => {
      const savedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      const snapshotState: PersistedAccountantState = {
        version: 3,
        activePresetId,
        taskTitle,
        organization,
        openingBalances,
        rawOperations,
        closingOperationStatuses,
        includeAutoClosing,
        baseDirectories: directories,
        activeOperationId,
        activeTab,
        osvMode,
        userOsvInputs,
        synced1C,
        chatMessages,
        aiConfig,
        theme,
        savedAt,
      };
      savePersistedState(snapshotState);
      setLastSavedAt(savedAt);
      await saveBackupSnapshotToIdb(
        `snap-${Date.now()}`,
        label || `${taskTitle} (${new Date().toLocaleTimeString('ru-RU')})`,
        snapshotState
      );
    },
    [
      activePresetId,
      taskTitle,
      organization,
      openingBalances,
      rawOperations,
      closingOperationStatuses,
      includeAutoClosing,
      directories,
      activeOperationId,
      activeTab,
      osvMode,
      userOsvInputs,
      synced1C,
      chatMessages,
      aiConfig,
      theme,
    ]
  );

  const value = useMemo<AccountantContextValue>(
    () => ({
      isHydrated,
      activePresetId,
      demoScenarios: DEMO_SCENARIOS,
      taskTitle,
      organization,
      effectiveOrganization,
      openingBalances,
      rawOperations,
      operations,
      includeAutoClosing,
      directories,
      activeOperationId,
      activeOperation,
      activeTab,
      osvMode,
      osvReport,
      referenceOsvReport,
      userOsvInputs,
      reconciliation,
      synced1C,
      isSyncing1C,
      requisiteReport,
      auditReport,
      chatMessages,
      aiConfig,
      theme,
      lastSavedAt,
      uploadedImageDataUrl,

      setTaskTitle,
      setOrganization,
      updateOrganization,
      setOpeningBalances,
      addOpeningBalance,
      updateOpeningBalance,
      removeOpeningBalance,
      clearOpeningBalances,
      balanceOpeningDifferenceTo84,
      applyImported1CData,

      refreshFrom1CSync,
      simulate1CSyncWithSampleErrors,
      clear1CSyncSnapshot,

      setRawOperations,
      setIncludeAutoClosing,
      setActiveOperationId,
      selectOperationAndNavigate,
      setOperationStatus,
      toggleOperationDone,
      markAllOperationsDone,
      resetAllOperationsStatus,
      updateOperation,
      setActiveTab,

      toggleDirectoryItemCreated,
      addCounterparty,
      addNomenclature,
      addEmployee,

      setOsvMode,
      setUserOsvInputs,
      updateUserOsvInput,
      clearUserOsvInputs,
      fillUserOsvFromReference,
      simulateTypicalAdvanceErrorInOsv,

      loadDemoScenario,
      resetToDefaultDemo,
      importParsedTask,
      setUploadedImageDataUrl,
      addChatMessage,
      setChatMessages,
      clearChatMessages,
      updateAiConfig,
      setTheme,
      toggleTheme,
      saveSnapshotNow,
    }),
    [
      isHydrated,
      activePresetId,
      taskTitle,
      organization,
      effectiveOrganization,
      openingBalances,
      rawOperations,
      operations,
      includeAutoClosing,
      directories,
      activeOperationId,
      activeOperation,
      activeTab,
      osvMode,
      osvReport,
      referenceOsvReport,
      userOsvInputs,
      reconciliation,
      synced1C,
      isSyncing1C,
      requisiteReport,
      auditReport,
      chatMessages,
      aiConfig,
      theme,
      lastSavedAt,
      uploadedImageDataUrl,
      updateOrganization,
      addOpeningBalance,
      updateOpeningBalance,
      removeOpeningBalance,
      clearOpeningBalances,
      balanceOpeningDifferenceTo84,
      applyImported1CData,
      refreshFrom1CSync,
      simulate1CSyncWithSampleErrors,
      clear1CSyncSnapshot,
      selectOperationAndNavigate,
      setOperationStatus,
      toggleOperationDone,
      markAllOperationsDone,
      resetAllOperationsStatus,
      updateOperation,
      toggleDirectoryItemCreated,
      addCounterparty,
      addNomenclature,
      addEmployee,
      updateUserOsvInput,
      clearUserOsvInputs,
      fillUserOsvFromReference,
      simulateTypicalAdvanceErrorInOsv,
      loadDemoScenario,
      resetToDefaultDemo,
      importParsedTask,
      setUploadedImageDataUrl,
      addChatMessage,
      clearChatMessages,
      updateAiConfig,
      setTheme,
      toggleTheme,
      saveSnapshotNow,
    ]
  );

  return <AccountantContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AccountantContext.Provider>;
}

export function useAccountant(): AccountantContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(AccountantContext);
  if (!ctx) {
    throw new Error('useAccountant must be used within an AccountantProvider');
  }
  return ctx;
}

export const ACCOUNT_MAP: Record<string, AccountInfo> = Object.fromEntries(
  CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS.map((acc) => [acc.code, acc])
);

export function getAccountInfo(code: string): AccountInfo {
  const normalized = code.trim();
  if (ACCOUNT_MAP[normalized]) {
    return ACCOUNT_MAP[normalized];
  }

  const rootCode = normalized.includes('.') ? normalized.split('.')[0] : undefined;
  const parentInfo = rootCode ? ACCOUNT_MAP[rootCode] : undefined;

  return {
    code: normalized,
    name: parentInfo ? `${parentInfo.name} (${normalized})` : `Счет ${normalized}`,
    parentCode: parentInfo?.isGroup ? rootCode : undefined,
    type: parentInfo?.type ?? 'active-passive',
    subconto: parentInfo?.subconto ?? [],
    category: parentInfo?.category ?? 'Прочие счета',
    isGroup: false,
  };
}

=== FILE: src\lib\ai\localExpertChat.ts ===
import type {
  BusinessOperation,
  ChatMessage,
  OpeningBalanceEntry,
  OrganizationCard,
  OsvDiscrepancy,
} from '@/types/accounting';

export interface ChatContextPayload {
  organization?: OrganizationCard;
  openingBalances?: OpeningBalanceEntry[];
  activeOperation?: BusinessOperation | null;
  operationsSummary?: unknown;
  osvSummary?: unknown;
  discrepancies?: OsvDiscrepancy[];
}

function fmtRub(amount: number | undefined | null): string {
  const num = typeof amount === 'number' && Number.isFinite(amount) ? amount : 0;
  return `${num.toLocaleString('ru-RU', {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })} ₽`;
}

export function stringifyOperationsSummary(summary: unknown): string {
  if (!summary) return 'Список операций не передан.';
  if (typeof summary === 'string') return summary;
  if (Array.isArray(summary)) {
    return summary
      .slice(0, 20)
      .map((item) => {
        if (typeof item === 'string') return `- ${item}`;
        if (item && typeof item === 'object') {
          const rec = item as Record<string, unknown>;
          const num = rec.number ?? '?';
          const date = rec.date ?? '';
          const desc = rec.rawDescription ?? rec.description ?? '';
          const amt =
            typeof rec.resolvedAmount === 'number'
              ? fmtRub(rec.resolvedAmount)
              : typeof rec.amount === 'number'
                ? fmtRub(rec.amount)
                : '';
          const status = rec.status ? ` [${String(rec.status)}]` : '';
          return `- Оп. №${String(num)} (${String(date)}): ${String(desc)} — ${amt}${status}`;
        }
        return '';
      })
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join('\n');
  }
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(summary);
  } catch {
    return String(summary);
  }
}

export function stringifyOsvSummary(osvSummary: unknown): string {
  if (!osvSummary) return 'Сводка ОСВ не передана.';
  if (typeof osvSummary === 'string') return osvSummary;
  if (typeof osvSummary === 'object') {
    const rec = osvSummary as Record<string, unknown>;
    const lines: string[] = [];
    if (typeof rec.totalStartDebit === 'number' || typeof rec.totalEndDebit === 'number') {
      lines.push(
        `Итого Сальдо нач.: Дт ${fmtRub(rec.totalStartDebit as number)} / Кт ${fmtRub(rec.totalStartCredit as number)}`
      );
      lines.push(
        `Итого Обороты: Дт ${fmtRub(rec.totalTurnoverDebit as number)} / Кт ${fmtRub(rec.totalTurnoverCredit as number)}`
      );
      lines.push(
        `Итого Сальдо кон.: Дт ${fmtRub(rec.totalEndDebit as number)} / Кт ${fmtRub(rec.totalEndCredit as number)}`
      );
    }
    if (Array.isArray(rec.rows)) {
      const leafRows = rec.rows
        .filter((r): r is Record<string, unknown> => Boolean(r && typeof r === 'object' && !r.isGroup))
        .slice(0, 25);
      for (const r of leafRows) {
        lines.push(
          `Счет ${String(r.accountCode)}: нач Дт ${fmtRub(r.startDebit as number)} Кт ${fmtRub(r.startCredit as number)} | обор Дт ${fmtRub(r.turnoverDebit as number)} Кт ${fmtRub(r.turnoverCredit as number)} | кон Дт ${fmtRub(r.endDebit as number)} Кт ${fmtRub(r.endCredit as number)}${r.hasRedBalance ? ' [КРАСНОТА!]' : ''}`
        );
      }
    }
    if (lines.length > 0) return lines.join('\n');
    try {
      return JSON.stringify(osvSummary);
    } catch {
      return String(osvSummary);
    }
  }
  return String(osvSummary);
}

export function buildChatSystemPrompt(context?: ChatContextPayload): string {
  const org = context?.organization;
