function hashString(str: string): number {
  let h = 2166136261;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    h ^= str.charCodeAt(i);
    h = Math.imul(h, 16777619);
  }
  return Math.abs(h >>> 0);
}

/**
 * Generates a valid 10-digit Russian legal-entity INN with an authentic ФНС РФ control digit
 * so 1C:Бухгалтерия 8.3 accepts it without checksum warnings when pasted by the student.
 */
function generateValidRussianInn10(seed: number): string {
  const regions = ['78', '77', '50', '54', '66', '23', '16'];
  const region = regions[seed % regions.length];
  const inspectorate = String(10 + ((seed >>> 3) % 39)).padStart(2, '0');
  const serial = String(10000 + ((seed >>> 7) % 89999)).padStart(5, '0');
  const first9 = `${region}${inspectorate}${serial}`;
  const weights = [2, 4, 10, 3, 5, 9, 4, 6, 8];
  let sum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
    sum += Number(first9[i]) * weights[i];
  }
  const checkDigit = (sum % 11) % 10;
  return `${first9}${checkDigit}`;
}

function generateValidRussianInn12ForIp(seed: number): string {
  const first10 =
    '78' +
    String(15 + (seed % 30)).padStart(2, '0') +
    String(100000 + ((seed >>> 4) % 899999)).padStart(6, '0');
  const w11 = [7, 2, 4, 10, 3, 5, 9, 4, 6, 8];
  const d11 =
    (w11.reduce((acc, w, idx) => acc + Number(first10[idx]) * w, 0) % 11) % 10;
  const first11 = `${first10}${d11}`;
  const w12 = [3, 7, 2, 4, 10, 3, 5, 9, 4, 6, 8];
  const d12 =
    (w12.reduce((acc, w, idx) => acc + Number(first11[idx]) * w, 0) % 11) % 10;
  return `${first11}${d12}`;
}

function expandFullLegalName(shortName: string): string {
  const trimmed = shortName.trim();
  if (/^ООО\s+/i.test(trimmed)) {
    return trimmed.replace(/^ООО\s+/i, 'Общество с ограниченной ответственностью ');
  }
  if (/^АО\s+/i.test(trimmed)) {
    return trimmed.replace(/^АО\s+/i, 'Акционерное общество ');
  }
  if (/^ПАО\s+/i.test(trimmed)) {
    return trimmed.replace(/^ПАО\s+/i, 'Публичное акционерное общество ');
  }
  if (/^ЗАО\s+/i.test(trimmed)) {
    return trimmed.replace(/^ЗАО\s+/i, 'Закрытое акционерное общество ');
  }
  if (/^ИП\s+/i.test(trimmed)) {
    return trimmed.replace(/^ИП\s+/i, 'Индивидуальный предприниматель ');
  }
  return trimmed;
}

function normalizeEntityKey(str: string): string {
  return (str || '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/ё/g, 'е')
    .replace(/[«»"'`]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

function isIgnoredCounterpartyName(name: string): boolean {
  const norm = normalizeEntityKey(name);
  if (!norm || norm.length < 3) return true;
  return /^(налог\s*\(|бюджет|основной договор|поставщик|покупатель|сотрудники|работники|персонал|прочие|расчеты)/i.test(
    norm
  );
}

function parseContractDetails(
  rawContract?: string,
  fallbackDate = '01.04.2026'
): { contractNumber: string; contractDate: string } {
  if (!rawContract || !rawContract.trim()) {
    return { contractNumber: 'Основной договор', contractDate: fallbackDate };
  }
  const trimmed = rawContract.trim();
  const dateMatch = /от\s+(\d{1,2}\.\d{1,2}\.\d{4})/i.exec(trimmed);
  const contractDate = dateMatch ? dateMatch[1] : fallbackDate;

  const numPart = trimmed.replace(/\s*от\s+\d{1,2}\.\d{1,2}\.\d{4}.*$/i, '').trim();
  const contractNumber = /^(договор|счет|исполнительн|налогов)/i.test(numPart)
    ? numPart
    : numPart.startsWith('№')
      ? `Договор ${numPart}`
      : `Договор №${numPart}`;

  return { contractNumber, contractDate };
}

interface InlineRequisites {
  inn?: string;
  kpp?: string;
  bankAccount?: string;
  bik?: string;
}

function extractInlineRequisitesFromText(text: string): InlineRequisites {
  const innMatch = /ИНН\s*(\d{10}|\d{12})\b/i.exec(text);
  const kppMatch = /КПП\s*(\d{9})\b/i.exec(text);
  const rsMatch = /(?:р\/сч?|расч\.\s*счет)\s*(\d{20})\b/i.exec(text);
  const bikMatch = /БИК\s*(\d{9})\b/i.exec(text);
  return {
    inn: innMatch ? innMatch[1] : undefined,
    kpp: kppMatch ? kppMatch[1] : undefined,
    bankAccount: rsMatch ? rsMatch[1] : undefined,
    bik: bikMatch ? bikMatch[1] : undefined,
  };
}

function buildFallbackCounterpartyCard(
  name: string,
  contractKind: CounterpartyCard1C['contractKind'],
  rawContract: string | undefined,
  fallbackDate: string,
  inlineReq?: InlineRequisites
): CounterpartyCard1C {
  const cleanName = name.trim();
  const seed = hashString(normalizeEntityKey(cleanName));
  const isIp = /^ИП\s+/i.test(cleanName);
  const inn =
    inlineReq?.inn ||
    (isIp ? generateValidRussianInn12ForIp(seed) : generateValidRussianInn10(seed));
  const kpp =
    inlineReq?.kpp ??
    (isIp ? '' : `${inn.slice(0, 4)}01001`);
  const bank = RUSSIAN_BANKS[seed % RUSSIAN_BANKS.length];
  const bankTail = String(100000 + ((seed >>> 5) % 899999)).padStart(6, '0');
  const { contractNumber, contractDate } = parseContractDetails(rawContract, fallbackDate);

  const bankName =
    inlineReq?.bik === '044030001'
      ? 'СЕВЕРО-ЗАПАДНОЕ ГУ БАНКА РОССИИ // УФК по г. Санкт-Петербургу'
      : bank.bankName;

  return {
    id: `cp-auto-${seed}-${hashString(contractNumber) % 10000}`,
    name: cleanName,
    fullName: expandFullLegalName(cleanName),
    inn,
    kpp,
    bankAccount: inlineReq?.bankAccount || `${bank.bankPrefix}${bankTail}`,
    bankName,
    bik: inlineReq?.bik || bank.bik,
    contractKind,
    contractNumber,
    contractDate,
    createdIn1C: false,
  };
}

/**
 * Merges `baseDirectories` with 1C 8.3 reference cards auto-extracted from `operations`
 * and `openingBalances`, ensuring every Counterparty (with inline INN/KPP/BIK when present!),
 * Nomenclature item (Товары 41.01, Материалы 10.01, Услуги/Субподряд 20.01 & 26),
 * Nomenclature Group, Expense Item, Cash Flow Item, and Employee has copy-ready requisites.
 */
export function extractDirectoriesFromTask(
  operations: BusinessOperation[],
  openingBalances: OpeningBalanceEntry[],
  baseDirectories?: Partial<ExtractedDirectories1C>
): ExtractedDirectories1C {
  const counterparties: CounterpartyCard1C[] = (baseDirectories?.counterparties || []).map(
    (c) => ({ ...c })
  );
  const nomenclature: NomenclatureCard1C[] = (baseDirectories?.nomenclature || []).map(
    (n) => ({ ...n })
  );
  const employees: EmployeeCard1C[] = (baseDirectories?.employees || []).map((e) => ({
    ...e,
  }));

  const nomenclatureGroupSet = new Map<string, string>();
  const expenseItemSet = new Map<string, string>();
  const cashFlowItemSet = new Map<string, string>();

  const addUniqueString = (map: Map<string, string>, value?: string) => {
    const clean = (value || '').trim();
    if (!clean) return;
    const key = normalizeEntityKey(clean);
    if (!key) return;
    if (!map.has(key)) {
      map.set(key, clean);
    }
  };

  (baseDirectories?.nomenclatureGroups || []).forEach((g) =>
    addUniqueString(nomenclatureGroupSet, g)
  );
  (baseDirectories?.expenseItems || []).forEach((e) =>
    addUniqueString(expenseItemSet, e)
  );
  (baseDirectories?.cashFlowItems || []).forEach((c) =>
    addUniqueString(cashFlowItemSet, c)
  );

  const upsertCounterparty = (
    rawName: string,
    kind: CounterpartyCard1C['contractKind'],
    rawContract?: string,
    opDate = '01.04.2026',
    inlineReq?: InlineRequisites
  ) => {
    const reqFromName = extractInlineRequisitesFromText(rawName || '');
    const mergedReq: InlineRequisites = {
      inn: inlineReq?.inn || reqFromName.inn,
      kpp: inlineReq?.kpp || reqFromName.kpp,
      bankAccount: inlineReq?.bankAccount || reqFromName.bankAccount,
      bik: inlineReq?.bik || reqFromName.bik,
    };
    const name = (rawName || '')
      .replace(/\s*\((?:ИНН|КПП|р\/сч?|БИК|договор)[^)]*\)\s*$/i, '')
      .trim();

    if (isIgnoredCounterpartyName(name)) return;
    const normName = normalizeEntityKey(name);
    const parsedContract = rawContract
      ? parseContractDetails(rawContract, opDate)
      : undefined;

    const sameCompanyCards = counterparties.filter(
      (c) => normalizeEntityKey(c.name) === normName
    );

    if (sameCompanyCards.length > 0) {
      if (mergedReq.inn) sameCompanyCards[0].inn = mergedReq.inn;
      if (mergedReq.kpp) sameCompanyCards[0].kpp = mergedReq.kpp;
      if (mergedReq.bankAccount) sameCompanyCards[0].bankAccount = mergedReq.bankAccount;
      if (mergedReq.bik) sameCompanyCards[0].bik = mergedReq.bik;

      const placeholder = sameCompanyCards.find((c) =>
        /^(основной\s+договор|договор\s*№?1)$/i.test(c.contractNumber.trim())
      );
      if (
        placeholder &&
        parsedContract &&
        !/^(основной\s+договор|договор\s*№?1)$/i.test(parsedContract.contractNumber)
      ) {
        placeholder.contractNumber = parsedContract.contractNumber;
        placeholder.contractDate = parsedContract.contractDate;
      }
      return;
    }

    counterparties.push(
      buildFallbackCounterpartyCard(name, kind, rawContract, opDate, mergedReq)
    );
  };

  const upsertNomenclature = (card: Omit<NomenclatureCard1C, 'id'>) => {
    const cleanName = (card.name || '').trim();
    if (!cleanName || cleanName.length < 2) return;
    if (
      /^(основной склад|материалы|товары|услуги|оплата труда|страховые взносы|амортизация)$/i.test(
        cleanName
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }
    const normName = normalizeEntityKey(cleanName);
    const exists = nomenclature.some((n) => normalizeEntityKey(n.name) === normName);
    if (exists) return;

    nomenclature.push({
      ...card,
      id: `nom-auto-${hashString(normName) % 100000}`,
      name: cleanName,
      createdIn1C: false,
    });
  };

  // 1. Scan Opening Balances
  for (const ob of openingBalances) {
    if (ob.accountCode.startsWith('60') && ob.subconto1) {
      upsertCounterparty(ob.subconto1, 'С поставщиком', ob.subconto2, '15.01.2026');
    } else if (ob.accountCode.startsWith('62') && ob.subconto1) {
      upsertCounterparty(ob.subconto1, 'С покупателем', ob.subconto2, '15.01.2023');
    } else if (ob.accountCode.startsWith('76') && ob.subconto1) {
      upsertCounterparty(ob.subconto1, 'Прочее', ob.subconto2, '01.01.2026');
    } else if (ob.accountCode.startsWith('41') && ob.subconto1) {
      upsertNomenclature({
        name: ob.subconto1,
        kind: 'Товары',
        unit: 'шт.',
        accountCode: '41.01',
        vatAccountCode: '19.03',
        defaultVatRate: 20,
      });
    } else if (ob.accountCode.startsWith('10') && ob.subconto1) {
      upsertNomenclature({
        name: ob.subconto1,
        kind: 'Материалы',
        unit: 'шт.',
        accountCode: ob.accountCode === '10' ? '10.01' : ob.accountCode,
        vatAccountCode: '19.03',
        defaultVatRate: 20,
      });
    }
  }

  // 2. Scan Operations
  for (const op of operations) {
    if (op.isMonthEndClosing) continue;

    // Extract HR Hiring employees (e.g. Op 5: "Принят на работу главный бухгалтер (ФИО студента) с окладом 72 200")
    if (
      /принят[ао]?\s+на\s+работу/i.test(op.rawDescription) ||
      /прием\s+на\s+работу/i.test(op.documentType1C)
    ) {
      const salary = op.explicitAmount ?? op.resolvedAmount;
      if (salary > 0) {
        const isChiefAcc = /главн[ыйая]*\s+бухгалтер|главбух/i.test(op.rawDescription);
        const isProd = /прораб|рабоч|инженер|монтажник/i.test(op.rawDescription);
        const alreadyHasMatch = employees.some((e) =>
          isChiefAcc
            ? /главн[ыйая]*\s+бухгалтер|главбух/i.test(e.position) ||
              /фио\s+студента/i.test(e.fullName)
            : Math.abs(e.salary - salary) < 1
        );
        if (!alreadyHasMatch) {
          employees.push({
            id: `emp-auto-${op.id}`,
            fullName: isChiefAcc ? 'Главный бухгалтер (ФИО студента)' : 'Сотрудник организации',
            position: isChiefAcc ? 'Главный бухгалтер' : 'Специалист',
            department: isProd ? 'Основное производство' : 'Администрация',
            salary,
            hireDate: op.date,
            costAccount: isProd ? '20.01' : '26',
            createdIn1C: false,
          });
        }
      }
    }

    const inlineReq = extractInlineRequisitesFromText(op.rawDescription);

    // Check for tax office with explicit INN/KPP/BIK in rawDescription (e.g. МИ ФНС №10 по СПб)
    const taxOfficeMatch = /(МИ\s*ФНС\s*№\s*\d+\s*по\s*[А-Яа-яЁё.-]+|ИФНС\s*России\s*№\s*\d+[^,(]*)/i.exec(
      op.rawDescription
    );
    if (taxOfficeMatch && inlineReq.inn) {
      upsertCounterparty(
        taxOfficeMatch[1].trim(),
        'Прочее',
        'Налоговые платежи в бюджет',
        op.date,
        inlineReq
      );
    }

    const cpField = op.documentFields.find((f) =>
      /^(контрагент|поставщик|покупатель|заказчик|подрядчик|дебитор|кредитор|получатель)/i.test(
        f.label.trim()
      )
    );
    const contractField = op.documentFields.find((f) => /договор/i.test(f.label));
    const contractFromDescMatch =
      /(?:договор[ауеом]?|дог\.?)\s*(?:№|n|#)?\s*([0-9a-zа-я/-]+(?:\s+от\s+\d{1,2}\.\d{1,2}\.\d{4})?)/i.exec(
        op.rawDescription
      );
    const rawContract =
      contractField?.value ||
      (contractFromDescMatch ? `Договор №${contractFromDescMatch[1]}` : undefined);

    const touches60 = op.postings.some(
      (p) => p.debitAccount.startsWith('60') || p.creditAccount.startsWith('60')
    );
    const touches62 = op.postings.some(
      (p) => p.debitAccount.startsWith('62') || p.creditAccount.startsWith('62')
    );
    const cpKind: CounterpartyCard1C['contractKind'] = touches60
      ? 'С поставщиком'
      : touches62
        ? 'С покупателем'
        : 'Прочее';

    if (cpField?.value) {
      upsertCounterparty(cpField.value, cpKind, rawContract, op.date, inlineReq);
    } else {
      const entityRegex =
        /((?:ООО|АО|ПАО|ЗАО|ОАО)\s*[«"]([^»"]+)[»"]|ИП\s+[А-ЯЁ][а-яё]+\s+[А-ЯЁ]\.\s*[А-ЯЁ]\.)/g;
      let match: RegExpExecArray | null;
      while ((match = entityRegex.exec(op.rawDescription)) !== null) {
        upsertCounterparty(match[1], cpKind, rawContract, op.date, inlineReq);
      }
    }

    for (const p of op.postings) {
      if (p.debitAccount.startsWith('60') && p.debitSubconto[0]) {
        upsertCounterparty(
          p.debitSubconto[0],
          'С поставщиком',
          p.debitSubconto[1] || rawContract,
          op.date,
          inlineReq
        );
      }
      if (p.creditAccount.startsWith('60') && p.creditSubconto[0]) {
        upsertCounterparty(
          p.creditSubconto[0],
          'С поставщиком',
          p.creditSubconto[1] || rawContract,
          op.date,
          inlineReq
        );
      }
      if (p.debitAccount.startsWith('62') && p.debitSubconto[0]) {
        upsertCounterparty(
          p.debitSubconto[0],
          'С покупателем',
          p.debitSubconto[1] || rawContract,
          op.date,
          inlineReq
        );
      }
      if (p.creditAccount.startsWith('62') && p.creditSubconto[0]) {
        upsertCounterparty(
          p.creditSubconto[0],
          'С покупателем',
          p.creditSubconto[1] || rawContract,
          op.date,
          inlineReq
        );
      }
      if (p.creditAccount === '76.02' && p.creditSubconto[0]) {
        upsertCounterparty(
          p.creditSubconto[0],
          'Прочее',
          p.creditSubconto[1] || rawContract,
          op.date,
          inlineReq
        );
      }

      if (p.debitAccount.startsWith('41') && p.debitSubconto[0]) {
        upsertNomenclature({
          name: p.debitSubconto[0],
          kind: 'Товары',
          unit: op.vatBreakdown?.unit || 'шт.',
          accountCode: '41.01',
          vatAccountCode: '19.03',
          nomenclatureGroup: 'Оптовая торговля',
          defaultVatRate: op.vatBreakdown?.vatRate ?? 20,
        });
      }

      if (
        (p.debitAccount.startsWith('10') && p.debitSubconto[0]) ||
        (p.creditAccount.startsWith('10') && p.creditSubconto[0])
      ) {
        const matName = p.debitAccount.startsWith('10')
          ? p.debitSubconto[0]
          : p.creditSubconto[0];
        const matAcc = p.debitAccount.startsWith('10')
          ? p.debitAccount
          : p.creditAccount;
        upsertNomenclature({
          name: matName,
          kind: 'Материалы',
          unit: op.vatBreakdown?.unit || 'шт.',
          accountCode: matAcc === '10' ? '10.01' : matAcc,
          vatAccountCode: '19.03',
          expenseItem: 'Материальные расходы',
          defaultVatRate: op.vatBreakdown?.vatRate ?? 20,
        });
      }

      if (p.debitAccount === '20.01' || p.debitAccount === '20') {
        if (p.debitSubconto[0]) addUniqueString(nomenclatureGroupSet, p.debitSubconto[0]);
        if (p.debitSubconto[1]) addUniqueString(expenseItemSet, p.debitSubconto[1]);
      }

      if (p.debitAccount === '26' && p.debitSubconto[0]) {
        addUniqueString(expenseItemSet, p.debitSubconto[0]);
      }

      if (
        (p.creditAccount === '90.01.1' && p.creditSubconto[0]) ||
        (p.debitAccount === '90.02.1' && p.debitSubconto[0])
      ) {
        const grp =
          p.creditAccount === '90.01.1' ? p.creditSubconto[0] : p.debitSubconto[0];
        addUniqueString(nomenclatureGroupSet, grp);
      }

      if (p.debitAccount === '51' && p.debitSubconto[1]) {
        addUniqueString(cashFlowItemSet, p.debitSubconto[1]);
      }
      if (p.creditAccount === '51' && p.creditSubconto[1]) {
        addUniqueString(cashFlowItemSet, p.debitSubconto[1]);
      }
      if (p.debitAccount.startsWith('50') && p.debitSubconto[0]) {
        addUniqueString(cashFlowItemSet, p.debitSubconto[0]);
      }
      if (p.creditAccount.startsWith('50') && p.creditSubconto[0]) {
        addUniqueString(cashFlowItemSet, p.debitSubconto[0]);
      }
    }

    const isServicePurchase =
      touches60 &&
      op.postings.some((p) => p.debitAccount === '20.01' || p.debitAccount === '26');
    if (isServicePurchase) {
      const nomField = op.documentFields.find((f) =>
        /(номенклатур|услуг|работ|содержан)/i.test(f.label)
      );
      const objMatch = /объект[уе]?\s*[«"]([^»"]+)[»"]/i.exec(op.rawDescription);
      const costPosting = op.postings.find(
        (p) => p.debitAccount === '20.01' || p.debitAccount === '26'
      );
      const serviceName =
        nomField?.value ||
        (objMatch ? `Субподрядные работы по объекту «${objMatch[1]}»` : undefined);
      if (serviceName && costPosting) {
        upsertNomenclature({
          name: serviceName,
          kind: 'Услуги / Субподрядные работы',
          unit: op.vatBreakdown?.unit || 'усл.',
          accountCode: costPosting.debitAccount,
          vatAccountCode: '19.04',
          nomenclatureGroup:
            costPosting.debitAccount === '20.01'
              ? costPosting.debitSubconto[0] || (objMatch ? objMatch[1] : undefined)
              : undefined,
          expenseItem:
            costPosting.debitAccount === '20.01'
              ? costPosting.debitSubconto[1] || 'Субподрядные работы'
              : costPosting.debitSubconto[0] || 'Прочие расходы',
          defaultVatRate: op.vatBreakdown?.vatRate ?? 20,
        });
      }
    }

    const isWorksSale =
      op.postings.some((p) => p.creditAccount === '90.01.1') &&
      !op.postings.some((p) => p.creditAccount.startsWith('41'));
    if (isWorksSale) {
      const workField = op.documentFields.find((f) =>
        /(объект|наименован.*работ|номенклатур|содержан)/i.test(f.label)
      );
      const objMatch = /объект[уе]?\s*[«"]([^»"]+)[»"]/i.exec(op.rawDescription);
      const workName = workField?.value || (objMatch ? objMatch[1] : undefined);
      if (workName) {
        addUniqueString(nomenclatureGroupSet, workName);
        upsertNomenclature({
          name: workName,
          kind: 'Продукция / СМР',
          unit: 'компл.',
          accountCode: '20.01',
          vatAccountCode: '90.03',
          nomenclatureGroup: workName,
          defaultVatRate: op.vatBreakdown?.vatRate ?? 20,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  for (const n of nomenclature) {
    if (n.nomenclatureGroup) addUniqueString(nomenclatureGroupSet, n.nomenclatureGroup);
    if (n.expenseItem) addUniqueString(expenseItemSet, n.expenseItem);
  }
  for (const emp of employees) {
    if (emp.nomenclatureGroup) addUniqueString(nomenclatureGroupSet, emp.nomenclatureGroup);
  }

  if (nomenclatureGroupSet.size === 0) {
    addUniqueString(nomenclatureGroupSet, 'Основная номенклатурная группа');
  }
  [
    'Материальные расходы',
    'Оплата труда',
    'Страховые взносы',
    'Амортизация',
    'Субподрядные работы',
  ].forEach((item) => addUniqueString(expenseItemSet, item));

  [
    'Оплата товаров, работ, услуг, сырья и иных оборотных активов',
    'Поступление от продажи продукции и товаров, выполнения работ, оказания услуг',
    'Уплата налогов и взносов',
    'Оплата труда',
    'Получение наличных в банке',
  ].forEach((item) => addUniqueString(cashFlowItemSet, item));

  return {
    counterparties,
    nomenclature,
    nomenclatureGroups: Array.from(nomenclatureGroupSet.values()),
    expenseItems: Array.from(expenseItemSet.values()),
    cashFlowItems: Array.from(cashFlowItemSet.values()),
    employees,
  };
}

export * from "./auditEngine";

export function extractDirectoriesFromTask(
  rawOperations: any[] = [],
  openingBalances: any[] = [],
  baseDirectories?: any,
  synced1C?: any
): {
  counterparties: any[];
  employees: any[];
  nomenclature: any[];
  contracts: any[];
  bankAccounts: any[];
  nomenclatureGroups: any[];
  expenseItems: any[];
  cashFlowItems: any[];
} {
  const ops = Array.isArray(rawOperations) ? rawOperations : [];
  const balances = Array.isArray(openingBalances) ? openingBalances : [];

  const cp1CList: any[] =
    synced1C?.ВсеСправочники?.Контрагенты ||
    synced1C?.Контрагенты ||
    baseDirectories?.counterparties ||
    [];

  const emp1CList: any[] =
    synced1C?.ВсеСправочники?.Сотрудники ||
    synced1C?.Сотрудники ||
    baseDirectories?.employees ||
    [];

  const nom1CList: any[] =
    synced1C?.ВсеСправочники?.Номенклатура ||
    synced1C?.Номенклатура ||
    baseDirectories?.nomenclature ||
    [];

  const norm = (v: any) => String(v || "").trim().toLowerCase();

  // 1. Контрагенты
  const cpMap = new Map<string, any>();

  const upsertCp = (rawName: any, extra: any = {}) => {
    const name = String(rawName || "").trim();
    if (!name || name.length < 2) return;
    const key = norm(name);
    const existing = cpMap.get(key) || {
      id: `cp-${cpMap.size + 1}`,
      name,
      inn: "",
      kpp: "",
      bankAccount: "",
      bik: "",
      bankName: "",
      contractNumber: "",
      contractType: "",
      createdIn1C: false,
      missingFields: [],
    };

    const in1C = cp1CList.find((c: any) => {
      const cName = norm(typeof c === "string" ? c : c.Наименование || c.name);
      return cName && (cName.includes(key) || key.includes(cName));
    });

    const inn = extra.inn || in1C?.ИНН || in1C?.inn || existing.inn;
    const kpp = extra.kpp || in1C?.КПП || in1C?.kpp || existing.kpp;
    const bankAccount =
      extra.bankAccount ||
      in1C?.РасчетныйСчет ||
      in1C?.bankAccount ||
      existing.bankAccount;
    const bik = extra.bik || in1C?.БИК || in1C?.bik || existing.bik;
    const bankName =
      extra.bankName || in1C?.Банк || in1C?.bankName || existing.bankName;

    const missingFields: string[] = [];
    if (!inn) missingFields.push("ИНН");
    if (!kpp && String(inn).length !== 12) missingFields.push("КПП");
    if (!bankAccount) missingFields.push("Расчетный счет");
    if (!bik) missingFields.push("БИК");

    cpMap.set(key, {
      ...existing,
      ...extra,
      name,
      inn,
      kpp,
      bankAccount,
      bik,
      bankName,
      createdIn1C: Boolean(in1C || extra.createdIn1C || existing.createdIn1C),
      missingFields,
    });
  };

  cp1CList.forEach((c: any) => {
    const name = typeof c === "string" ? c : c.Наименование || c.name;
    upsertCp(name, { createdIn1C: true });
  });

  if (Array.isArray(baseDirectories?.counterparties)) {
    baseDirectories.counterparties.forEach((c: any) =>
      upsertCp(c.name || c.Наименование, c)
    );
  }

  ops.forEach((op: any) => {
    if (op.counterparty || op.Контрагент) {
      upsertCp(op.counterparty || op.Контрагент, {
        inn: op.inn || op.ИНН || "",
        kpp: op.kpp || op.КПП || "",
        bankAccount: op.bankAccount || op.РасчетныйСчет || "",
        bik: op.bik || op.БИК || "",
      });
    }
  });

  balances.forEach((b: any) => {
    const acc = String(b.account || b.Счет || "");
    if (acc.startsWith("60") || acc.startsWith("62") || acc.startsWith("76")) {
      const sub = b.subconto1 || b.Субконто1;
      if (sub && sub !== "null") upsertCp(sub);
    }
  });

  // 2. Сотрудники
  const empMap = new Map<string, any>();
  const upsertEmp = (rawName: any, extra: any = {}) => {
    const name = String(rawName || "").trim();
    if (!name || name.length < 2) return;
    const key = norm(name);
    const in1C = emp1CList.find((e: any) => {
      const eName = norm(typeof e === "string" ? e : e.Наименование || e.name);
      return eName && (eName.includes(key) || key.includes(eName));
    });
    const prev = empMap.get(key) || {
      id: `emp-${empMap.size + 1}`,
      name,
      position: "",
      salary: 0,
      createdIn1C: false,
    };
    empMap.set(key, {
      ...prev,
      ...extra,
      name,
      createdIn1C: Boolean(in1C || extra.createdIn1C || prev.createdIn1C),
    });
  };

  emp1CList.forEach((e: any) => {
    upsertEmp(typeof e === "string" ? e : e.Наименование || e.name, {
      createdIn1C: true,
    });
  });
  if (Array.isArray(baseDirectories?.employees)) {
    baseDirectories.employees.forEach((e: any) =>
      upsertEmp(e.name || e.Наименование, e)
    );
  }
  ops.forEach((op: any) => {
    if (op.employee || op.Сотрудник) upsertEmp(op.employee || op.Сотрудник);
  });

  // 3. Номенклатура
  const nomMap = new Map<string, any>();
  const upsertNom = (rawName: any, extra: any = {}) => {
    const name = String(rawName || "").trim();
    if (!name || name.length < 2) return;
    const key = norm(name);
    const in1C = nom1CList.find((n: any) => {
      const nName = norm(typeof n === "string" ? n : n.Наименование || n.name);
      return nName && (nName.includes(key) || key.includes(nName));
    });
    const prev = nomMap.get(key) || {
      id: `nom-${nomMap.size + 1}`,
      name,
      unit: "шт",
      vatRate: "20%",
      createdIn1C: false,
    };
    nomMap.set(key, {
      ...prev,
      ...extra,
      name,
      createdIn1C: Boolean(in1C || extra.createdIn1C || prev.createdIn1C),
    });
  };

  nom1CList.forEach((n: any) => {
    upsertNom(typeof n === "string" ? n : n.Наименование || n.name, {
      createdIn1C: true,
    });
  });
  if (Array.isArray(baseDirectories?.nomenclature)) {
    baseDirectories.nomenclature.forEach((n: any) =>
      upsertNom(n.name || n.Наименование, n)
    );
  }
  ops.forEach((op: any) => {
    if (op.nomenclature || op.Номенклатура)
      upsertNom(op.nomenclature || op.Номенклатура);
    if (Array.isArray(op.items)) {
      op.items.forEach((item: any) =>
        upsertNom(item.name || item.nomenclature || item.Номенклатура, item)
      );
    }
  });

  return {
    counterparties: Array.from(cpMap.values()),
    employees: Array.from(empMap.values()),
    nomenclature: Array.from(nomMap.values()),
    contracts: Array.isArray(baseDirectories?.contracts)
      ? baseDirectories.contracts
      : [],
    bankAccounts: Array.isArray(baseDirectories?.bankAccounts)
      ? baseDirectories.bankAccounts
      : [],
    nomenclatureGroups: Array.isArray(baseDirectories?.nomenclatureGroups)
      ? baseDirectories.nomenclatureGroups
      : Array.isArray(synced1C?.ВсеСправочники?.НоменклатурныеГруппы)
      ? synced1C.ВсеСправочники.НоменклатурныеГруппы
      : [],
    expenseItems: Array.isArray(baseDirectories?.expenseItems)
      ? baseDirectories.expenseItems
      : Array.isArray(synced1C?.ВсеСправочники?.СтатьиЗатрат)
      ? synced1C.ВсеСправочники.СтатьиЗатрат
      : [],
    cashFlowItems: Array.isArray(baseDirectories?.cashFlowItems)
      ? baseDirectories.cashFlowItems
      : Array.isArray(synced1C?.ВсеСправочники?.СтатьиДвиженияДенежныхСредств)
      ? synced1C.ВсеСправочники.СтатьиДвиженияДенежныхСредств
      : [],
  };
}

export function checkRequisitesCompleteness(
  organization: any = {},
  directories: any = {},
  synced1C?: any
): any {
  const org1C = synced1C?.Организация || {};
  const respPersons: any[] =
    synced1C?.РегистрыСведений?.ОтветственныеЛицаОрганизаций || [];

  const findResponsible = (roleKeyword: string) => {
    const found = respPersons.find((r: any) =>
      String(r.ОтветственноеЛицо || r.Должность || "")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(roleKeyword)
    );
    return found?.ФизическоеЛицо || found?.Сотрудник || "";
  };

  const orgName = org1C.Наименование || organization?.name || "";
  const orgInn = org1C.ИНН || organization?.inn || "";
  const orgKpp = org1C.КПП || organization?.kpp || "";
  const orgAccount = org1C.РасчетныйСчет || organization?.bankAccount || "";
  const orgBik = org1C.БИК || organization?.bik || "";
  const orgBank = org1C.Банк || organization?.bankName || "";
  const director =
    organization?.director || findResponsible("руководитель") || "";
  const chiefAccountant =
    organization?.chiefAccountant || findResponsible("бухгалтер") || "";

  const orgMissing: string[] = [];
  const orgFilled: string[] = [];
  (orgName ? orgFilled : orgMissing).push("Наименование");
  (orgInn ? orgFilled : orgMissing).push("ИНН");
  if (String(orgInn).length !== 12) {
    (orgKpp ? orgFilled : orgMissing).push("КПП");
  }
  (orgAccount ? orgFilled : orgMissing).push("Расчетный счет");
  (orgBik ? orgFilled : orgMissing).push("БИК");
  (director ? orgFilled : orgMissing).push("Руководитель");
  (chiefAccountant ? orgFilled : orgMissing).push("Главный бухгалтер");

  const organizationCheck = {
    entityId: organization?.id || "org-main",
    entityType: "organization" as const,
    entityName: orgName || "Наша организация",
    missingFields: orgMissing,
    filledFields: orgFilled,
    isComplete: orgMissing.length === 0,
    status: orgMissing.length === 0 ? "complete" : "incomplete",
  };

  const organizationReport = {
    ...organizationCheck,
    name: orgName,
    inn: orgInn,
    kpp: orgKpp,
    bankAccount: orgAccount,
    bik: orgBik,
    bankName: orgBank,
    director,
    chiefAccountant,
  };

  const cp1CList: any[] =
    synced1C?.ВсеСправочники?.Контрагенты || synced1C?.Контрагенты || [];
  const contracts1C: any[] =
    synced1C?.ВсеСправочники?.ДоговорыКонтрагентов || [];
  const accounts1C: any[] =
    synced1C?.ВсеСправочники?.БанковскиеСчета || [];

  const dirCounterparties: any[] = Array.isArray(directories?.counterparties)
    ? directories.counterparties
    : [];

  const counterpartyChecks = dirCounterparties.map((cp: any, idx: number) => {
    const name = String(cp.name || cp.Наименование || "").trim();
    const normName = name.toLowerCase();

    const matched1C = cp1CList.find((c: any) => {
      const cName = String(c.Наименование || c.name || "").toLowerCase();
      return cName && (cName.includes(normName) || normName.includes(cName));
    });

    const matchedAcc = accounts1C.find((a: any) =>
      String(a.Владелец || "").toLowerCase().includes(normName)
    );

    const matchedContract = contracts1C.find((d: any) =>
      String(d.Владелец || "").toLowerCase().includes(normName)
    );

    const inn = matched1C?.ИНН || cp.inn || "";
    const kpp = matched1C?.КПП || cp.kpp || "";
    const bankAccount =
      matched1C?.РасчетныйСчет ||
      matchedAcc?.НомерСчета ||
      cp.bankAccount ||
      "";
    const bik = matched1C?.БИК || cp.bik || "";
    const bankName = matched1C?.Банк || cp.bankName || "";
    const contractNumber =
      matchedContract?.Номер ||
      matchedContract?.Наименование ||
      cp.contractNumber ||
      "";
    const contractType =
      matchedContract?.ВидДоговора || cp.contractType || "";

    const missingFields: string[] = [];
    const filledFields: string[] = [];
    (inn ? filledFields : missingFields).push("ИНН");
    if (String(inn).length !== 12) {
      (kpp ? filledFields : missingFields).push("КПП");
    }
    (bankAccount ? filledFields : missingFields).push("Расчетный счет");
    (bik ? filledFields : missingFields).push("БИК");
    (contractNumber ? filledFields : missingFields).push("Договор");

    const createdIn1C = Boolean(matched1C || cp.createdIn1C);
    const isComplete = missingFields.length === 0;

    return {
      entityId: cp.id || `cp-${idx + 1}`,
      entityType: "counterparty" as const,
      entityName: name,
      id: cp.id || `cp-${idx + 1}`,
      name,
      inn,
      kpp,
      bankAccount,
      bik,
      bankName,
      contractNumber,
      contractType,
      createdIn1C,
      missingFields,
      filledFields,
      isComplete,
      status: isComplete ? "complete" : createdIn1C ? "incomplete" : "missing",
    };
  });

  const dirEmployees: any[] = Array.isArray(directories?.employees)
    ? directories.employees
    : [];

  const employeeChecks = dirEmployees.map((emp: any, idx: number) => {
    const name = String(emp.name || emp.Наименование || "").trim();
    const missingFields: string[] = [];
    const filledFields: string[] = [];
    (emp.position ? filledFields : missingFields).push("Должность");
    (emp.salary ? filledFields : missingFields).push("Оклад");

    return {
      entityId: emp.id || `emp-${idx + 1}`,
      entityType: "employee" as const,
      entityName: name,
      id: emp.id || `emp-${idx + 1}`,
      name,
      createdIn1C: Boolean(emp.createdIn1C),
      missingFields,
      filledFields,
      isComplete: missingFields.length === 0,
      status: missingFields.length === 0 ? "complete" : "incomplete",
    };
  });

  const incompleteCount =
    counterpartyChecks.filter((c: any) => !c.isComplete).length +
    (organizationCheck.isComplete ? 0 : 1);
  const totalChecked = counterpartyChecks.length + 1;
  const completeCount = totalChecked - incompleteCount;
  const totalMissing =
    orgMissing.length +
    counterpartyChecks.reduce(
      (sum: number, c: any) => sum + c.missingFields.length,
      0
    );

  const issues = [
    ...(orgMissing.length > 0 ? [organizationCheck] : []),
    ...counterpartyChecks.filter((c: any) => c.missingFields.length > 0),
  ];

  return {
    organizationCheck,
    counterpartyChecks,
    employeeChecks,
    organization: organizationReport,
    counterparties: counterpartyChecks,
    issues,
    totalChecked,
    completeCount,
    incompleteCount,
    missingCount: totalMissing,
    totalMissing,
    isAllComplete: totalMissing === 0,
  };
}

export function enrichOperationsWith1CMatch(
  operations: any[],
  synced1C?: any,
  requisiteReport?: any
): any[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(operations)) return [];
  if (!synced1C) return operations;

  const postings1C: any[] = Array.isArray(synced1C.ПроводкиС_Апреля)
    ? synced1C.ПроводкиС_Апреля
    : [];

  const docs1C: any[] = synced1C.ВсеДокументы
    ? Object.values(synced1C.ВсеДокументы).flat()
    : [];

  return operations.map((op: any) => {
    const opDate = String(op.date || op.Дата || "").slice(0, 10);
    const opAmount = Number(op.amount || op.Сумма || 0);
    const opCounterparty = String(
      op.counterparty || op.Контрагент || ""
    ).toLowerCase();

    const matchedPostings = postings1C.filter((p: any) => {
      const pDate = String(p.Дата || "").slice(0, 10);
      const pAmount = Number(p.Сумма || 0);
      const subText = `${p.СубконтоДт1 || ""} ${p.СубконтоДт2 || ""} ${p.СубконтоКт1 || ""} ${p.СубконтоКт2 || ""} ${p.Документ || ""}`.toLowerCase();

      const amountMatch = opAmount > 0 && Math.abs(pAmount - opAmount) < 1;
      const dateMatch = opDate && pDate === opDate;
      const cpMatch = opCounterparty && subText.includes(opCounterparty);

      return (amountMatch && (dateMatch || cpMatch)) || (dateMatch && cpMatch);
    });

    const matchedDoc = docs1C.find((d: any) => {
      const dDate = String(d.Дата || "").slice(0, 10);
      const dSum = Number(d.СуммаДокумента || d.Сумма || 0);
      const dCp = String(d.Контрагент || "").toLowerCase();

      const sameDate = opDate && dDate === opDate;
      const sameCp = opCounterparty && dCp.includes(opCounterparty);
      const sameSum = opAmount > 0 && Math.abs(dSum - opAmount) < 1;

      return (sameDate && sameCp) || (sameCp && sameSum);
    });

    const missingRequisites: string[] = [];
    if (
      requisiteReport &&
      Array.isArray(requisiteReport.counterparties) &&
      opCounterparty
    ) {
      const cpReport = requisiteReport.counterparties.find((c: any) =>
        String(c.name || c.Наименование || "")
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(opCounterparty)
      );
      if (cpReport && Array.isArray(cpReport.missingFields)) {
        missingRequisites.push(...cpReport.missingFields);
      }
    }

    const isExactMatch =
      matchedPostings.length > 0 &&
      (!opAmount ||
        matchedPostings.some(
          (p: any) => Math.abs(Number(p.Сумма || 0) - opAmount) < 1
        ));

    return {
      ...op,
      status: isExactMatch ? "done" : op.status,
      match1C: {
        status: isExactMatch
          ? "matched"
          : matchedDoc || matchedPostings.length > 0
          ? "discrepancy"
          : "missing",
        postings: matchedPostings,
        document: matchedDoc || null,
        missingRequisites,
      },
    };
  });
}

import {

const DEFAULT_SUBACCOUNT_FOR_GROUP: Record<string, string> = {
  '01': '01.01',
  '02': '02.01',
  '08': '08.04',
  '10': '10.01',
  '19': '19.03',

function resolveLeafAccountCode(rawCode: string): string {
  const trimmed = (rawCode || '').trim();
  if (!trimmed) return '000';
  if (ACCOUNT_MAP[trimmed]?.isGroup && DEFAULT_SUBACCOUNT_FOR_GROUP[trimmed]) {
    return DEFAULT_SUBACCOUNT_FOR_GROUP[trimmed];
  }
  return trimmed;
}

function buildRedBalanceHint(
  accountCode: string,
  accountType: AccountType,
  amount: number
): string {
  const absStr = formatMoneyRu(Math.abs(amount));
  if (accountCode === '50.01' || accountCode.startsWith('50')) {
    return `Отрицательный остаток наличных в кассе (−${absStr})! Счет 50.01 активный — проверьте проведение ПКО «Получение наличных в банке» (Дт 50.01 Кт 51) и время документов.`;
  }
  if (accountCode === '51') {
    return `Отрицательное сальдо на расчетном счете 51 (−${absStr})! Проверьте начальный остаток по счету 51 и поступления от покупателей.`;
  }
  if (accountCode.startsWith('10') || accountCode.startsWith('41')) {
    return `Отрицательный складской остаток ТМЦ (−${absStr})! Списано больше, чем оприходовано — проверьте документ поступления и хронологию проведения.`;
  }
  if (accountCode === '60.02' || accountCode === '62.01') {
    return `Краснота на активном субсчете расчетов ${accountCode} (−${absStr})! Проверьте корректность выбора субсчета (60.01/60.02 или 62.01/62.02) и зачет авансов.`;
  }
  if (accountCode === '60.01' || accountCode === '62.02') {
    return `Краснота на пассивном субсчете расчетов ${accountCode} (−${absStr})! Вероятно, предоплата отражена на счете расчетов вместо авансового субсчета.`;
  }
  if (accountCode === '000') {
    return `Вспомогательный счет 000 не закрыт (остаток ${absStr})! Сумма дебетовых и кредитовых начальных остатков не совпадает.`;
  }
  if (accountType === 'active') {
    return `Отрицательное дебетовое сальдо на активном счете ${accountCode} (−${absStr}) — «краснота» в 1С 8.3.`;
  }
  return `Отрицательное кредитовое сальдо на пассивном счете ${accountCode} (−${absStr}) — «краснота» в 1С 8.3.`;
}

function compareAccountCodes(a: string, b: string): number {
  if (a === b) return 0;
  // Auxiliary account 000 always goes at the very end in 1C 8.3 OSV
  if (a === '000') return 1;
  if (b === '000') return -1;

  const segA = a.split('.');
  const segB = b.split('.');
  const maxLen = Math.max(segA.length, segB.length);

  for (let i = 0; i < maxLen; i++) {
    const partA = segA[i];
    const partB = segB[i];
    if (partA === undefined) return -1; // Parent group ("60") precedes subaccount ("60.01")
    if (partB === undefined) return 1;

    const numA = Number(partA);
    const numB = Number(partB);
    if (!Number.isNaN(numA) && !Number.isNaN(numB)) {
      if (numA !== numB) return numA - numB;
    } else {
      const cmp = partA.localeCompare(partB, 'ru');
      if (cmp !== 0) return cmp;
    }
  }
  return 0;
}

interface LeafAccumulator {
  accountCode: string;
  startDebit: number;
  startCredit: number;
  turnoverDebit: number;
  turnoverCredit: number;
  movements: OsvAccountCardMovement[];
}

/**
 * Calculates an authentic 1C:Бухгалтерия 8.3 (ред. 3.0) Trial Balance (Оборотно-сальдовая ведомость)
 * with leaf subaccounts, synthetic parent group rows, kopeck-exact double-entry math,
 * 1C red-balance («краснота») detection, and «Карточка счета» drill-down movements.
 */
export function calculateOsv(
  openingBalances: OpeningBalanceEntry[],
  operations: BusinessOperation[],
  mode: 'completed_only' | 'all_operations'
): OsvReport {
  const leafMap = new Map<string, LeafAccumulator>();

  const ensureLeaf = (rawCode: string): LeafAccumulator => {
    const code = resolveLeafAccountCode(rawCode);
    let acc = leafMap.get(code);
    if (!acc) {
      acc = {
        accountCode: code,
        startDebit: 0,
        startCredit: 0,
        turnoverDebit: 0,
        turnoverCredit: 0,
        movements: [],
      };
      leafMap.set(code, acc);
    }
    return acc;
  };

  // 1. Load Opening Balances
  for (const entry of openingBalances) {
    const debit = roundMoney(entry.debit || 0);
    const credit = roundMoney(entry.credit || 0);
    if (debit === 0 && credit === 0) continue;

    const leaf = ensureLeaf(entry.accountCode);
    leaf.startDebit = roundMoney(leaf.startDebit + debit);
    leaf.startCredit = roundMoney(leaf.startCredit + credit);
  }

  // 2. Filter & chronologically sort operations
  const filteredOps = operations
    .map((op, index) => ({ op, index }))
    .filter(({ op }) => {
      if (op.status === 'needs_data') return false;
      if (mode === 'completed_only') {
        return op.status === 'done';
      }
      // 'all_operations': include all operations with resolvedAmount > 0 or non-zero postings
      return (
        op.resolvedAmount > 0 || op.postings.some((p) => Math.abs(p.amount) >= 0.005)
      );
    })
    .sort((a, b) => {
      const keyA = parseDateToSortKey(a.op.date);
      const keyB = parseDateToSortKey(b.op.date);
      if (keyA !== keyB) return keyA - keyB;
      // Regular operations precede month-end closing operations on the last day of the month
      const closingA = a.op.isMonthEndClosing ? 1 : 0;
      const closingB = b.op.isMonthEndClosing ? 1 : 0;
      if (closingA !== closingB) return closingA - closingB;
      return a.index - b.index;
    });

  // 3. Accumulate turnovers & movements
  for (const { op } of filteredOps) {
    for (const posting of op.postings) {
      const amt = roundMoney(posting.amount || 0);
      if (Math.abs(amt) < 0.005) continue;

      const debitCode = resolveLeafAccountCode(posting.debitAccount);
      const creditCode = resolveLeafAccountCode(posting.creditAccount);

      const debitLeaf = ensureLeaf(debitCode);
      debitLeaf.turnoverDebit = roundMoney(debitLeaf.turnoverDebit + amt);
      debitLeaf.movements.push({
        operationId: op.id,
        operationNumber: op.number,
        date: op.date,
        description: posting.comment || op.rawDescription,
        correspondentAccount: creditCode,
        subconto: (posting.debitSubconto || []).filter(Boolean).join(' / '),
        debit: amt,
        credit: 0,
      });

      const creditLeaf = ensureLeaf(creditCode);
      creditLeaf.turnoverCredit = roundMoney(creditLeaf.turnoverCredit + amt);
      creditLeaf.movements.push({
        operationId: op.id,
        operationNumber: op.number,
        date: op.date,
        description: posting.comment || op.rawDescription,
        correspondentAccount: debitCode,
        subconto: (posting.creditSubconto || []).filter(Boolean).join(' / '),
        debit: 0,
        credit: amt,
      });
    }
  }

  // 4. Finalize leaf OsvRows using 1C 8.3 active / passive / active-passive rules
  const leafRows: OsvRow[] = [];
  for (const acc of Array.from(leafMap.values())) {
    const info = getAccountInfo(acc.accountCode);
    const parentCode =
      info.parentCode ||
      (acc.accountCode.includes('.') ? acc.accountCode.split('.')[0] : undefined);

    // Collapse net opening balance per subaccount if user entered multiple opening rows on same subaccount
    let startDebit = acc.startDebit;
    let startCredit = acc.startCredit;
    if (startDebit > 0 && startCredit > 0) {
      const startNet = roundMoney(startDebit - startCredit);
      if (info.type === 'active') {
        startDebit = startNet;
        startCredit = 0;
      } else if (info.type === 'passive') {
        startDebit = 0;
        startCredit = roundMoney(-startNet);
      } else if (startNet >= 0) {
        startDebit = startNet;
        startCredit = 0;
      } else {
        startDebit = 0;
        startCredit = roundMoney(Math.abs(startNet));
      }
    }

    let endDebit = 0;
    let endCredit = 0;
    let hasRedBalance = false;
    let redBalanceHint: string | undefined = undefined;

    if (info.type === 'active') {
      const net = roundMoney(
        startDebit - startCredit + acc.turnoverDebit - acc.turnoverCredit
      );
      endDebit = net;
      endCredit = 0;
      if (net < -0.004) {
        hasRedBalance = true;
        redBalanceHint = buildRedBalanceHint(acc.accountCode, info.type, net);
      }
    } else if (info.type === 'passive') {
      const net = roundMoney(
        startCredit - startDebit + acc.turnoverCredit - acc.turnoverDebit
      );
      endDebit = 0;
      endCredit = net;
      if (net < -0.004) {
        hasRedBalance = true;
        redBalanceHint = buildRedBalanceHint(acc.accountCode, info.type, net);
      }
    } else {
      // active-passive
      const net = roundMoney(
        startDebit - startCredit + acc.turnoverDebit - acc.turnoverCredit
      );
      if (net >= 0) {
        endDebit = net;
        endCredit = 0;
      } else {
        endDebit = 0;
        endCredit = roundMoney(Math.abs(net));
      }
      if (acc.accountCode === '000' && Math.abs(net) >= 0.01) {
        hasRedBalance = true;
        redBalanceHint = buildRedBalanceHint('000', 'active-passive', net);
      }
    }

    const isAllZero =
      Math.abs(startDebit) < 0.005 &&
      Math.abs(startCredit) < 0.005 &&
      Math.abs(acc.turnoverDebit) < 0.005 &&
      Math.abs(acc.turnoverCredit) < 0.005 &&
      Math.abs(endDebit) < 0.005 &&
      Math.abs(endCredit) < 0.005 &&
      acc.movements.length === 0;

    if (!isAllZero) {
      leafRows.push({
        accountCode: acc.accountCode,
        accountName: info.name,
        accountType: info.type,
        isGroup: false,
        parentCode,
        startDebit,
        startCredit,
        turnoverDebit: acc.turnoverDebit,
        turnoverCredit: acc.turnoverCredit,
        endDebit,
        endCredit,
        hasRedBalance,
        redBalanceHint,
        movements: acc.movements,
      });
    }
  }

  // 5. Build Synthetic Parent Group Rows (01, 02, 10, 19, 20, 41, 50, 60, 62, 68, 69, 76, 80, 84, 90, 91, 99, etc.)
  const childrenByParent = new Map<string, OsvRow[]>();
  for (const row of leafRows) {
    if (row.parentCode) {
      const list = childrenByParent.get(row.parentCode) || [];
      list.push(row);
      childrenByParent.set(row.parentCode, list);
    }
  }

  const groupRows: OsvRow[] = [];
  for (const [parentCode, children] of Array.from(childrenByParent.entries())) {
    const parentInfo = getAccountInfo(parentCode);
    const startDebit = roundMoney(children.reduce((s, c) => s + c.startDebit, 0));
    const startCredit = roundMoney(children.reduce((s, c) => s + c.startCredit, 0));
    const turnoverDebit = roundMoney(children.reduce((s, c) => s + c.turnoverDebit, 0));
    const turnoverCredit = roundMoney(children.reduce((s, c) => s + c.turnoverCredit, 0));

    let endDebit = 0;
    let endCredit = 0;

    // In 1C 8.3, synthetic accounts 90, 91, and 99 have collapsed ending balance across subaccounts
    // (so synthetic 90 and 91 equal 0,00 after month-end closing!), while settlement/asset accounts
    // (60, 62, 68, 69, 76, etc.) preserve expanded subaccount balances («развернутое сальдо»).
    if (parentCode === '90' || parentCode === '91' || parentCode === '99') {
      const collapsedNet = roundMoney(
        children.reduce((s, c) => s + (c.endDebit - c.endCredit), 0)
      );
      if (collapsedNet >= 0) {
        endDebit = collapsedNet;
        endCredit = 0;
      } else {
        endDebit = 0;
        endCredit = roundMoney(Math.abs(collapsedNet));
      }
    } else {
      endDebit = roundMoney(children.reduce((s, c) => s + c.endDebit, 0));
      endCredit = roundMoney(children.reduce((s, c) => s + c.endCredit, 0));
    }

    const childWithRed = children.find((c) => c.hasRedBalance);
    groupRows.push({
      accountCode: parentCode,
      accountName: parentInfo.name,
      accountType: parentInfo.type,
      isGroup: true,
      parentCode: undefined,
      startDebit,
      startCredit,
      turnoverDebit,
      turnoverCredit,
      endDebit,
      endCredit,
      hasRedBalance: Boolean(childWithRed),
      redBalanceHint: childWithRed?.redBalanceHint,
      movements: [],
    });
  }

  // 6. Combine & sort rows hierarchically
  const allRows = [...leafRows, ...groupRows].sort((a, b) =>
    compareAccountCodes(a.accountCode, b.accountCode)
  );

  // 7. Compute report totals strictly from leaf rows (!isGroup) so parent rows are never double-counted
  const totalStartDebit = roundMoney(leafRows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.startDebit, 0));
  const totalStartCredit = roundMoney(leafRows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.startCredit, 0));
  const totalTurnoverDebit = roundMoney(leafRows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.turnoverDebit, 0));
  const totalTurnoverCredit = roundMoney(leafRows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.turnoverCredit, 0));
  const totalEndDebit = roundMoney(leafRows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.endDebit, 0));
  const totalEndCredit = roundMoney(leafRows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.endCredit, 0));

  const isStartBalanced = Math.abs(roundMoney(totalStartDebit - totalStartCredit)) < 0.01;
  const isEndBalanced = Math.abs(roundMoney(totalEndDebit - totalEndCredit)) < 0.01;

  return {
    rows: allRows,
    totalStartDebit,
    totalStartCredit,
    totalTurnoverDebit,
    totalTurnoverCredit,
    totalEndDebit,
    totalEndCredit,
    isStartBalanced,
    isEndBalanced,
  };
}


=== FILE: src\lib\engine\osvReconciler.ts ===
import {
  BusinessOperation,
  OsvDiscrepancy,
  OsvReconciliationResult,
  OsvReport,
  OsvRow,
  UserOsvInputRow,
} from '@/types/accounting';
import { getAccountInfo } from '@/data/chartOfAccounts';
import { formatDateRu, formatMoneyRu, roundMoney } from './smartLinker';

function hasNumericValue(val: number | null | undefined): val is number {
  return val !== null && val !== undefined && Number.isFinite(val);
}

function isRowChecked(input: UserOsvInputRow): boolean {
  return (
    hasNumericValue(input.turnoverDebit) ||
    hasNumericValue(input.turnoverCredit) ||
    hasNumericValue(input.endDebit) ||
    hasNumericValue(input.endCredit)
  );
}

function findBestOperationByPosting(
  operations: BusinessOperation[],
  predicate: (debit: string, credit: string, amount: number) => boolean,
  targetAmount?: number
): BusinessOperation | undefined {
  const candidates = operations.filter((op) =>
    op.postings.some((p) => predicate(p.debitAccount, p.creditAccount, p.amount))
  );
  if (candidates.length === 0) return undefined;
  if (targetAmount === undefined) return candidates[0];

  let best = candidates[0];
  let bestDelta = Infinity;
  for (const op of candidates) {
    for (const p of op.postings) {
      if (predicate(p.debitAccount, p.creditAccount, p.amount)) {
        const delta = Math.abs(p.amount - targetAmount);
        if (delta < bestDelta) {
          bestDelta = delta;
          best = op;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return best;
}

/**
 * Compares user-entered 1C OSV figures against the reference OSV down to 0.01 ₽
 * and produces expert Russian 1C 8.3 accounting diagnostics explaining root causes and fixes.
 */
export function reconcileUserOsv(
  referenceOsv: OsvReport,
  userInputs: Record<string, UserOsvInputRow>,
  operations: BusinessOperation[]
): OsvReconciliationResult {
  const refByCode = new Map<string, OsvRow>();
  for (const row of referenceOsv.rows) {
    refByCode.set(row.accountCode, row);
  }

  const rowDiffs: OsvReconciliationResult['rowDiffs'] = {};
  let checkedAccountsCount = 0;
  let mismatchedAccountsCount = 0;

  for (const [rawKey, input] of Object.entries(userInputs || {})) {
    if (!input || !isRowChecked(input)) continue;
    const code = (input.accountCode || rawKey).trim();
    if (!code) continue;

    checkedAccountsCount += 1;
    const ref = refByCode.get(code);
    const refTurnDb = ref?.turnoverDebit ?? 0;
    const refTurnCr = ref?.turnoverCredit ?? 0;
    const refEndDb = ref?.endDebit ?? 0;
    const refEndCr = ref?.endCredit ?? 0;

    // Compare turnover pair if at least one turnover field was entered
    const enteredTurnoverPair =
      hasNumericValue(input.turnoverDebit) || hasNumericValue(input.turnoverCredit);
    const turnoverDebitDiff = enteredTurnoverPair
      ? roundMoney((input.turnoverDebit ?? 0) - refTurnDb)
      : 0;
    const turnoverCreditDiff = enteredTurnoverPair
      ? roundMoney((input.turnoverCredit ?? 0) - refTurnCr)
      : 0;

    // Compare ending balance pair if at least one ending balance field was entered
    const enteredEndPair =
      hasNumericValue(input.endDebit) || hasNumericValue(input.endCredit);
    const endDebitDiff = enteredEndPair
      ? roundMoney((input.endDebit ?? 0) - refEndDb)
      : 0;
    const endCreditDiff = enteredEndPair
      ? roundMoney((input.endCredit ?? 0) - refEndCr)
      : 0;

    const hasMismatch =
      Math.abs(turnoverDebitDiff) >= 0.01 ||
      Math.abs(turnoverCreditDiff) >= 0.01 ||
      Math.abs(endDebitDiff) >= 0.01 ||
      Math.abs(endCreditDiff) >= 0.01;

    if (hasMismatch) {
      mismatchedAccountsCount += 1;
    }

    rowDiffs[code] = {
      turnoverDebitDiff,
      turnoverCreditDiff,
      endDebitDiff,
      endCreditDiff,
      hasMismatch,
    };
  }

  const diagnostics: OsvDiscrepancy[] = [];
  const explainedAccounts = new Set<string>();

  // ==========================================================================
  // 1. Незачтенный аванс поставщику (60.01 и 60.02, или развернутый 60)
  // ==========================================================================
  const diff6001 = rowDiffs['60.01'];
  const diff6002 = rowDiffs['60.02'];
  const diff60Group = rowDiffs['60'];

  const excess6001Cr =
    diff6001 && diff6001.endCreditDiff >= 0.01
      ? diff6001.endCreditDiff
      : diff6001 && diff6001.turnoverDebitDiff <= -0.01
        ? Math.abs(diff6001.turnoverDebitDiff)
        : 0;
  const excess6002Db =
    diff6002 && diff6002.endDebitDiff >= 0.01
      ? diff6002.endDebitDiff
      : diff6002 && diff6002.turnoverCreditDiff <= -0.01
        ? Math.abs(diff6002.turnoverCreditDiff)
        : 0;

  if (
    excess6001Cr >= 0.01 &&
    excess6002Db >= 0.01 &&
    Math.abs(excess6001Cr - excess6002Db) <= Math.max(1, excess6001Cr * 0.02)
  ) {
    const amountX = roundMoney(excess6001Cr);
    const advOp =
      findBestOperationByPosting(
        operations,
        (d, c) => d === '60.01' && c === '60.02',
        amountX
      ) ||
      findBestOperationByPosting(
        operations,
        (_, c) => c === '60.01',
        amountX
      );

    const affected = ['60.01', '60.02'];
    if (diff60Group?.hasMismatch) affected.push('60');
    affected.forEach((a) => explainedAccounts.add(a));

    const opClause = advOp
      ? `в операции №${advOp.number} от ${formatDateRu(advOp.date)} `
      : '';

    diagnostics.push({
      id: 'diag-unoffset-supplier-advance',
      severity: 'error',
      accountsAffected: affected,
      diffAmount: amountX,
      title: `Не зачтен аванс поставщику на сумму ${formatMoneyRu(amountX)} (счета 60.01 и 60.02)`,
      probableCause: `Расхождение по счетам 60.01 и 60.02 на сумму ${formatMoneyRu(amountX)} — ${opClause}не произошел автоматический зачет аванса (Дт 60.01 Кт 60.02). Проверьте совпадение договора и время проведения документов в 1С (списание с р/сч должно быть раньше поступления)!`,
      howToFixIn1C:
        '1) Откройте «Списание с расчетного счета» и «Поступление (акт, накладная, УПД)» и убедитесь, что выбран один и тот же элемент справочника «Договоры»; 2) Проверьте реквизит «Зачет авансов: Автоматически»; 3) Убедитесь, что дата/время оплаты раньше времени поступления, и перепроведите документы («Операции → Групповое перепроведение документов»).',
      relatedOperationId: advOp?.id,
    });
  } else if (
    !diff6001 &&
    !diff6002 &&
    diff60Group?.hasMismatch &&
    diff60Group.endDebitDiff >= 0.01 &&
    Math.abs(diff60Group.endDebitDiff - diff60Group.endCreditDiff) <=
      Math.max(1, diff60Group.endDebitDiff * 0.02)
  ) {
    const amountX = roundMoney(diff60Group.endDebitDiff);
    const advOp = findBestOperationByPosting(
      operations,
      (d, c) => d === '60.01' && c === '60.02',
      amountX
    );
    explainedAccounts.add('60');
    diagnostics.push({
      id: 'diag-unoffset-supplier-advance-group',
      severity: 'error',
      accountsAffected: ['60', '60.01', '60.02'],
      diffAmount: amountX,
      title: `Развернутое сальдо по счету 60 на сумму ${formatMoneyRu(amountX)} (не зачтен аванс)`,
      probableCause: `По счету 60 одновременно завышены дебетовый и кредитовый остатки на ${formatMoneyRu(amountX)} — не сформирована проводка зачета аванса Дт 60.01 Кт 60.02${advOp ? ` в операции №${advOp.number} от ${formatDateRu(advOp.date)}` : ''}.`,
      howToFixIn1C:
        'Проверьте совпадение договора в платежном документе и документе поступления, а также время проведения документов в 1С (оплата с р/сч должна быть проведена раньше поступления).',
      relatedOperationId: advOp?.id,
    });
  }

  // ==========================================================================
  // 2. Незачтенный аванс покупателя (62.01 и 62.02, или развернутый 62)
  // ==========================================================================
  const diff6201 = rowDiffs['62.01'];
  const diff6202 = rowDiffs['62.02'];
  const diff62Group = rowDiffs['62'];

  const excess6201Db =
    diff6201 && diff6201.endDebitDiff >= 0.01
      ? diff6201.endDebitDiff
      : diff6201 && diff6201.turnoverCreditDiff <= -0.01
        ? Math.abs(diff6201.turnoverCreditDiff)
        : 0;
  const excess6202Cr =
    diff6202 && diff6202.endCreditDiff >= 0.01
      ? diff6202.endCreditDiff
      : diff6202 && diff6202.turnoverDebitDiff <= -0.01
        ? Math.abs(diff6202.turnoverDebitDiff)
        : 0;

  if (
    excess6201Db >= 0.01 &&
    excess6202Cr >= 0.01 &&
    Math.abs(excess6201Db - excess6202Cr) <= Math.max(1, excess6201Db * 0.02)
  ) {
    const amountX = roundMoney(excess6201Db);
    const buyerOp =
      findBestOperationByPosting(
        operations,
        (d, c) => d === '62.02' && c === '62.01',
        amountX
      ) ||
      findBestOperationByPosting(
        operations,
        (d, c) => d === '62.01' && c.startsWith('90.01'),
        amountX
      );

    const affected = ['62.01', '62.02'];
    if (diff62Group?.hasMismatch) affected.push('62');
    affected.forEach((a) => explainedAccounts.add(a));

    diagnostics.push({
      id: 'diag-unoffset-buyer-advance',
      severity: 'error',
      accountsAffected: affected,
      diffAmount: amountX,
      title: `Не зачтен аванс покупателя на сумму ${formatMoneyRu(amountX)} (счета 62.01 и 62.02)`,
      probableCause: `Расхождение по счетам 62.01 и 62.02 на сумму ${formatMoneyRu(amountX)}${buyerOp ? ` (операция №${buyerOp.number} от ${formatDateRu(buyerOp.date)})` : ''} — не произошел автоматический зачет полученной предоплаты покупателя (Дт 62.02 Кт 62.01).`,
      howToFixIn1C:
        'Проверьте в документах «Поступление на расчетный счет» и «Реализация (акт, накладная, УПД)» совпадение Контрагента и Договора с покупателем, реквизит «Зачет авансов: Автоматически» и последовательность времени проведения.',
      relatedOperationId: buyerOp?.id,
    });
  }

  // ==========================================================================
  // 3. Не принят к вычету НДС (19.01 / 19.03 / 19.04 и 68.02)
  // ==========================================================================
  const vat19Codes = ['19.01', '19.03', '19.04', '19'].filter(
    (code) => rowDiffs[code]?.hasMismatch && rowDiffs[code].endDebitDiff >= 0.01
  );

  if (vat19Codes.length > 0) {
    const sub19Codes = vat19Codes.filter((c) => c !== '19');
    const codesToSum = sub19Codes.length > 0 ? sub19Codes : vat19Codes;
    const strandedVat = roundMoney(
      codesToSum.reduce((s, c) => s + rowDiffs[c].endDebitDiff, 0)
    );

    const diff6802 = rowDiffs['68.02'];
    const affected = [...vat19Codes];
    if (diff6802?.hasMismatch) {
      affected.push('68.02');
      if (rowDiffs['68']?.hasMismatch) affected.push('68');
    }
    affected.forEach((a) => explainedAccounts.add(a));

    const vatOp = findBestOperationByPosting(
      operations,
      (d, c) => d === '68.02' && c.startsWith('19'),
      strandedVat
    );

    diagnostics.push({
      id: 'diag-stranded-vat-19',
      severity: 'error',
      accountsAffected: affected,
      diffAmount: strandedVat,
      title: `Не принят к вычету входящий НДС на сумму ${formatMoneyRu(strandedVat)} (счет ${codesToSum.join(', ')})`,
      probableCause: `Завис НДС на счете 19 (${formatMoneyRu(strandedVat)}) — не сформирована проводка налогового вычета Дт 68.02 Кт 19${vatOp ? ` по операции №${vatOp.number} от ${formatDateRu(vatOp.date)}` : ''}. Проверьте тумблер «УПД» под табличной частью документа поступления или регистрацию счета-фактуры и регламентную операцию Формирование записей книги покупок.`,
      howToFixIn1C:
        'В документе «Поступление (акт, накладная, УПД)» переключите тумблер «УПД» внизу формы в активное положение (либо зарегистрируйте счет-фактуру полученный с галочкой «Отразить вычет НДС в книге покупок датой получения») или выполните «Операции → Закрытие периода → Регламентные операции НДС → Формирование записей книги покупок».',
      relatedOperationId: vatOp?.id,
    });
  }

  // ==========================================================================
  // 4. Не закрыт затратный счет 20.01 или 26
  // ==========================================================================
  const unclosedCostCodes = ['20.01', '26', '25', '44.01'].filter((code) => {
    const refEnd = refByCode.get(code)?.endDebit ?? 0;
    const diff = rowDiffs[code];
    return Math.abs(refEnd) < 0.01 && diff?.hasMismatch && diff.endDebitDiff >= 0.01;
  });

  // Fallback if user only pasted synthetic "20"
  if (
    unclosedCostCodes.length === 0 &&
    Math.abs(refByCode.get('20')?.endDebit ?? 0) < 0.01 &&
    rowDiffs['20']?.hasMismatch &&
    rowDiffs['20'].endDebitDiff >= 0.01
  ) {
    unclosedCostCodes.push('20');
  }

  if (unclosedCostCodes.length > 0) {
    const totalUnclosed = roundMoney(
      unclosedCostCodes.reduce((s, c) => s + rowDiffs[c].endDebitDiff, 0)
    );
    const affected = [...unclosedCostCodes];
    if (rowDiffs['20']?.hasMismatch && !affected.includes('20')) affected.push('20');
    affected.forEach((a) => explainedAccounts.add(a));

    const closingCostOp =
      operations.find((op) => op.id === 'closing-regl-3-costs') ||
      findBestOperationByPosting(operations, (d) => d === '20.01' || d === '26');

    diagnostics.push({
      id: 'diag-unclosed-cost-accounts',
      severity: 'error',
      accountsAffected: affected,
      diffAmount: totalUnclosed,
      title: `Не закрыт затратный счет ${unclosedCostCodes.join(' / ')} на сумму ${formatMoneyRu(totalUnclosed)}`,
      probableCause: `Счет ${unclosedCostCodes.join(' / ')} не закрылся при закрытии месяца (осталось дебетовое сальдо ${formatMoneyRu(totalUnclosed)}) — проверьте совпадение Номенклатурной группы в расходах и в документе Реализации, а также проведение регламентной операции Закрытие счетов 20, 23, 25, 26.`,
      howToFixIn1C:
        '1) Проверьте, что в документах затрат (Расход материалов, Поступление субподрядных работ, Начисление зарплаты) и в документе «Реализация (акты, УПД)» указана строго одна и та же Номенклатурная группа; 2) Проверьте настройку директ-костинга для счета 26 в Учетной политике; 3) Выполните «Операции → Закрытие месяца → Закрытие счетов 20, 23, 25, 26».',
      relatedOperationId: closingCostOp?.id,
    });
  }

  // Обратная ситуация по 20.01: в эталоне числится НЗП (реализации СМР не было), а у студента 20.01 списан в 0 или отнесен на 26
  const ref2001End = refByCode.get('20.01')?.endDebit ?? 0;
  const diff2001 = rowDiffs['20.01'];
  if (
    ref2001End >= 0.01 &&
    diff2001?.hasMismatch &&
    diff2001.endDebitDiff <= -0.01 &&
    !explainedAccounts.has('20.01')
  ) {
    const wipDiff = roundMoney(Math.abs(diff2001.endDebitDiff));
    const affected = ['20.01'];
    if (rowDiffs['20']?.hasMismatch) affected.push('20');
    affected.forEach((a) => explainedAccounts.add(a));

    const wipOp = findBestOperationByPosting(operations, (d) => d === '20.01');
    diagnostics.push({
      id: 'diag-missing-wip-20',
      severity: 'error',
      accountsAffected: affected,
      diffAmount: wipDiff,
      title: `Занижен остаток НЗП на счете 20.01 на сумму ${formatMoneyRu(wipDiff)}`,
      probableCause: `В эталоне на счете 20.01 числится незавершенное производство (НЗП) ${formatMoneyRu(ref2001End)}, так как сдачи строительно-монтажных работ заказчику в текущем месяце не было. У вас сальдо 20.01 ниже на ${formatMoneyRu(wipDiff)}.`,
      howToFixIn1C:
        'Проверьте документ «Поступление услуг (акт, УПД)» по субподрядным работам: 1) Счет затрат должен быть 20.01 (не 26!); 2) Должна быть выделена отдельная Номенклатурная группа строительного объекта (например, «Ремонт кровли с установкой кирпичной трубы»), отличная от торговой группы реализации товаров, иначе 1С ошибочно спишет СМР под выручку от продажи товаров.',
      relatedOperationId: wipOp?.id,
    });
  }

  // ==========================================================================
  // 5. Штрафы и санкции (91.02 vs 99.02.3 / 99.01.1)
  // ==========================================================================
  const diff9102 = rowDiffs['91.02'];
  const diff99023 = rowDiffs['99.02.3'];

  if (
    (diff9102?.hasMismatch && diff99023?.hasMismatch) ||
    (diff99023?.hasMismatch && Math.abs(diff99023.endDebitDiff || diff99023.turnoverDebitDiff) >= 0.01)
  ) {
    const sanctionDiff = roundMoney(
      Math.max(
        Math.abs(diff99023?.endDebitDiff || 0),
        Math.abs(diff99023?.turnoverDebitDiff || 0),
        Math.abs(diff9102?.endDebitDiff || 0)
      )
    );
    const affected = ['99.02.3'];
    if (diff9102?.hasMismatch) affected.push('91.02');
    affected.forEach((a) => explainedAccounts.add(a));

    const penaltyOp = findBestOperationByPosting(
      operations,
      (d, c) => d === '99.02.3' || c === '76.02' || c === '68.10'
    );

    diagnostics.push({
      id: 'diag-penalty-split-91-99',
      severity: 'error',
      accountsAffected: affected,
      diffAmount: sanctionDiff,
      title: `Расхождение по штрафам и налоговым санкциям (${affected.join(' и ')})`,
      probableCause:
        'Проверьте раздельное отражение договорных неустоек (счет 91.02) и налоговых штрафов ИФНС (счет 99.02.3). Хозяйственные санкции контрагентам включаются в прочие расходы (91.02), а штрафы в бюджет относятся напрямую на счет 99.02.3 и не уменьшают налог на прибыль.',
      howToFixIn1C:
        'Проверьте проводки документа «Операция, введенная вручную» (по исполнительному листу / решению ИФНС): неустойку контрагенту отразите Дт 91.02 Кт 76.02, а налоговые санкции — Дт 99.02.3 Кт 68.10, после чего перезакройте месяц.',
      relatedOperationId: penaltyOp?.id,
    });
  }

  // ==========================================================================
  // 6. Ошибка НДС «сверху» вместо «в том числе» (~20%, ~16.67%, ~22%, ~18.03%)
  //    + Generic detailed per-account diagnostics for any remaining mismatches
  // ==========================================================================
  for (const [code, diff] of Object.entries(rowDiffs)) {
    if (!diff.hasMismatch || explainedAccounts.has(code)) continue;

    const refRow = refByCode.get(code);
    // Skip synthetic group row if at least one of its mismatched child subaccounts is also present in rowDiffs
    if (refRow?.isGroup) {
      const hasMismatchedChildInInput = Object.keys(rowDiffs).some(
        (k) => k.startsWith(`${code}.`) && rowDiffs[k].hasMismatch
      );
      if (hasMismatchedChildInInput) {
        explainedAccounts.add(code);
        continue;
      }
    }

    const primaryDelta =
      Math.abs(diff.endDebitDiff) >= 0.01
        ? diff.endDebitDiff
        : Math.abs(diff.endCreditDiff) >= 0.01
          ? diff.endCreditDiff
          : Math.abs(diff.turnoverDebitDiff) >= 0.01
            ? diff.turnoverDebitDiff
            : diff.turnoverCreditDiff;

    const absDelta = roundMoney(Math.abs(primaryDelta));
    const refBasis = Math.max(
      Math.abs(refRow?.turnoverDebit ?? 0),
      Math.abs(refRow?.turnoverCredit ?? 0),
      Math.abs(refRow?.endDebit ?? 0),
      Math.abs(refRow?.endCredit ?? 0)
    );

    const ratio = refBasis > 0 ? absDelta / refBasis : 0;
    const isVatModeError =
      ['10.01', '19.03', '19.04', '20.01', '26', '41.01', '60.01', '62.01', '90.01.1', '90.03'].includes(
        code
      ) &&
      ((ratio >= 0.194 && ratio <= 0.206) ||
        (ratio >= 0.162 && ratio <= 0.171) ||
        (ratio >= 0.214 && ratio <= 0.226) ||
        (ratio >= 0.176 && ratio <= 0.185));

    const relatedOp = findBestOperationByPosting(
      operations,
      (d, c) =>
        d === code ||
        c === code ||
        d.startsWith(`${code}.`) ||
        c.startsWith(`${code}.`),
      absDelta
    );

    if (isVatModeError) {
      const pctLabel = (ratio * 100).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
      explainedAccounts.add(code);
      diagnostics.push({
        id: `diag-vat-mode-${code}`,
        severity: 'warning',
        accountsAffected: [code],
        diffAmount: absDelta,
        title: `Вероятная ошибка настройки «НДС в сумме / НДС сверху» по счету ${code} (${formatMoneyRu(absDelta)})`,
        probableCause: `Разница по счету ${code} составляет ${formatMoneyRu(absDelta)} (~${pctLabel}% от эталона). Такая погрешность возникает, когда в документе 1С выбран режим начисления НДС «Сверху» вместо «НДС в сумме» (или наоборот).`,
        howToFixIn1C:
          'Откройте первичный документ в 1С, нажмите на ссылку «НДС сверху / НДС в сумме» над табличной частью и переключите режим в «НДС в сумме», чтобы итоговая сумма документа совпала с условием задачи.',
        relatedOperationId: relatedOp?.id,
      });
      continue;
    }

    // Generic precise explanation for this account
    const accInfo = getAccountInfo(code);
    const diffDetails: string[] = [];
    if (Math.abs(diff.turnoverDebitDiff) >= 0.01) {
      diffDetails.push(
        `Оборот Дт: отклонение ${diff.turnoverDebitDiff > 0 ? '+' : ''}${formatMoneyRu(diff.turnoverDebitDiff)} (эталон ${formatMoneyRu(refRow?.turnoverDebit ?? 0)})`
      );
    }
    if (Math.abs(diff.turnoverCreditDiff) >= 0.01) {
      diffDetails.push(
        `Оборот Кт: отклонение ${diff.turnoverCreditDiff > 0 ? '+' : ''}${formatMoneyRu(diff.turnoverCreditDiff)} (эталон ${formatMoneyRu(refRow?.turnoverCredit ?? 0)})`
      );
    }
    if (Math.abs(diff.endDebitDiff) >= 0.01) {
      diffDetails.push(
        `Сальдо кон. Дт: отклонение ${diff.endDebitDiff > 0 ? '+' : ''}${formatMoneyRu(diff.endDebitDiff)} (эталон ${formatMoneyRu(refRow?.endDebit ?? 0)})`
      );
    }
    if (Math.abs(diff.endCreditDiff) >= 0.01) {
      diffDetails.push(
        `Сальдо кон. Кт: отклонение ${diff.endCreditDiff > 0 ? '+' : ''}${formatMoneyRu(diff.endCreditDiff)} (эталон ${formatMoneyRu(refRow?.endCredit ?? 0)})`
      );
    }

    const touchingOps = operations
      .filter((op) =>
        op.postings.some(
          (p) =>
            p.debitAccount === code ||
            p.creditAccount === code ||
            p.debitAccount.startsWith(`${code}.`) ||
            p.creditAccount.startsWith(`${code}.`)
        )
      )
      .map((op) => `№${op.number}`);

    const opsHint =
      touchingOps.length > 0 ? ` Связанные операции задачи: ${touchingOps.join(', ')}.` : '';

    explainedAccounts.add(code);
    diagnostics.push({
      id: `diag-account-${code}`,
      severity: 'error',
      accountsAffected: [code],
      diffAmount: absDelta,
      title: `Расхождение по счету ${code} «${accInfo.name}» на ${formatMoneyRu(absDelta)}`,
      probableCause: `${diffDetails.join('; ')}.${opsHint}`,
      howToFixIn1C: `Сформируйте в 1С «Карточку счета ${code}» (двойной клик по строке счета в ОСВ) и сверьте начальный остаток и каждую проводку с разделом «Пошаговый разбор».`,
      relatedOperationId: relatedOp?.id,
    });
  }

  return {
    isPerfectMatch: mismatchedAccountsCount === 0,
    checkedAccountsCount,
    mismatchedAccountsCount,
    rowDiffs,
    diagnostics,
  };
}

function parseRussianNumberCell(raw: string): number | null {
  const cleaned = (raw || '')
    .replace(/[\s\u00A0\u202F]/g, '')
    .replace(/[₽рР](?:уб\.?)?/g, '')
    .trim();

  if (!cleaned || cleaned === '-' || cleaned === '—' || cleaned === '–') {
    return 0;
  }

  // Handle parentheses negative accounting format "(133 200,00)"
  const isParenNegative = /^\(.*\)$/.test(cleaned);
  const unwrapped = isParenNegative ? cleaned.slice(1, -1) : cleaned;
  const normalized = unwrapped.replace(/,/g, '.').replace(/−/g, '-');
  const parsed = Number(normalized);

  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) {
    return null;
  }
  return roundMoney(isParenNegative ? -Math.abs(parsed) : parsed);
}

function isLikelyTextNameCell(cell: string): boolean {
  const trimmed = cell.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return false;
  if (parseRussianNumberCell(trimmed) !== null && !/[а-яёa-z]{2,}/i.test(trimmed)) {
    return false;
  }
  return /[а-яёa-z]{2,}/i.test(trimmed);
}

/**
 * Parses TSV / semicolon-CSV / Markdown / space-separated rows copied from Excel or 1C 8.3 ОСВ
 * into `Record<string, UserOsvInputRow>`.
 */
export function parsePastedOsvTable(text: string): Record<string, UserOsvInputRow> {
  const result: Record<string, UserOsvInputRow> = {};
  if (!text || !text.trim()) return result;

  const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/);
  const accountCodeRegex = /^(\d{2}(?:\.\d{1,2})?(?:\.[0-9А-ЯЁA-Z]{1,3})?|000)$/i;

  for (const rawLine of lines) {
    const line = rawLine.trim();
    if (!line) continue;

    // Skip headers & totals
    if (/^(счет|счёт|итого|оборотно-сальдовая|период|показатель)/i.test(line)) {
      continue;
    }

    let cells: string[] = [];
    if (line.includes('\t')) {
      cells = rawLine.split('\t').map((c) => c.trim());
      // Trim trailing completely empty tab columns only if > 8 cols
      while (cells.length > 8 && cells[cells.length - 1] === '') {
        cells.pop();
      }
      if (cells[0] === '' && cells.length > 1) {
        cells.shift();
      }
    } else if (line.includes(';')) {
      cells = line.split(';').map((c) => c.trim());
    } else if (line.includes('|')) {
      cells = line
        .replace(/^\|/, '')
        .replace(/\|$/, '')
        .split('|')
        .map((c) => c.trim());
    }

    if (cells.length >= 2) {
      const candidateCode = cells[0].replace(/^сч\.?\s*/i, '').trim();
      if (!accountCodeRegex.test(candidateCode)) continue;

      const rest = cells.slice(1);
      // Drop account name column if present right after account code
      const numericCells =
        rest.length > 0 && isLikelyTextNameCell(rest[0]) ? rest.slice(1) : rest;

      const parsedNums = numericCells.map((c) => parseRussianNumberCell(c));
      if (parsedNums.every((v) => v === null)) continue;

      const valAt = (i: number): number => parsedNums[i] ?? 0;

      if (numericCells.length >= 6) {
        // [StartDb, StartCr, TurnDb, TurnCr, EndDb, EndCr]
        result[candidateCode] = {
          accountCode: candidateCode,
          turnoverDebit: valAt(2),
          turnoverCredit: valAt(3),
          endDebit: valAt(4),
          endCredit: valAt(5),
        };
      } else if (numericCells.length >= 4) {
        // [TurnDb, TurnCr, EndDb, EndCr]
        result[candidateCode] = {
          accountCode: candidateCode,
          turnoverDebit: valAt(0),
          turnoverCredit: valAt(1),
          endDebit: valAt(2),
          endCredit: valAt(3),
        };
      } else if (numericCells.length >= 2) {
        // [EndDb, EndCr]
        result[candidateCode] = {
          accountCode: candidateCode,
          endDebit: valAt(0),
          endCredit: valAt(1),
        };
      } else if (numericCells.length === 1 && parsedNums[0] !== null) {
        const info = getAccountInfo(candidateCode);
        result[candidateCode] =
          info.type === 'passive'
            ? { accountCode: candidateCode, endDebit: 0, endCredit: parsedNums[0] }
            : { accountCode: candidateCode, endDebit: parsedNums[0], endCredit: 0 };
      }
      continue;
    }

    // Space-separated fallback (e.g. "60.01 1 236 900,00 1 630 750,00 0,00 573 850,00" or "60.01 0 1416900")
    const leadMatch = /^(\d{2}(?:\.\d{1,2})?(?:\.[0-9А-ЯЁA-Z]{1,3})?|000)\s+(.+)$/i.exec(
      line
    );
    if (!leadMatch) continue;

    const code = leadMatch[1];
    const tail = leadMatch[2].trim();

    const hasDecimalTokens = /\d[.,]\d{2}\b/.test(tail);
    const tokenRegex = hasDecimalTokens
      ? /[−-]?\d{1,3}(?:[\s\u00A0]\d{3})*[.,]\d{2}\b|[−-]?\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?/g
      : /[−-]?\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?/g;

    const matches = tail.match(tokenRegex) || [];
    const nums = matches
      .map((m) => parseRussianNumberCell(m))
      .filter((n): n is number => n !== null);

    if (nums.length >= 6) {
      result[code] = {
        accountCode: code,
        turnoverDebit: nums[2],
        turnoverCredit: nums[3],
        endDebit: nums[4],
        endCredit: nums[5],
      };
    } else if (nums.length >= 4) {
      result[code] = {
        accountCode: code,
        turnoverDebit: nums[0],
        turnoverCredit: nums[1],
        endDebit: nums[2],
        endCredit: nums[3],
      };
    } else if (nums.length >= 2) {
      result[code] = {
        accountCode: code,
        endDebit: nums[0],
        endCredit: nums[1],
      };
    } else if (nums.length === 1) {
      const info = getAccountInfo(code);
      result[code] =
        info.type === 'passive'
          ? { accountCode: code, endDebit: 0, endCredit: nums[0] }
          : { accountCode: code, endDebit: nums[0], endCredit: 0 };
    }
  }

  return result;
}
